tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi gsung 'bum pod (ṇa )pa bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi gsung 'bum pod (ṇa )pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi gsung 'bum pod (ṇa )pa bzhugs so//

(1) ༄༅// mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa bzhugs so// (2) da ni nyan thos kyi grub pa'i mtha'i chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bstan 'chos bshad par bya ste/ de la gsum bstan 'chos la 'jug pa dang*/ bstan 'chos dngos dang*/ bstan 'chos mthar phyin pa'i don no// dang po la bzhi las/ mchod par brjod pa ni/ rang nyid dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun par/ ston pas gzhan dag dang bskyed pa la sogs pa'i don du ston pa la bstod phyag gsungs te/ de la phyag 'tshal zhes sbyar ro// gang la na/ rang don gyi khyad par bcom ldan 'das/ gang zhig shes bya (3) kun la don mthong ba'i/ gegs su gyur pas mun pa ste/ nyon mongs can dang*/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i ma rig pa thams cad gtan bcom pa ste/ slar mi skye bar byas pa'o// gang ces pa spyi sgra yin yang gtan bcom zhes pa'i don gyi shugs kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la 'jug ste nyan rang yang kun la mun pa bcom par 'dod mod kyi gtan nas ni min pa'i phyir te/ mdo las gsung pa ltar nyan rang la sangs rgyas kyi chos dang*/ dus dang yul shin tu skal ba dang*/ don rab tu dbye ba mtha' yas pa rnams mi shes pa'i rmongs sgrib ci rigs par yod pas so// gzhan don gyi khyad par ni/ 'khor ba nyid kun du chags pa'i gnas dang*/ rgal bka' bas 'dam lta bu ste/ de las 'gro ba skyabs med pa rnams skal ba dang mtshams par don ji lta ba bzhin phyin ci ma log par chos ston pa'i phyag brkyang bas drangs par mdzad (4) pa'i sangs rgyas de la'o// bshad par dam 'cha' ba ni rtsom pa mthar phyin par bya ba'i phyir te/ de ltar phyag 'tshal nas/ ci bya na/ chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bstan 'chos legs par gshar par bya ste/ de yang rgyu nyon mongs las 'chos shing*/ 'bras bu ngan 'gro dang srid pa las skyob pas bstan 'chos zhes bya'o// mtshan gyi don la gnyis te/ mngon pa bshad pa dang mdzod bshad pa'o// dang po ni/

chos mngon pa gang zhe na/ de la don dam pa dang*/ brdar brtags pa gnyis las/ don dam pa'i chos mngon pa ni/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab dri ma zag pa med pa rjes 'brang 'khor dang bcas pa zag med kyi phung po lnga ste/ mthong sgom mi slob lam gyis bsdus pa'i zag med kyi sdom pa'i gzugs dang*/ zag med kyi tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes dang*/ sems pa sogs dang*/ yid shes sogs so// brdar rtags pa ni/ don dam pa'i mngon pa de thos par bya ba'i phyir gyi thos bsam sgom byung dang*/ skyes stobs kyi shes rab zag bcas 'dod gzugs su ji rigs par phung po lnga dang*/ (5) gzugs med du bzhi'i 'khor dang bcas pa gang dang*/ chos mngon pa rjod byed kyi bstan 'chos gang yin pa'o// de la 'dod pa na thos bsam yod kyi/ mnyam par ma bzhag pas sgom byung med cing*/ gzugs na gzhan gnyis yod kyi sems par rtsol ba'i tshe ting nge 'dzin skye bas bsam byung med de/ sgom byung gong ma gnyis dang*/ skyes stobs khams gsum car na yod do// de'i thos bsam dang skyes thob gsum gyi shes rab ni sa gang na yod kyang phung po bzhi pa ste/ gzugs kyi sgom byung ni bsam gtan gyi sdom pa'i gzugs dang bcas pa'i phung po lnga'o// de'i tshe nges tshig ni/ rang mtshan 'dzin pas chos ste/ myang 'das sam/ rang spyi'i mtshan nyid la mngon du phyogs pas mngon pa zhes bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'di ji ltar na/ chos mngon pa'i mdzod yin zhe na/ gzhung 'dir/ mngon pa sde bdun sogs chos mngon pa'i bstan 'chos te/ gces pa rnams don du ste/ tshig gi sgo nas min par don gyi sgo nas yang dag par chud (6) pa'i phyir/ 'di chos mngon pa'i bstan 'chos de'i mdzod lta bu yin pas sam/ yang na de las 'di phyung bas gzhung 'di'i gnas chos mngon pa de yin pas/ de nyid gzhung 'di'i mdzod te/ de lta bas na gzhung 'di/ chos mngon pa'i mdzod yin no// gsungs pa'i dgos pa ni ci'i phyir/

chos mngon pa bstan/ 'di dang por sus bstan pas slob dpon 'dis 'chad par gyur ce na/ chos mngon pa ma bstan na slob mas chos dbye mi nus shing*/ gang gi phyir chos rnams rab tu rnam par 'byed pa med par nyon mongs rnams nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i thabs la/ ma zhi na nyon mongs pas kyang 'jig rten srid pa nyid 'ching bar chos mthun pas rgya mtsho lta bu 'dir 'khyams te/ rgyu mtshan de bas chos rab tu rnam 'byed de'i rgyur chos mngon pa 'di ni ston pa sangs rgyas kyis sil bur gsungs la/ ka t+ya'i bu sogs kyis sde tshan bdun du bsdus te/ ye shes la 'jug ka t+ya'i bus// rab tu byed pa dbyig shes kyis// rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis// chos kyi phung po (7) shwa ri'i bus// gdags pa'i bstan chos mau 'gal bus// 'gro ba'i rnam grangs gsus po ches// khams kyi tshogs ni gang pos bsdus// ces 'dod la/ gzhan du na/ de bdun las gzhan pa'i mngon pa mi snang bas/ gsung rabs la sde snod gsum ma tshang bar 'gyur ro// zhe'o// lo ces pa ni/ bye brag du smra ba'i lugs de la/ mdo sde pas zur za ba ste/ sde bdun la 'khrul pa du ma snang bas ston pa'i bka' min gyi dgra bcom pa de dang des byas pa yin la/ sde snod gsum ma tshang bar yang mi 'gyur te/ 'dir grangs pa'i mdo la sogs pa gtso bor chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i ched du chos kyi mtshan nyid ston pa'i sde snod du ma gsungs pas so// bstan 'chos dngos la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni chos mngon pa bstan pas/ dbye bya'i chos rnams gang zhe na/ mdor bsdu na zag bcas dang zag pa med pa ni dbye bya'i chos rnams so// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ (8) zag bcas bshad/ zag med bshad/ de dag rten la dbab pa'o// dang po ni/ zag bcas rnams gang zhe na/ lam bden ma rtogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams ni zag bcas so// gang gi phyir na lam bden ma yin pa'i 'dus byas de rnams las zag pa nyon mongs rnams rgyas shing 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin la/

'gog lam la dmigs nas zag pa skye bar 'dod kyang rgyas par mi 'gyur ro// zag med la gnyis te/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ 'dus ma byas bye brag du bshad pa'o// dang po ni zag med rnams gang zhe na/ lam gyi bden pa dang*/ rgyu rkyen gyis 'dus ma byas rnams pa gsum yin te/ gsum gang zhe na/ nam mkha' dang*/ so sor rtags pa dang*/ rtags min gyi 'gog pa gnyis so// gnyis pa ni/ 'dus ma byas gsum po de la nam mkha' ni mi sgrib pa'i rang bzhin gang na gzugs kyi go yod pa'o// bden pa bzhi la/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab bar chad med pa'i lam gyis thob bya'i 'gog pa gang de ni gnyen pos zag bcas dang bral ba'o// de yang (9) bar gyi tshig phyis pa ste/ ba lang dag dang ldan pa'i shing rta la ba lang gi shi rta ces pa lta bu'o// ci zag bcas thams cad kyi so sor rtags 'gog cig kho na lam zhe na/ so so ste/ ldan rdzas sam ji snyed pa'i bral rdzas kyang de snyed do// gzhan du na/ sdug bsngal mthong spang gi 'gog pa mngon du byas pas/ nyon mongs kun gyis 'gog pa mngon du byed par thal zhing de lta na lhag ma'i gnyen po sgom pa don med du 'gyur ro// so sor rtags 'gog las gzhan so sor rtags min gyi 'gog pa ni/ rgyu yod kyang rkyen ma tshang bas chos ma 'ongs pa skye ba la gtan du gegs byed pas nam yang ma skyes pa'i cha ste/ la lar gzugs gzhan la lta zhing*/ yid g.yengs pa na bya rog tu snang ba'i mig shes mi skye ste/ bya rog snang rung yod pa na lta 'dod med cing*/ lta bar 'dod pa na/ phyogs gzhan du song ba lta bu'o// de gsum ni/ bye brag smra ba rtag rdzas rang dbang can dang*/ mdo sde pa rtag yod du 'dod do// de dag bstan la dbab pa (10) la/ gnas brgyad las/ dang po khams bstan pa bzhi ste/ 'dus byas kyi dbye ba rnam grangs dang bcas pa dang*/ phung khams skye mched kyi rnam bzhag dang*/

chos gsum po der kun 'dus par bstan pa dang*/ lam ma rtogs pa'i khams la rnam pa'i rab tu dbye ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ ngo bo'i dbye ba dang*/ spyi'i rnam grangs dang*/ zag bcas kyi rnam grangs so// dang po ni/ 'dus byas rnams zag bcas ces bshad pa'i 'dus byas gang zhe na/ rkyen rnams 'dus shing phrad nas byas pa'i chos rnams de dag kyang gzugs dang sogs pas tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnams te/ phung po lnga'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'dus byas de rnams nyid song ba dang*/ 'gro ba dang*/ 'gro bar 'gyur bas sam/ mi rtag pas za bas dus dang*/ don 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i ming smos pas gtam ste/ dag gi gzhi dang*/ lam bden yang lhag med du 'dor ba sogs myang 'das su nges par 'byung ba dang bcas pa dang bzhi ste/ rgyu dang bcas pa'o// 'dus ma byas ni de lta ma yin no// mdo sde pa ni de (11) skad gzhi ngo bo nyid la 'dod la/ gsung rab tu bzhi ni ngo bo nyid dang dmigs pa dang*/ kun tu sbyar bya ba dang*/ rgyu dang yongs su bzung ba ste/ lnga la 'jug par bshad do// gsum pa ni/ yang 'dus byas gang rnams zag bcas yin na/ de rnams nyer len phung po ste/ nyer len ni nyon mongs yin la/ de yang rtsa dang sog ma'i me zhes pa ltar/ nyer len las byung bas sam/ mi tog dang 'bras bu'i shing zhes pa ltar/ phung po las nyer len 'byung bas de skad do// rang gzhan la gnod pas 'thab pa ste/ nyon mongs dang bcas pa zhes bya'o// 'phags pa rnams dang mi mthun pas sdug bsngal lo// 'di las sdug bsngal kun 'byung bas kun 'byung ba'o// 'jig pas 'jig rten dang*/ 'di la lta ba rgyas par 'gyur ba'i sgo nas gnas pas lta ba'i gnas so// yang srid par 'byung bas srid pa'ang zag bcas de rnams yin no// phung khams skye mched kyi rnam bzhag la gsum te/ phung khams skye mched so so'i rang bzhin dang*/ sgra don dang*/ bstan pa'i dgos

(12) pa dang*/ de rnams nges pa'i rgyu mtshan no// dang po la gsum ste/ chos gsum bshad pa dang*/ bsdu ba dang*/ khams mang bar thal ba spang ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ gzugs kyis dang*/ chos kyis dang*/ sems kyis bsdus pa'i chos gsum gyis rang bzhin no// dang po la gnyis ste/ gzugs kyi phung po dang*/ de skye mched khams su bstan pa'o// dang po la bstan bshad gnyis kyi/ bstan pa ni/ gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po lnga zhes pa de la gzugs kyi phung po ni/ dbye na bcu cig yod de/ dbang po mig sogs lnga dang*/ don gzugs sogs lnga dang*/ rnam rig byed min gyi gzugs rnams su yod pa'i phyir ro// bshad pa la dbang po lnga ni/ mig rna ba/ sna/ lce/ lus kyi dbang po rnams yin la/ mig dbang gi mtshan nyid/ mig gi rnam shes kyi bdag rkyen gzugs can dang ba ste/ de bzhin du rna ba la sogs pa'ang rigs sgre'o// don lnga ni/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yin la/ gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ mig gi gzung don ste/ (13) de bzhin du sgra sogs pa'ang rigs sgre'o// de la gzugs chos can/ bsdu na gnyis sam/ phye na nyi shur dbyer yod de/ kha dog dang*/ dbyibs gnyis sam/ sngo ser dkar dmar/ ring thung*/ lham/ zlum po mtho dma' cha le dang*/ cha le ma yin sprin du rdul/ khug rna nyi grib snang mun no// zhes pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de la ring sogs brgyad dbyibs dang*/ lhag ma bzhi dang brgyad rtsa ba dang*/ yan lag gi kha dog gi dbye ba ste/ kha dog nyid dang dbyibs nyid dang*/ de gnyis ka yin pa'i mu gsum 'dod cing*/ mngon pa'i mdo sde pa ni/ dbyibs rtog pas brtags pa rdzas su med par bzhed la/ rigs pa'i mdo sde pa de rdzas su bzhed par mngon no// sgra ni/ dbye na rnam pa brgyad yod de/ zin ma zin gnyis dang*/ de re re la lung du bstan pa/ snyan mi snyan gnyis/ lung du mi ston pa snyan mi snyan gnyis te/

bzhi bzhi yod pas so// zin pa'i sgra bzhi ni/ glu dang*/ du ba dang*/ pheg rdob (14) dang*/ rdeg mtshog gi sgra lta bu dang*/ ma zin pa'i sgra bzhi ni/ sprul pa'i glu dang*/ du ba dang*/ pheb rdob dang*/ brag ral ba'i sgra lta bu'o// ro ni dbye na rnam pa drug yod de/ mngar skyur lan tshwa/ tsha ba/ kha ba/ ska ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir ro// dri ni dbye na bzhi ste/ zhim mi zhim/ mnyam mi mnyam rnams su dbyer yod pas so// reg bya ni/ dbye na bcu gcig yod de/ 'byung bzhi 'jam rtsub lci yang grang ba/ bkres skom gyi reg bya rnams su yod pa'i phyir ro// de la phyi ma gsum ni/ dro ba dang*/ zas dang*/ skom pa 'dod pa'i rgyu'i reg bya ste/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i ming gi btags pa'o// rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs bshad pa la/ mtshan nyid ni/ lung bstan gyi gzugs rgyun gang zhig rang kun slong gi sems gzhan la rig par mi byed pa ste/ de yang gnas skabs kyi khyad par ma yengs pa dang*/ sems yod pa lta zhog g.yengs pa ste/ rang gi kun slong las gnas pa'i sems la gnas pa'i tshe dang*/ sems med pa'i snyoms (15) 'jug gnyis la gnas pa'i tshe yang yod la/ ngo bo'i khyad par rnam par rig byed dang*/ ting nge 'dzin las byung ba'i gzugs de dag dge dang mi dge ba rjes su 'brel ba'i rgyun yin la/ thob pa'i rgyun yang de 'dra yod pas/ de gcad pa'i phyir/ rgyu'i khyad par 'byung ba chen po rnams rgyur bar byas pa'i 'byung 'gyur de ni gzugs dang byed pa'i rang bzhin yin yang rnam par rig byed kyi gzugs ltar rang kun slong gi sems rig par mi byed pa'o// 'o na rgyu 'byung ba chen po rnams gang zhe na/ 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid/ gzugs can gang zhig rten du gyur pa ste/ 'bras gzugs kyi rten ni bya ba la shas che bas chen po rnams ni sa dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ rlung gi khams rnams te/

rang gi mtshan nyid dang*/ 'bras bu'i gzugs 'dzin pas khams rnams so// khams de dag gi las ni gang mtshan nyid ni ci zhe na/ rim pa bzhin 'dzin pa dang sogs pas sdud pa dang*/ smin pa dang*/ rgyas par (16) byed pa'i las su grub la/ mtshan nyid ni rim pa bzhin sra ba dang gsher ba dang*/ dro ba dang*/ g.yo bar snang ba'i reg bya ste/ nyid ni dngos po'i rkyen yin la/ g.yo ba ni 'byung ba'i rgyun yul gzhan du skyed pa'o// gsung rab tu sa'i khams sogs pa dang*/ sa sogs kyang gsungs na sa sogs dang sa'i khams sogs la khyad ci yod ce na/ 'jig rten gyi tha snyad du sa ser po dang*/ gru bzhi sogs kha dog dbyibs la sa zhes brjod cing*/ der ma zad chu dkar po dang*/ zlum po dang*/ me dmar po dang*/ gru gsum sogs/ chu me yang 'jig rten gyi tha snyad du kha dog dang dbyibs la brjod do// rlung ni khams g.yo ba nyid la 'jig rten na rlung zhes 'dogs la/ sa sogs de dang 'dra bar rlung sngon po dang*/ zlum po sogs kha dog dang dbyibs la'ang brjod do// 'ang ni khams la 'dogs par ma zad pa'o// des na 'byung 'gyur gyi mtshan nyid gzugs can gang zhig rten par grub pa zhes thob ste/ sngar bshad pa'i dbang don rnams so// gnyis pa de skye mched dang khams su bstan pa ni/

(17) gzugs phung gi ngo bor bstan pa'i phyir/ dbang don bcu po de rnams kho na la skye mched rnam par bzhag pa na phyi nang gi skye mched gzugs can bcu dang*/ khams rnam par bzhag pa na gzugs can gyi khams bcur 'dod do// gnyis pa chos kyis bsdus pa'i chos gsum gyi rang bzhin ni/ tshor ba'i mtshan nyid gtso bor rnam smin myong ba'i sems byung 'du shes kyi mtshan nyid gtso bor yul gyi mtshan ma 'dzin pa'i sems byung*/ 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid gzugs tshor 'du shes rnam shes bzhi las rdzas gzhan pa'i 'dus byas so// phung po de gsum dang*/ rnam rig byed min gyi gzugs dang 'dus ma byas gsum po rnams dang bcas pa'i chos bdun ni skye mched dang*/ khams rnam par bzhag pa na/ chos kyi skye mched dang*/ chos kyi khams zhes bya'o// gsum pa ni rnam shes kyi phung po ni yul dang*/ yul so sor rnam par rig pa mig shes sogs drug go /skye mched rnam par bzhag pa ni yid kyi skye mched kyang rnam (18) shes phung por bstan pa de nyid yin la/ de gnyis khams rnam par bzhag par khams bdun rnams su'ang 'dod pa ste/ bdun gang zhe na/ mig nas yid kyis rnam par shes pa'i bar drug gi khams dang yid kyi khams so// 'o na rnam shes tshogs drug ni/ rnam shes phung por bshad pa ma yin nam/ de las gzhan pa'i yid kyi khams gang zhe na/ gzhan ni med kyi drug po nyid kyi 'das shing 'gags ma thag pa'i rnam shes gang dang gang yin pa de dang de nyid yid kyi khams te/ bu de nyid gzhan gyi phar gyur pa lta bu'o// des na yid khams kyi mtshan nyid 'gags ma thag pa'i rnam shes so// de ltar na rnam shes kyi khams drug dang yid kyi khams phan tshun 'dus pas rdzas su na khams bcu bdun nam bcu gnyis su 'gyur ro zhe na/ yid kyi khams ni rnam shes khams drug las zur du bstan dgos pa'i phyir te/ drug pa yid kyi rnam shes kyi rten sgrub dgos pa'i phyir ro// des na khams ni bco brgyad du dbyer yod de rten dang*/

(19) brten pa dang dmigs pa drug drug du dbyer yod pas so// gnyis pa bsdu ba ni/ chos ni mdor bsdu na/ phung po gcig gzugs dang*/ skye mched gcig yid dang*/ khams gcig chos kyis khyed thams cad bsdus te/ gzugs phung gis gzugs can gyi skye mched bcu dang*/ khams bcu bsdus la/ yid kyi skye mched kyi rnam shes phung po dang*/ sems kyi khams bdun bsdus zhing*/ chos khams kyi tshor 'du dang 'du byed de gsum dang*/ rig byed min pa'i gzugs dang*/ chos kyi skye mched bsdus pas so// bsdu ba de ni gang nas 'byung yang rung mig dbang lta bu rang gi ngo bo nyid gzugs phung dang*/ mig gis skye mched dang*/ khams kyis bsdus te/ gzhan tshor ba sogs kyi dngos po ni ma yin no// ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzhan de dang mi ldan pa'i phyir ro// khams mang bar thal bar spang ba ni/ mig rna ba/ sna dang gsum ni gnyis gnyis yod pas khams nyer gcig du mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ mig ni gnyis yod kyang khams gcig du (20) bgrang ste/ khyed gnyis rigs mig gi rang bzhin dang*/ spyod yul gzugs dang*/ 'bras bu mig gi rnam shes su 'dra ba'i phyir de bzhin du sogs pas bsdus pa rna ba dang*/ sna la'ang sbyar ro// 'on kyang rten mdzes par bya ba'i phyir du gnyis gnyis 'byung*/ gnyis pa sgra don dang bstan pa'i dgos pa ni/ du ma spungs pa ni phung po'i don ste/ mdor gzugs gang ci mang rung 'das pa'am/ ma 'ongs pa'am/ da ltar byung ba'am/ nang gi'am/ phyi'i'am/ rags pa'am/ phra ba'am/ ngan pa'am/ gya nom pa'am/ thag ring ba'am/ nye ba na yod pa gang de dag thams cad gcig du bsdus te/ gzugs kyi phung po zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o zhes dang rnam shes kyi khar du'ang gsungs so// sems dang sems byung rnams skye zhing*/ 'chad la rgyas par byed pa'i sgo ni skyed mched kyi don no// rigs te 'byung gnas sgyu ni khams gyi don te/

'dus byas kun rang rang gi rigs 'dra phyi ma'i skal nyams kyi rgyu dang 'dus ma byas kyang dmigs pa'i sgo nas sems dang sems byung gi gnas (21) yin pas so// gzhan dag rigs rang bzhin la 'dod pa ltar na/ khams bco brgyad char rang rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin pas khams zhes bya'o// yang ci'i phyir phung po sogs gsum bstan ce na/ phung po/ skye mched/ khams rnams ni khyed gsum bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ khyed gsum bstan pa de gdul bya rnams kyi rmongs pa sems byung nyid dang*/ gzugs nyid dang*/ gzugs sems dag la ril por 'dzin pa gsum gyi phyir dang*/ dbang po rno 'bring brtul po gsum dang*/ tshig bsdus pa bar ma rgyas pa 'dod pa rnam pa gsum gyi ched yin pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang rmongs pa gsum ni mdo'i dgongs pa ltar na/ gcig bu dang byed pa po dang*/ za ba po'i bdag tu rmongs pa gsum zlog pa'i don du yin no// gsum de rnams nges pa'i rgyu mtshan la bzhi ste/ sems byung las tshor 'du gnyis phung po logs su ston pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ 'dus ma byas phung por mi 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ phung khams skye mched (22) kyi go rim nges tshul dang*/ gzugs dang chos kyi skye mched gnyis bye brag la bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan no// dang po ni/ ci'i phyir/ sems byung gzhan rnams 'du byed kyi phung po gcig du bstan cing*/ tshor 'du gnyis logs su phung por bstan ce na/ tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes ni sems byung gzhan rnams las khyed gnyis logs su phung por bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyed gnyis kyi tshor bas khyim pa dang 'du shes kyis rab tu byung ba rnams rtsod pas rtsod pa'i rtsa bar gyur pa dang*/ tshor bas 'dod pa la zhen pa dang*/ 'du shes log pa bas lta ba la zhen pas 'khor ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo'i phyir dang*/ gzugs kyi 'og du tshor ba rags pa sogs 'chad pa'i rim pa'i rgyu mtshan yid pa'i phyir ro// 'dus ma byas phung por mi 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/

'o na/ 'dus ma byas chos can/ phung por ma bshad te/ spungs pa'i don du mi rung ba'i phyir ro// phung khams skye mched kyi go rim rnam dag nges tshul ni/ phung po ni gzugs sogs lngar go (23) rim nges te/ khyed snga ma rnams rags pa'i rim pa dang*/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rim pa dang*/ snod sogs kyi don gyi rim pa dang*/ khams ji bzhin gyi rim par nges pa'i phyir ro// de yang gzugs thogs bcas yin pas thams cad pas rags shing*/ ming bzhi'i nang nas tshor ba rgyu ba rags pa sogs snga ma snga ma ches rags pa dang*/ yang na 'khor ba thog med nas pho mo dag phan tshun gzugs la dga' zhing de'ang tshor ba'i ro myang ba las dang*/ de la chags pa yang 'du shes log pa las dang*/ de yang nyon mongs kyis te/ de rnams kyi sems kun nas nyon mongs can du byas pa'i rim pas so// yang na gzugs sogs lnga rim pa ltar/ snod dang*/ zas dang*/ bya na dang*/ byan po dang*/ za ba po lta bu'i don gyis so// yang gzugs 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi 'dod khams dang*/ tshor bas bsam gtan rnams dang*/ 'du shes kyis gzugs med dang po gsum dang*/ (24) thams cad las de'i sems pa 'bras bu che bas 'du byed tsam gyis srid rtse rab tu phye zhing de bzhi ni rnam shes la gnas pa yin la/ rnam shes ni de dag gi gnas so// des na rang 'grel de dag las rnam shes gnas so// zhes pa ni ma dag go /phung po lnga'i rim pa nges pa 'dis grangs nges kyang grub bo// dbang po ni mig sogs drug tu go rim nges te/ da ltar gyi don sogs ni rim par nges pa'i phyir ro// de yang dbang po drug gi go rim gyis grub pa'i dbang gis yul dang rnam shes kyi go rim kyang 'grub pas/ dbang po'i go rim ni/ da lta'i don yul du byed pa'i phyir/ dang po mig sogs lnga smos la yid ni dus gsum dang*/ dus ma yin pa'i yang yul can yin pas phyis smos so// dang po lnga las kyang 'byung ba yin pas gyur pa'i don yul du byed pa'i phyir/

mig sna/ rna ba/ lce dang bzhi dang por smos la/ lus ni 'byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur gyi yang yul can yin pas phyis smos so// de bzhi las kyang gzhan (25) mig sna gnyis ches ring ba la 'jug pas sngar smos la de gnyis las mig ni ches ring ba la 'jug pas sngar smos te/ chu klung rgyang ring po nas mthong yang de'i sgra mi thos pa'i phyir zhes te/ phal che ba'i dbang du byas pa'o// sna lce gnyis las sna myur bar 'jug pa'i phyir sngar smos te/ zas lce dang ma phrad par dri tshor bas so// yang na lus 'di la rten ji ltar gnas pa'i rim pa bzhin te/ mig gi rten dang po na/ de'i 'og na rna ba'i/ de'i 'og na sna'i/ de'i 'og na lce'i/ lus kyi rten ni phal cher de'i 'og na'o// yid ni de rnams la rten pa dang*/ yul ni mi gnas pas phyis bstan no// gzugs dang chos kyi skye mched bye brag la bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'o na mig sogs bcu char gzugs yin yang mig gi yul kho na la gzugs zhes dang*/ kun chos yin yang tha ma kho na chos zhes brjod pa ci zhe na/ mig gi gzung don gcig pu ni gzugs zhes byas te/ gzhan la ming so sor btags pas bye brag gi don dang bstan du yod cing thogs pa (26) dang bcas pas khyod gzugs kyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir ro// skye mched tha ma gcig pu ni/ chos kyi skye mched zhes bya ste/ chos gzhan la ming so sor brtags pas bye brag gi don dang*/ chos kyi tshor ba sogs chos mang po dang*/ chos kyi mchog mya ngan las 'das pa yang bsdus pa yin pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa chos gsum po der kun 'dus par bstan pa la gsum ste/ chos kyi phung po bsdu ba dang*/ phung khams skye mched gzhan bsdu ba dang*/ zhar la khams gnyis kyi ngo bo dang po ni/ mdo las phung khams skye mched gzhan yang gsungs pa de rnams 'di las tha dad dam zhe na/ 'di rnams nyid kyis bsdus te/ re shig chos kyi phung po brgyad khri gang rnam thub pas gsungs pa de rnams ni mngon pa'i mdo sde pa ltar na/

gzugs phung gis bsdus te/ de ltar na tshig gam ngag yin pas so// de ni bye brag smra ba ltar na 'du byed kyi bsdus te/ de ltar na ming yin pa'i phyir ro// chos kyi phung po'i tshad ci tsam zhe na/ kha cig chos kyi phung po zhes pa'i bstan (27) 'chos kyi tshad sh+lau ka drug stong yod pa tsam re chos phung re'i tshad ces zer la/ gzhan na re phung po dang sogs pas khams skye mched rten 'byung ba bden pa la sogs pa'i gtam rdzogs pa re chos phung re'o zhes zer ro// rang lugs ni dug gsum dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ lta ba dang*/ the tshom sogs spyod pa brgyad khri'i gnyen por chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs pas spyod pa re re'i gnyen po rdzogs par ston pa'i gzhung gi tshogs chos phung re'o// gnyis pa ni/ chos phung brgyad khri phung po lngas bsdus pa de bzhin du mdo las gzhan yang ji rigs par phung po dang*/ skye mched dang*/ khams kyi ming can 'byung ba rnams rang rang gi mtshan nyid legs par spyad de ji skad bshad pa'i phung po lnga dang*/ skye mched bcu gnyis dang*/ khams bco brgyad por bsdu bar byas te/ phung po'i ming can tshul khrims dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab dang*/ rnam par grol ba dang*/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes (28) mthong ba'i phung po rnams las dang po lus ngag gi las yin pas gzugs phung dang lhag ma sems 'byung yin pas 'du byed phung pos bsdus pa sogs dang*/ zad par gyi skye mched dang brgyad po ma chags pa yin pas/ chos kyi skye mched dang*/ phyi ma gnyis gzugs med kyi skye mched bzhi ni/ sems dang sems byung gi ngo bo yin pas yid dang chos kyi skye mched kyis bsdus pa sogs dang*/ 'dod pa dang*/ gnod sems dang*/ rnam 'tshe'i khams ni/ sems byung yin pas/ chos khams kyis bsdus pa sogs so// gsum pa ni/ 'o na sa chu me rlung*/ nam mkha' rnam shes kyi khams drug gsungs pa la/

nam mkha' nyid nam mkha'i khams dang*/ rnam shes thams cad rnam shes kyi khams yin nam zhe na/ dang po bzhi bshad zin cing reg bya'i khams su 'dus pas ma bris so// skar khung dang kha sna sogs kyi bu kha ni nam mkha'i khams zhes bya'o// bu kha ci zhe na/ nyin bar snang ba dang*/ mtshan mo mun pa'i rang bzhin (29) yin pas gzugs kyi khams kyis bsdus so// lo ces pa mdo sde pa thogs bcas kyi gzugs med tsam gyis phye ba'i 'dus ma byas nam mkha'i khams yin pas chos kyi khams su 'dus par bstan pa'o// zag pa dang bcas pa'i rnam shes kho na ni 'dir rnam shes kyi khams yin no// ci'i phyir zag med ma yin zhe na/ khams drug gi nying 'tshams sbyor ba nas 'chi ba'i bar gyi sems bskyed pa yin la/ zag med de lta ma yin pa'o// bzhi pa khams kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye bsdu ba la bdun las/ dang po gnyis tshan ni/ khams bco brgyad las bstan yod du bstan med du zhe na 'di ni 'di na'o// pha gi na'o// zhes bstan du yod pa'i khams ni gzugs gcig pu ste/ bstan yod kyi mtshan nyid mig gi bzung don yin la/ lhag ma bcu bdun bstan med do// thogs bcas du/ thogs med du zhe na/ thogs bcas kyi mtshan nyid/ rang gi go sar gzugs gzhan 'byung ba'i gegs su gyur pa'i thogs pa dang bcas pa ni/ gzugs (30) can bcu nyid yin te sems kyi khams bdun dang*/ chos kyi khams ni rdul phran bsags pa min pas thogs med do// sbyang bya sgrib pa dang*/ yul dang dmigs pa thogs med gsum mo// gnyis pa gsum tshan ni/ dge ba du/ mi dge ba du/ lung ma bstan du zhe na/ dge mi dge'i ngor lung ma bstan nyid yin pa brgyad de/ gang zhe na/ thogs bcas bcu po de rnams nyid las gzugs sgra gnyis ma rtogs pa'o// brgyad las gzhan khams bcu rnams dge mi dge lung ma stan rnams pa gsum yod do// 'dod par rtogs pa du/ gzugs dang gzugs med par rtogs pa du zhe na/

'dod khams su rtogs pa khams ji rigs pa khams bco brgyad po thams cad yin la/ gzugs kyi khams na khams bcu bzhi ste/ khams zas la 'dod chags dang bral bas dri/ ro med la/ dmigs rkyen de gnyis med pas sna dang lce'i rnam shes kyi khams ma rtogs so// des na bsdu bar gzugs khams pa'i sna lce ni rtag tu skye mched ma yin par gsungs so// (31) slob dpon dbyig gnyen ni/ sna lce'i dbang rten nyid las dbang po med par bzhed la/ 'phags pa thogs med dang*/ bye brag du smra ba ni/ rten mdzes pa dang*/ tshig brjod pa dang*/ sred pa'i dbang gis sna lce'i dbang po yod par 'chad do// gzugs med khams na gzugs can gyi khams bcu dang*/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes med pas/ der rtogs pa'i yid dang*/ chos dang*/ yid kyi rnam shes kyi khams gsum mo// gsum pa bcas ma bcas kyi rab dbye ni/ zag bcas du zag med du zhe na/ khams tha ma de gsum la zag bcas dang zag med gnyis ka yod la/ lhag ma dang po bco lnga ni/ gcig du zag bcas pa'o// yang rtog spyod gnyis ka dang bcas pa ni/ rtog pa med la spyod pa tsam dag ni du/ rtog spyod gnyis ka med pa ni du/ rtog spyod dang bcas pa ste/ mtshungs par ldan pa ni rnam par shes pa'i khams dang po lnga ste/ kha phyir ltas pas so// tha ma yid/ chos/ yid shes gsum ni/ gnyis ga gnyis ga med pa/ spyod pa

(32) tsam ste/ rnam pa gsum mo// lhag ma gzugs can bcu po rnams ni/ rtog spyod gnyis ga spangs pa ste/ mtshungs par mi ldan no// 'o na rnam shes khams lnga ci ltar rtog med ces bya zhe na/ rtog pa gsum las ngo bo nyid kyi rtog pa yod kyi/ nges par rtog pa dang*/ rjes su dran pa'i rtog pa ni med pas rnam par mi rtog ste/ rta rkang gcig pa la rkang med pa ces pa bzhin no// rtog pa tha ma de dag gi ngo bo gang zhe na/ de dag ni yid kyi rnam shes dang mtshungs ldan gyi shes rab mnyam par ma bzhag pas/ g.yengs pa ni des rtog byed do// yid kyi dran pa mnyam par bzhag ma bzhag thams cad ni rjes dran nyid do// yang dmigs bcas du dmigs med du zhe na/ dmigs bcas ni/ sems kyi khams bdun dang chos khams kyi phyed sems byung rnams kyang ngo*// gzugs can bcu dang*/ chos khams kyi ldan mi ldan dang*/ 'das ma 'das ni dmigs pa med pa'o// bzhi pa gzugs can gyi dbye ba ni/ zin pa du ma zin pa du zhe na/ ma zin pa'i (33) mtshan nyid rnam shes dang lhan cig ma yin pa de yang dgu ste/ dmigs bcas brgyad po de rnams dang sgra'o// de las gzhan gzugs can dgu po ni zin ma zin rnam pa gnyis te/ dbang po lnga'i 'das ma 'ongs dang*/ da lta'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yang dbang po dang mi ldan pa ma zin pa dang da lta'i dbang po dang*/ de'i tshogs pa na yod pa'i gzugs dri sogs bzhi zin pa ste/ zin pa'i mtshan nyid rnam shes dang lhan cig pa'o// 'byung ba du 'byung 'gyur du zhe na/ reg bya'i khams ni 'byung ba dang*/ 'byung 'gyur gnyis ka yin te/ lhag ma gzugs can gyi khams dgu po ni 'byung 'gyur kho na dang*/ der ma zad chos khams phyogs gcig rig byed min pa'i gzugs kyang 'byung gyur nyid de/ sems kyi khams bdun dang*/ chos kyi phal che gnyis ga ma yin pa'o// bsags pa du zhe na/ gzugs can gyi khams bcu ni/

rdul phra rab 'dus pas bsags pa ste/ lhag ma brgyad ni bsags pa ma yin pa'o// 'o na (34) gcod byed gcad bya sogs gang zhe na/ gcod byed dgra lta bu dang*/ gcad bya shing rta lta bu nyid ni/ phyi rol gyi khams gzugs dri ro reg bya kho na yin no// gcod byed gcad bya bzhi yin pa de bzhin du/ sreg bya bung shing lta bu dang*/ 'jal byed srang lta bu yang*/ khams de bzhi'o// sreg byed dang gzhal bya la ni mi mthun pa smra ste/ kha cig khams de bzhi nyid de dag du smra la/ kha cig rgyu'i reg bya me nyid dang*/ 'bras bu'i reg bya lci ba nyid rim pa bzhin du de dag du smra'o// gzhan dbang po lnga ni dwangs cing sgra la rgyun med la/ khams thogs med brgyad rdul phran bsags pa ma yin pas gcod byed sogs min no// lnga pa byung ba gsum ni/ rnam smin skyes du/ rgyu mthun las 'byung ba du zhe na/ bar gyi tshig phyis pa rnam smin gyi rgyu las skyes pa'am/ 'bras bu dus su smin pa'i las ni rnam smin te/ de las skyes pa'am/ rgyu dge mi dge la 'bras bu ming gi rtags te/ rnam smin zhes bya la/ de las skyes pas rnam smin (35) skyes de dang*/ zas dang skum mnye sogs legs par bya ba dang*/ gnyid dang ting nge 'dzin te/ rgyas pa'i rgyu bzhi las byung ba mig sogs nang gi khams lnga'o// gong ma sa legs par bya ba'i don tshangs spyod du bzhed la/ des mi gnod pa tsam la sangs rgyas par mi bzhed do// de lta 'byung ba de gnyis su 'dus pa'i rgyu mthun yod kyang*/ de gnyis las gzhan pa'i rgyu mthun med de/ shi ba la mig sogs rjes su mi 'jug pas so// des na rgyu mthun las byung bar ma bshad do// sgra ni rgyas pa dang rgyu mthun las byung gi rnam smin las skyes pa ma yin te/ 'dod dgur 'byung bas so// gdags par tshig rtsub spangs pas tshangs pa'i dbyangs grub par gsungs pa ni/

rnam smin las rgyud de byung ba la dgongs pa ste/ rnam smin dngos ni/ mgrin par 'byung ba khyad par can 'grub pa'o// rgyu mthun du byung yang sgra nyid ni med de/ rgyun med pas so// des na skal mnyam dang*/ kun 'gro'i rgyu ci (36) rigs las skyes pa tsam la bya'o// bskal mnyam dang kun 'gro'i rgyu mthun las byung ba dang*/ rnam smin gyi rgyu las skyes pa ni thogs pa med pa brgyad do// rgyas byung ni med de/ thogs pa med pa la rkyal stong bus pa bzhin du rgyas pa med pas so// gzhan gzugs dri ro reg bya la/ byung ba rnam pa gsum car yod de/ rnam smin skyes ni zin pa'i cha dang*/ byung ba gzhan gnyis ni ma zin pa'i cha la yang yod do// rtag pa'i rdzas dang ldan pa chos khams kyi phyogs gcig 'dus ma byas dang*/ 'dus byas las kyang khams tha ma gsum sdug bsngal la chos bzod kyi dus mtha'i skad cig ma gcig ni byung ba gsum car ma yin te/ zag med skad cig dang po ni/ skal mnyam kun 'gro'i rgyu mthun dang rnam smin gyi rgyu las ma byung zhing*/ bsags pa ma yin pas rgyas byung yang ma yin pa ste/ thogs pa med brgyad ces sogs kyi dmigs gsal lo// yang na rdzas dang ldan pa du/ skad cig ma du zhe na/ 'dus ma byas ni rtag pa'i rdzas te/ (37) de ldan pa chos khams gcig pu ste/ gzhan byed dang bco brgyad ni de 'dra'i rdzas dang ldan pa ma yin pa'o// 'di ni rdzas yod bzhi las rten pa'i rdzas kyi dbang du byas pa'o// khams tha ma gsum gyi cha zag med dang po sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi skad cig ma gcig rgyu mthun las ma byung ba'i phyir/ sngar med kyi skad cig ma ste/ 'dus byas gzhan ni rgyu mthun las ma byung ba 'ga' yang med pas de 'dra'i skad cig min pa'o// drug pa thob pa'i khyad par ni/ gang mig gi khams dang sngar mi ldan pa las thob pa de mig shes dang yang yin nam zhe na/

mig dang mig gi rnam shes kyi khams dag so so ste/ mig gsar du thob la/ mig shes ma thob pa dang*/ mig shes gsar du thob la mig ma thob pa dang*/ lhan cig te dus mnyam du thob pa dang yang gi sgras gnyis ga ma thob pa yang yod ces mu bzhi ste/ mu dang po ni/ gzugs med nas bsam gtan gnyis pa yan gyi bar srid du skyes pa na mig gsar du thob cing*/ (38) mig shes rags pa dag nas/ med pas ma thob pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan gnyis pa yan gyi gzugs kyi lhas 'og sa'i mig shes mngon du byas pa na mig shes rang sa na med pa mngon du byas pas gsar du thob la/ mig ni rang sa na sngar du yod pas gsar du mi thob pa lta bu'o/ mu gsum pa ni gzugs med nas 'dod pa'am/ bsam gtan dang po'i bar srid du skyes pa na gnyis ka gsar du thob pa lta bu'o// bzhi pa ni gzugs med nas de nyid du skyes pa na mig dang mig shes gnyis ka sngar yang med la gsar du mi thob pa lta bu'o// bdun pa phyi nang sogs kyi dbye ba la yang bdun las/ dang po ni/ nang gi khams ni du/ phyi'i khams ni du zhe na/ nang gi khams ni bcu gnyis te/ gzugs sogs yul drug ma rtogs pa'o// de drug ni phyi'i khams so// des nang gi khams kyi mtshan nyid 'dzin par rtogs pa/ phyi'i khams kyi mtshan nyid gzung ba kho nar gyur pa'o// gnyis pa yang rten bcas du/ de mtshungs du zhe na/ chos kyi khams zhes pa ni gcig tu rten bcas ste/ 'phags pa thams cad chos thams cad bdag med do mnyam du nges par yid (39) la byed pas so// khams lhag ma bcu bdun ni// de mtshungs dang*/ rkyang gis rten bcas ste/ gnyis ka yin no// de mtshungs kyi mtshan nyid khams gang zhig rang gi las mi byed pa/ rten bcas kyi mtshan nyid khams gang zhig rang gi las byed pa'o// de la nang gi khams drug gi las ni/ yul gyi yul can dang*/ rnam shes kyi rten byed pa dang*/

yul gyi khams drug gi las ni/ dbang po'i yul dang*/ rnam shes kyi yul dang*/ dmigs pa byed pa dang*/ rnam shes kyi khams drug gi las ni/ dbang po'i rten pa dang*/ yul gyi yul can byed pa yin pas/ las de dag byed mi byed ni/ rten bcas dang de mtshungs yin la/ sems kyi khams bdun ni/ skye 'gyur rten bcas dang*/ mi skye ba'i chos de mtshungs so// gsum pa yang*/ mthong spangs du/ sgom spangs du/ spang bya ma yin pa du zhe na/ gzugs can bcu ni/ sgom pas spang bya yin zhing*/ der ma zad (40) rnam shes kyi khams dang po lnga yang yin no// khams tha ma gsum gyi rigs la/ mthong spang sgom spang spang bya min pa rnam pa gsum ka yod do// gnas ma bu pa dag so so skye bo dang ngan song du skye ba'i rgyu lus ngag gi las kyang mthong spang yin te/ mthong lam skyes pa na de dag 'gags pas so// zhes zer ro// 'dir so skye ni mthong spang min te/ nyon mongs can min pa ni mthong spang min la/ so skye ni nyon mongs can min pa'i lung ma bstan yin pa'i phyir te/ dge rtsa chad pa dang*/ chags bral gong ma la'ang*/ so skye dang ldan pas so// ngan song gi lus ngag gi las kyang mthong spang min te/ gzugs ni nyon mongs can yin yang mthong spang min la/ ngan song gi lus ngag gi las ni gzugs yin pas so// drug pa yid kyi skye mched min pa sgo lnga'i shes pa las skyes pa ni thogs gzugs min cing*/ nyon mongs can yin yang sgo lnga las skyes pa'i dbang shes ni mthong (41) spang min te/ bden pa la log par mi rtog pas so// 'on kyang mthong lam skyes pa na log pa ni rkyen ma tshang ba rtags min thob pa'o// bzhi pa lta ba dang lta min sogs bshad pa ni yang lta ba du/ lta ba ma yin pa du zhe na/ mig gi khams dang*/ chos kyi khams kyi phyogs gcig ni lta ba yin te/ chos khams lta ba de yang 'jig lta sogs lnga dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i dang*/

slob pa'i dang*/ mi slob pa'i yang dag pa'i lta bas te rnam pa brgyad do// lhag ma khams phyed dang bcu bdun ni lta ba min pa'o// ci'i phyir/ yid shes dang mtshungs ldan kho na 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba zhes bya zhe na/ rnam shes sgo lnga dang mtshungs pa ste/ lhan cig par skye ba'i blo ste/ shes rab ni des rtog ste/ nges par sems pa la zhugs pa med pa'i phyir/ lta ba ma yin no// 'o na rtog pa med pas ci ltar mig kyang lta ba yin zhe na/ mig ni gzugs la lta (42) ba yin te/ gzugs mthong ba'i phyir ro// mig thams cad kyis sam zhe na min gyi rnam shes rten pa dang bcas pa'o// 'o na mig la rten pa'i rnam shes kho nas mthong bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ mig de la rten pa'i rnam shes kyi mthong zhes nges par nus pa min te/ gang gi phyir zhe na/ rtsig pa la sogs pas bar du chod pa'i gzugs mthong ba min pa'i phyir te/ rnam par shes pas mthong na de thogs med yin pas gzugs/ sgrib pa yang mthong bar 'gyur ro lo ces pa mdo sde pa mig shes kho nas mthong bar 'dod pa 'thad par ston pa'o// ci mig gcig gi gzugs mthong ngam/ 'on te gnyis kas mthong zhe na/ mig gnyis ka dag gi kyang mthong ste/ gnyis ka phye na gsal bar mthong ba'i phyir ro// dper na khang pa gcig du mar me gnyis byas na/ 'od rgyas pa gcig gi shin tu gsal ba bzhin no// kyang gi gcig gis kyang mthong bar bstan no// dbang po drug yul dang (43) phrad pa zhig gam/ 'od de ma phrad pa 'dzin ce na/ mig dang*/ yid dang*/ rna ba gsum ni/ yul dang ma phrad par 'dzin la/ kha cig rna bas phrad nas kyang 'dzin ces so// sna lce lus gsum ni ma phrad pa las gzhan yul dang phrad nas 'dzin to// ci dbang po drug yul mnyam pa'am/ 'on te mi mnyam pa zhig 'dzin ce na/ sna tshogs de gsum gyis ni dbang po'i sdug bsngal bran ji snyed kyi yul sdug bsngal dang phrad nas yul mnyam 'dzin par 'dod la/

mig sna gnyis ni yul mnyam mi mnyam ma nges cing*/ yid ni lus can min pas ma spyad do// de la dbang po lnga ni/ rdul phra rab 'dus pa'i ngo bo ste/ mig gi dbang po ni/ mig 'bras la go snyod kyi me tog ltar ma 'dres par gnas pa rgun 'brum tsam shin du dwangs pa'i lpags pas bkab pas mi 'gyes pa'o// kha cig ni dbang rten ltar gor bur gnas ste/ shel ltar dwang bas phan tshun mi sgrib bo// zhes zer ro// rna ba'i dbang po ni/ dbang rten (44) rna 'brug ces bya ba gro ga bcus pa lta bu'i nang na gnas so// sna'i dbang po ni sna'i rgyud kyi nang na gnas so// lce'i dbang po zla ba phyed pa lta bu ste/ lce'i dbang po'i dbus na skra'i rtse mo tsam zhig lce'i dbang po'i rdul phran gyi ma khebs so// zhes grag go /lus kyi dbang po'i rdul phran rnams ni rkang mthil nas spyi bo'i bar du lus bzhin du gnas so// de'i bye brag mo'i dbang po ni lnga'i sbubs lta bu dang*/ pho'i dbang po ni mthe'o lta bu gnas ces te/ bye brag tu smra ba ltar na skor ba bar dang bcas pa dang*/ mdo sde pa ltar na bar med la ma 'byar ba'o// ci rnam shes tshogs drug gi nang nas dang po lnga'i yul da ltar yin la/ tha ma'i dus gsum pa yin pa ltar/ rten kyang de lta bu yin nam zhe na/ ma yin te/ tha ma yid shes kyi rten 'gags ma thag pa'i yid nyid yin pas 'das pa kho na dang*/ gzhan sgo lnga rnams kyi rten ni/ lnga po de rnams dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i mig sogs re dang*/ 'ang gi 'das pa'i yid de/ bdag (45) rkyen gnyis gnyis so// gong ma pa ni/ yid shes kyi'ang lhan cig 'byung ba'i gnas nyon yid du bzhed pas/ de la'ang bdag rkyen gnyis so// 'o na dbang yul gnyis ka la rag las pa la mig sogs kho na la rten zhes bya'i/ gzugs sogs ni min zhe na/ mig sogs de rnams gsal mi gsal du 'gyur bas mig shes sogs gsal mi gsal du 'gyur ba'i phyir/

rten ni mig sogs yin gyi/ gzugs sogs ni de lta min pas rten du ma bshad do// gzugs sogs kyang shes na mig shes ces sogs dbang po'i sgo nas brjod kyi/ gzugs shes ces so// yul gyi sgo nas/ ma brjod pa ci zhe na/ rten min pa de'i phyir dang*/ gzugs ni yid dang*/ gang zag gzhan gyi mig shes kyi yul du 'gyur la/ mig ni de lta min pa sogs dbang po rnams rnam shes kyi thun mong min pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ yang mig sogs de rnams kyis ni rnam shes bstan gyi gzugs sogs yul gyis ni ma bstan te/ rnga'i sgra dang*/ nas kyi (46) myu gu bzhin no// lus dbang yul shes pa'i sa mtshungs dpyad pa ni/ lus gang la gnas te/ mig gi gzugs rnams lta ba na/ ci lus dang*/ mig dang*/ gzugs dang rnam shes de rnams/ sa gcig nyid yin nam/ gzhan gyi sa'ang yin zhe na/ ci rigs su yin te/ lus dang mig dang*/ gzugs pa lnga dang*/ mig shes pa gnyis yin la/ nges pa ni lus ces pa phung po lnga dang*/ gzugs phung dang*/ dbang po gzugs can dang*/ lus dbang dang*/ rten khog pa sogs du ma la 'jug pa las 'dir ni phyi ma yin pas rten la gong ma'i lus chos can/ khyod la 'og ma'i mig skyed pa min te/ mig skyed pa ni gzugs la lta ba yin la/ khyod rang na mig mchog yod pas ltas pas chog pas/ 'og ma'i mig dman pa skyed pa la dgos pa med pas so// rang sa'i lus la rang sa'i mig dang*/ 'og ma'i lus la gong ma'i mig skyed pa ni yod ces shugs la bstan te/ 'dod pa'i lus la 'dod pa dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i mig skyed pa lta bu'o//

(47) rten pa 'og ma'i mig gi sa gong ma'i gzugs mthong bar nus pa min te/ 'og ma'i mig sman cing*/ gong ma'i gzugs mchog yin pas so// rang sa'i mig gi rang sa'i gzugs dang*/ gong ma'i mig gi 'og ma'i gzugs mthong ba ni shugs la bstan te/ 'dod pa dang bsam gtan bzhi'i mig gis 'dod pa'i gzugs mthong ba lta bu'o// gong sa'i rnam par shes pa'ang*/ 'og sa'i mig la rten pa min te/ rten dman pa rten pa mchog gi rten du mi rung bas so// rang sa'i mig shes dang sa'i mig dang*/ 'og ma'i mig shes gong ma'i mig la rten par ni shugs la bstan te/ bsam gtan dang po'i mig shes ni/ bsam gtan dang po dang*/ bsam gtan gong ma gsum gyi mig la rten pa lta bu'o// rnam shes 'di'i yul gzugs ni/ gong 'og rang sa thams cad de/ bsam gtan dang po'i mig shes kyi yul 'dod pa dang*/ dang po dang*/ gnyis pa sogs kyi gzugs yin pa lta bu'o// 'og mas gong ma'i gzugs mi mthong bar bshad pa dang ni mi 'gal te/ dang po'i (48) mig shes dman yang gnyis pa sogs kyi mig mchog la rten pa'i phyir te/ phal pas kyang rgyal po sogs la rten na bya ba stobs can 'grub pa bzhin no// lus rten khog pa'i gzugs dang*/ rnam shes gnyis ka gong 'og rang sa thams cad kyis kyang ste/ dang po dang ni bsam gtan dang po'i lus ni 'dod pa dang*/ dang po dang gnyis pa sogs kyi gzugs mthong ba'i rten du rung ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni 'dod pa'i lus ni rang sa 'dod pa dang*/ gong sa bsam gtan dang po'i rnam shes kyi rten dang*/ gnyis pa sogs kyi lus ni 'og sa dang po'i rnam shes kyi rten du rung ba lta bu'o// rna ba'ang mig ji ltar bshad pa de bzhin te/ lus la 'og ma'i rna ba min zhes sogs sbyar ro// gsum pa ni sna lce lus gsum rnams ni rten dbang yul shes bzhi po thams cad rang gi sa pa nyid do// 'on kyang lus kyi rnam shes ni bsam gtan gnyis pa sogs gsum gyi 'og sa lta bu dang*/

'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po lta bu rang gi sa pa'o// yid ni ma nges te/ sna tshogs su (49) 'jug pas so// khams gang*/ lnga pa rnam shes gang gis shes par bya ba yin zhe na/ rang rang gi dbang shes dang*/ yid shes gnyis kyis rnam par shes par bya ba ni/ phyi'i gzugs sogs lnga ste/ khams lhag ma bcu gsum ni yid shes gcig pu'i shes bya'o// yang khams bco brgyad las drug pa rtag pa du/ mi rtag pa du zhe na/ chos khams kyi phyogs gcig 'dus ma byas gsum ni rtag pa ste/ khams lhag ma bcwo brgyad ni mi rtag pa'o// sngar ni rtag rdzas dang*/ 'dir ni rtag pa tsam gyi dbang du byas pas mi zlos so// bdun pa dbang po du/ dbang po min pa du zhe na/ chos khams kyi phyed srog dang tshor ba lnga dang*/ dad sogs lnga dang*/ kun shes byed sogs gsum gyi cha rnams dang*/ khams gang rnams nang gir bshad pa bcu gnyis po de rnams ni dbang po te gzugs sogs phyi'i khams lnga dang*/ chos khams kyi phyed ni dbang po min la/ 'dir dbang po smos pa ni/ 'og nas rgyas par 'chad pas 'grel lo// khams (50) bstan pas chos thams cad bsdus pa'i phyir/ phung po dang skye mched bsdus par 'gyur te/ des na gtso bor khams rgyas par bstan pas khams bstan pa zhes bya'o// chos mngon pa mdzod las/ khams bstan pa zhes bya ba gnas dang po'i 'grel pa'o// gnyis pa dbang po bstan pa la gsum te/ dbang po'i rang bzhin dang*/ 'dus byas kyi skye tshul dang*/ skye mched rgyu rkyen 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ dbang po ngos bzung ba dang*/ de gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ so so'i ngo bo dang*/ grangs nges dang*/ dbang po brgyad bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ bye brag du smra ba'i dang*/ mdo sde pa'i lugs so// dang po ni khams bstan pa'i mthar dbang po zhes smos pa de rgyas par 'chad de/ dbang po'i don ci zhe na/

dbang ni dbang phyug dam pa la'o// ces pa dbang byed pa'i don to// gang zhig gang la dbang byed na/ mig sogs lnga po rnams ni don bzhi bzhi la dbang byed de/ rten mdzes pa dang*/ lus (51) srung ba dang*/ rang gi rnam shes mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa skyed pa dang*/ rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu la dbang byed pa'i phyir ro// pho mo srog yid bzhi rnams don gnyis gnyis la dbang byed de/ pho'o// mo'o// zhes sems can gyi bye brag dang*/ nu ma sogs dbyibs dang*/ nga ro dang spyod pa'i khyad chos te sems can gyi khyad par gnyis dang*/ bar srid du nying mtshams sbyor ba dang*/ sbyar nas ris mthun gnas pa gnyis dang*/ yang srid par nying mtshams sbyor ba dang*/ lus ngag gi las sogs yid kyi rjes su mthun par 'jug pas dbang gi ngo bo dang mthun par byed pa ste gnyis so// lo ces pa mdo sde pa mig nas srog gi bar dbang po bdun ni ji skad bshad pa'i don phyi ma rnam nyid las/ gzhan rnams la dbang byed pa mi rigs par ston pa'o// bde sogs lnga ni kun nas nyon mongs la dbang byed de/ bde ba dag las 'dod chags dang*/ sdug bsngal dag las zhe sdang dang*/ gtang snyoms las gti mug rgyas par gsungs so// dad sogs lnga dang (52) tha ma gsum ste/ brgyad po de na rnam byang la dbang byed do// gzhan dag bde sogs kyang rnam byang la dbang byed ces zer ro// gnyis pa ni mig sogs lnga dang yid chos can/ nang gi dbang po drug zhes byas te/ gzugs sogs rang rang gi don la dmigs pa dang*/ don thams cad la dmigs par dbang byed pa'i phyir ro// lhag par dbang byed pa ni dbang po yin la/ phyi don ni dbang po min no// pho mo'i mtshan ma ni/ lus kyi dbang po las rdzas tha dad med kyang*/ dbang po zhes gzhag ste/ pho nyid zhes pa rang bzhin nga ro gsang mtho ba dang*/ g.yo ba dang*/ mo la sems pa'i sems pa dang*/ mo nyid de/

de las zlog pa'i nga ro dang*/ g.yo ba dang bsam pa la dbang byed pa'i phyir ro// srog dang*/ tshor ba rnams dang*/ dad sogs ni dbang por 'dod de/ khyod rim pa ltar sems can ris mthun par gnas pa dang*/ sngar kun nas nyon mongs dang*/ nyon mongs kyi mgo gnon cing*/ lam 'dren pas rnam byang la dbang byed pa'i phyir ro// kun (53) shes par byed pa dang*/ kun shes dang*/ kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po rnams ni rim bzhin dbang por bzhag ste/ khyod dang po gnyis kyis rang rang gi gong ma gong ma thob pa dang*/ phyi mas myang 'das dang*/ sogs pas rim pas mthong spangs dang*/ sgom spang spong ba dang*/ mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa la dbang byed pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la grangs nges ni gal te/ dbang byed pas dbang po yin na/ ma rig pa sogs 'du byed sogs dang*/ ngag lag pa/ rkang pa/ rkub 'doms rnams kyang smra ba/ len pa 'gro ba/ gshang ba/ 'dor ba/ kun du dga' ba'i bya ba rnams la dbang byed pas/ dbang po kha skang bar bya'o// zhe na mi bya ste/ bye brag tu smra ba ltar na/ mig sogs drug sems kyi rten te/ de drug sems can gyi rdzas kyi gzhi yin pas so// pho mo'i dbang pos rten de'i bye brag 'byed la/ srog gi de gnas par byed do// de dgu kun byang thun mong gi gzhi'o// tshor ba lngas kun nas nyon mongs pa (54) nyid du byed la/ dad sogs lngas rnam byang gi tshogs sog par byed cing*/ phyi ma gsum gyis rnam par byang bar byed pa ji snyed dbang po rnams kyang de snyed du grangs nges pa yin pas ma rig pa sogs dbang por mi 'dod do// mdo sde pa'i lugs 'chad pas/ yang na ces pa ste/ 'jug phyogs dang ldog phyogs kyi dbang du byas nas bshad pa'o// de la 'jug pa ste 'khor ba'i rten mig sogs drug dang*/ de skye bar byed pa pho mo'i dbang po dang*/ gnas par byed pa srog dang*/ nye bar spyod par byed pa tshor ba lnga ste/

'jug phyogs gzhan bzhi las dbang po bcu bzhi'o// 'jug pa'i de bzhin du ldog phyogs bzhi la brgyad de/ ldog pa ste mya 'das kyi rten dad sogs lnga dang*/ dang por zag med skye ba kun shes byed dang*/ rgyu gnas par byed pa kun shes pa dang*/ rnam grol gyi dga' bde la nye bar spyod par byed pa tha ma ste/ de las dbang po gzhan brgyad yin pas dbang po de snyed yin la/ de nyid kyi phyir go rim yang de dag go / (55) gsum pa ni dbang po gzhan bshad zin cing*/ 'chad par 'gyur bas 'dir brgyad kho na skabs su bab pas 'chad pa la gnyis te/ tshor ba lnga'i ngo bo dang*/ dri med gsum gyi ngo bo'o// dang po ni/ lus 'dir dbang po gzugs can te/ de la rten pa'i tshor ba sim pa ma yin pa gnod par byed pa gang yin pa de ni sdug bsngal gyi dbang po'o// lus tshor sim pa phan 'dogs pa ni bde ba'i dbang po'o// bsam gtan gsum pa na sems ni yid shes te de'i 'khor gyi tshor ba sim pa de ni bde ba'i dbang po ste dga' ba'i 'dod chags dang bral bas yid bde ba min la/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes med pas lus tshor ni med pas so// mdo sde pa ni de lus tshor dang*/ nyan par tshor ba dang*/ shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde bar bshad do// gsum pa las gzhan 'dod pa dang*/ dang po dang gnyis pa rnams na/ sems tshor sim pa de yid bde ba'i dbang po'o// sems kyi tshor ba sim pa ma yin pa gdung bar myong ba gang yin pa de yid mi bde ba'i dbang po'o// gtang snyoms kyi dbang po ni (56) sim gdung bar mar myong ba'o// lus sems gang gi bar ma zhe na/ gnyis ka'i bar ma'o// de dbang po gcig du byed pa gang zhe na/ mi rtog pa kho nar rang gis skye ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni dad sogs lnga bde ba yid/ yid bde btang snyoms te/ dbang po dgu ni lam gsum du rim pa ltar/ dbang po phyi ma gsum zhes bya ste/ mthong lam la bden bzhi mngon du mi shes pa kun shes par bya bar zhugs pas kun shes byed pa'i dbang po yin la/

sgom lam la bden bzhi mthong zin shes shing gom par byed pas kun shes pa'i dbang po'o// mi slob lam la bden pa kun shes pa'i zad mi skye shes pa ldan pas kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po zhes bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa de bstan la dbab pa la lnga ste/ rnam pa'i rab dbye dang*/ snyed tshul dang*/ gtong tshul dang*/ dge sbyong gi 'bras bu dbang po du yis thob pa dang*/ dbang po'i ldan tshul lo// dang po ni/ dbang po nyer gnyis las/ zag bcas du/ zag med du/ mi shes pa kun shes sogs tha ma gsum ni dri ma (57) zag pa med pa kho na dang dbang po gzugs can bdun dang*/ srog dang*/ sdug bsngal dang*/ yid mi bde dag ste/ bcu zag pa dang bcas pa kho na dang*/ dad sogs lnga bde ba yid/ yid bde btang snyoms te dgu la zag bcas zag med gnyis ka yod do// yang rnam smin du rnam smin min pa du zhe na/ srog ni gcig du rnam smin no// 'o na dgra bcom pa tshe'i 'du byed 'jog pa'i srog de/ gang gi rnam smin yin zhe na/ kha cig longs spyod cher smin pa'o zhes dang*/ gzhan yang skye ba snga ma'i tshe lhag yod pa drangs pas rnam smin du bzhed la/ slob dpon dang btsun pa dbyangs sgrog de ni ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus gnas pa yin pas srog de rnam smin min la/ srog gzhan ni rnam smin no zhes so// bcu gnyis la rnam smin yin min gnyis yod de/ bcu gnyis gang zhe na tha ma brgyad dge ba kho na dang*/ yid mi bde dge mi dge gang rung nyid du nges pa ma rtogs pa ste/ de yang gzugs can bdun la rgyas byung ni min cing lhag ma yin la/ (58) yid dang tshor ba la/ dge nyon sogs kyi cha min cing*/ rnam smin skyes pa'i cha yin pas so// yang rnam smin dang bcas pa du/ ma bcas pa du zhe na/ yid mi bde de gcig pu ni/ dge ba zag bcas sam/ mi dge ba kho nar nges pas rnam smin dang bcas pa ste/ kun rtog gis khyad par gyi skyed pas/

lung ma bstan med cing*/ mnyam bzhag min pas/ zag med kyang med pas so// bcu rnam smin dang bcas ma bcas gnyis ka te/ bcu gang zhe na/ yid dang tshor ba yid mi bde las gzhan bzhi dang*/ dad sogs lnga'o// lhag ma gzugs can bdun dang*/ srog ni/ lung ma bstan nyid dang*/ tha ma gsum ni zag med yin pas rnam smin dang ma bcas par grub bo// yang dge ba du mi dge ba du/ lung ma bstan du zhe na/ dge bar nges pa ni dad sogs lnga dang*/ tha ma gsum te brgyad do// yid mi bde ni/ dge mi dge rnam pa gnyis kho nar kha che bar 'dod la/ gzhan ni lung ma bstan yang yod par 'dod do// yid dang tshor (59) ba gzhan bzhi la ni dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum ka dang*/ gzhan mig sogs bdun dang*/ srog ni rnams pa gcig te/ lung ma bstan kho na'o// dbang po gang khams gang du rtogs zhe na/ dri med gsum ma rtogs pa bcu dgu ni 'dod khams su rtogs so// 'phrig pa'i 'dod chags dang bral zhing rten mi mdzes pa'i las spangs pas pho mo'i dbang po dang*/ lus dar zhing mi dge ba med pas rgyu mthun skyes dang*/ rnam smin skyes kyi sdug bsngal dang*/ rgyud zhi gnas kyi rlan cing*/ kun nas mnar sems kyi gzhi med pas yid mi bde ste/ dag ni gnyis tshig go /dri med dang de bzhi ma gtogs pa bco lnga ni gzugs khams su rtogs so// de rnams kyi steng du dbang po gzugs can lnga dang*/ bde ba dang yid bde ba ma rtogs pa srog yid btang snyoms dad sogs lnga ste brgyad gzugs med du rtogs so// yang mthong spang du/ sgom spang du/ spang bya min pa du zhe na/ yid dang tshor ba bde ba/ yid (60) bde stong snyoms gsum ni/ mthong spangs dang mtshungs ldan/ mthong spangs dang*/ de las gzhan pa'i zag bcas thams cad sgom spang dang*/ zag med dag spang bya min pa ste/ rnam pa gsum mo// mthong sgom gnyis kyi spang bya ni/ yid mi bde dang gzugs can bdun srog sdug bsngal te/

dgu ni sgom pas spang bya nyi dang*/ dad sogs lnga po ni zag med kyi cha spang bya min pa dang*/ yang gis zag bcas kyi kha sgom spang ngo*// tha ma gsum ni spang bya min pa kho na'o// gnyis pa rnyed tshul ni/ khams gang du/ dbang po rnam smin yin pa du rnyed ce na/ 'dod par rdzus skyes min pa'i skye gnas gsum gyi dang por rnam smin lus srog gnyis rnyed de/ de'i tshe yid dang*/ btang snyoms yod kyang rnam smin min no// de yang rdzus te skye bas rnyed pa min te/ rdzus skyes de'i skal ba dang po'i mi lta bu mtshan med kyis mig sogs lnga dang*/ srog ste drug gam/ mtshan ma cig pa lha sogs kyis bdun nam mtshan gnyis pas brgyad de/ (61) de ni ngan 'gro na yod do// gzugs khams na mig sogs lnga dang srog te drug go /gong ma gzugs med par srog cig tu rnyed do// gsum pa gtong tshul ni khams gang du 'chi ba na dbang po du gtong zhe na/ gzugs med du/ 'chi ba na srog yid dang btang snyoms nyid 'gag par 'gyur ro// gzugs khams na de gsum dang*/ mig sogs lnga ste brgyad 'gag la/ 'dod par cig char 'chi ba la/ mtshan nyid pa la de brgyad pho mo'i dbang po ste/ bcu'am mtshan gcig pa la dgu'am mtshan med na brgyad 'gag cing*/ rims kyis 'chi ba la ni lus srog yid btang snyoms te/ bzhi 'gag go /dge ba'i sems la gnas te 'chi na/ gnas skabs drug po thams cad du/ sngar gyi steng du dad sogs lnga yang 'gag pas mnan par bya'o// bzhi pa dge sbyong gi thob tshul ni/ dbang po'i skabs su dbang po'i chos thams cad spyad par bya ste/ dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'bras bu gang zhig dbang

(62) po dus 'thob ce na/ 'bras bu bzhi'i mthar yod pa rgyun zhugs dang*/ dgra bcom gnyis ni dbang po dgus 'thob ste/ dang po ni dad sogs lnga kun shes byed pa kun shes pa yid btang snyoms rnams dang*/ bzhi pa ni dad sogs lnga kun shes pa/ kun shes/ srung ba yid rnams dang*/ bde ba yid bde btang snyoms gsum las gang rung gcig gis so// bar pa phyir 'ong ba dang*/ phyir mi 'ong gnyis ni 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis thob na/ dad sogs lnga btang snyoms yid de/ bdun nam 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyis thob na/ de bdun dang kun shes pa ste brgyad dam phal cher la chags bral gyi phyir 'ong thob na/ dang po thob byed dgu dang*/ chags bral sngon 'gros phyir mi 'ong thob na/ gzhan de dang 'dra zhing*/ tshor ba bde ba yid bde btang snyoms gsum las gang rung gcig ste/ dgus thob bo// 'o na ye shes la 'jug par dgra bcom pa dbang po bcu gcig gi thob par bshad pa dang*/ ci ltar mi 'gal zhe na/ dbang po (63) bcu gcig rnams kyis dgra bcom thob par bshad pa ni/ gang zag 'ga' zhig la/ bde sogs gsum gyi rim gyis thob pa srid pa'i phyir bshad pa yin te/ dbang rtul 'ga' btang snyoms kyi dgra bcom thob pa las nyams te/ bsam gtan dang po gnyis las dgra bcom thob na yid bde dang de las kyang nyams te/ gsum las thob na bde bas thob kyi bde sogs gsum dus gcig mi srid de/ sems dang sems byung rnams rdzas mtshungs pas so// lnga pa dbang po'i ldan tshul ni/ dbang po gang dang*/ nges par dbang po du ldan spyad par bya ste/ btang snyoms dang srog dang yid de/ gsum las gang rung dang ldan pa la nges par de gsum ldan no// lhag ma rnams ni/ ldan mi ldan ma nges so// bde ba dang lus dbang dag re re dang ldan pa la nges gsum dang rang rang ste bzhi dang ldan no// mig dang sogs pas/ rna ba sna lce bzhi po re re dang ldan pa la de gsum dang khyab byed lus dang rang rang ste lnga dang ldan no//

(64) yid bde dang ldan pa yang*/ de gsum dang khyab byed bde ba dang*/ rang nyid de lnga dang ldan no// sdug bsngal dang ldan pa ni/ lus srog yid tshor ba bzhi ste/ bdun dang ldan no// yid mi bde ni 'dod pa'i rten can chags bral la mi ldan pas ma smos cing*/ sdug bsngal ni khams gong du skyes pa la med kyi 'di la med pa min no// mo'i dbang po dang sogs pas gzhan gyis ldan pa bshad zin 'chad pas/ pho dbang dang yid mi bde dang*/ dad sogs lnga ste/ de re re dang ldan pa la brgyad dang ldan te/ dang po gsum la snga ma bdun dang rang rang dang*/ dad sogs lnga ldan pa la de lnga dang nges gsum mo// kun shes dang*/ kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po re re dang ldan pa la nges gsum bde ba yid bde dang sogs lnga rang rang ste/ bcu gcig nges par ldan no// kun shes byed pa'i dbang po ldan pa la lus srog yid tshor ba bzhi dad sogs lnga rang nyid de bcu gsum rnams dang ldan pa yin no// gang dbang po'i nang na nyung ldan de du (65) dang ldan zhe na/ dge rtsa med de 'chad cing nang na dbang po nyung ba dang ldan pa na lus dang tshor ba lnga dang*/ srog dang yid de/ brgya dang ldan no// gzugs med kyi byis pa'ang*/ grangs de bzhin du brgyad dang ldan te/ brgyad gang zhe na/ btang snyoms dang*/ srog dang*/ yid dang*/ dge ba dang sogs lnga rnams dang ngo*// byis pa ni shed ma bye ba ste/ brda dang glang dor gyis dmigs dang*/ spang gnyen la shed ma bye/ rgan po dang*/ mkhas pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i zlas grangs pa gsum las 'dir ni phyi ma ste/ 'ga' zhig du theg chen pas zlas grangs pa'i byis pa nyan thos pa'ang bshad do// gang dbang po nang na mang ba dang ldan pa de du dang ldan zhe na/ mang po ldan pa la dbang po bcu dgu ldan te/ dri med gsum rnams ma gtogs pa'o// de yang mtshan gnyis pa dbang po tshang ba'o/ gzhan yang 'phags pa chags bcas kyang grangs bcu dgu ldan srid de/

pho mo'i mtshan gcig dang dri med kun shes ldan (66) pa dang*/ gzhan gnyis las gang rung gcig ste ma rtogs pas so// bsdu bar ni srid pa las kun dang ldan pa 'dod khams su skyes pa dang*/ mi dang lhar skyes pa dang*/ dge rtsa ma chad pa dang*/ 'phags pa rnams yin par gsungs so// spyi'i gnyis pa 'dus byas kyi skye tshul ni/ ci 'dus byas rnams mtshan nyid tha dad pa de bzhin du tha dad par skye'am/ kha cig nges par lhan cig skye ba'ang yod dam ce na yod de/ chos thams cad shes bya gzhi lngar nges te/ gzugs dang*/ sems dang*/ sems byung dang*/ ldan min 'du byed dang*/ 'dus ma byas kyi gzhi yin no// 'dus ma byas la skye bzhi med cing*/ gzhan bzhi'i skye tshul la gnyis te/ gzugs can dang gzugs can ma yin pa'i skye tshul lo// dang po ni/ gzugs can rnams kyi nges pa ni 'di yin te/ rdul phra rab ni gnyis te/ rdzas kyi dang bsags pa'i rdul phra rab bo// dang po ni/ gzugs thams cad kyi chung mtha' dang*/ gnyis (67) pa ni/ rags pa'i nang gi chung mtha'o// de la 'dod khams na dbang po med cing*/ sgra yang med pa'i bsags pa'i rdul phra rab la 'byung ba bzhi dang*/ gzugs dri ro reg bya ste/ rdzas brgyad nges par lhan cig tu skye'o// lus kyi dbang po dang ldan pa la brgyad po de dang*/ rang nyid de rdzas dgu lhan cig skyes te/ dbang po gzhan mig rna ba sna lce dang ldan pa la dgu dang*/ rang rang ste rdzas bcu skye zhing*/ de rnams la sgra yod na re re mnan no// gzugs khams na dri ro med pas gzugs na dbang po med pa la/ sgra med phra rab sdug bsngal rdzas drug ces sbyar ro// de ltar 'dus pa re re la rdzas brgyad mnyam por yod kyang pra bsher sogs 'ga' zhig kho na dmigs pa ni ches gsal zhing nus pa che ba de dmigs pa ste phye dang lan tshwa'i phye ma sres pa'i rdzas mnyam yang lan tsha'i ro dmigs pa bzhin no// 'dir rdzas kyi don yang 'byung bzhi ni rdzas kyi rang gi

(68) mtshan nyid kyi rigs dang gzhan ni skye mched kyi rang mtshan no// gsal bar ma dmigs pa'i 'byung ba rnams yod par ni byed las las rjes su dpag cing rkyen dang phrad na mngon du'ang 'gyur te/ lcags me dang phrad na nal nal po dang*/ chu grang reg dang phrad na sra ba dang*/ shing grud na mi dmigs so zhes zer ro// mdo sde pa na re/ 'dus pa gang la 'byung ba gang dmigs pa de rdzas su yod cing*/ gzhan ni sa bon te/ nus pa'i sgo nas yod kyi rang gi ngo bor te rdzas su ni med de/ shing gi phung po 'di la khams rnam pa sna tshogs yod do// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro zer ro// sde pa 'di dag ni/ 'dus pa gcig la yod pa'i rdul rdzas brgyad sogs gog pa tha dad ni skor bar bcas sam/ bar med du gnas pa 'dzin par byed pa'i rlung gis bzung bas phan tshun mi 'gyes par 'dod do// gnyis pa 'dus byas kyi gzugs can ma yin pa'i skye tshul la/ mdor bstan pa ni/ sems (69) dang sems byung gnyis nges par lhan gcig tu skye la/ gzugs sogs skye ba can thams cad ni 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid skye ba sogs dang*/ nges par lhan gcig du skye ba'o// sems can du ston pa kho na lus dang grib ma lta bu'i thob pa dang*/ lhan cig skye'i snga phyi'i thob pa dang*/ ni min no'am ni sems can du mi ston pa dang lhan cig mi skye'o zhes bye brag tu bya ba'i phyir ro// rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ sems dang mtshungs ldan dang*/ mi ldan pa'i 'du byed rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ nges par mtshungs ldan dang*/ ma nges pa'i mtshungs ldan dang*/ gcig pa lta bu'i tha dad dang*/ tha dad lta bu'i gcig pa'o// dang po la mdor bstan pa ni/ sems byung zhes pa gang zhe na/ dbye bzhi nges pa'i sems byung ni/ dbye grangs sde tshan lnga ste/ spyir gyi sa mang po dang*/ sogs pas dge ba'i dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i dang*/

mi dge ba'i sa mang po pa dang*/ nyon mongs chung (70) ngu'i sa pa ste/ de'i dbye ba las so// rgyas par bshad pa la lnga'i/ dang po mtshams kyi sa mang po'i mtshan nyid la/ tshor ba myong ba dang*/ sems mngon par 'du byed pa'i sems pa dang*/ yul la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'du shes dang*/ byed 'dod pa'i 'dun pa dang*/ yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus pa las skyes pa'i reg pa dang*/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i blo gros te shes rab dang*/ dran pa dmigs pa mi brjed pa dang*/ yid la byed pa sems kyi 'jug pa dang*/ mos pa 'dod pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin sems rtse gcig pa ste/ bcu ni sa mang zhes pa ste/ phal cher sems thams cad la 'byung ba'i phyir/ sems dang sems byung rnams kyi bye brag ni phra bas/ de ni re shig rgyun rnams la yang yongs su dpyad par dka' na skad cig rnams la lta ci smos zhes sman sogs kyi ro sogs dper byas te bshad do// gnyis pa ni sems dwang ba ni dad pa ste de dang ldan na nyon mongs dang nye ba'i nyon mongs (71) pa'i rtog pa dang bar 'gyur ba nor bu chu dwangs lta bu'o// bag yod pa dge ba'i chos sgom zhing ces su byed pa dang*/ shin tu sbyangs pa sems las su rung ba dang*/ btang snyoms sems snyam zhing lhun gyi grub pa nyid dang*/ 'og nas 'chad pa'i ngo tsha shes pa dang*/ khrel yod pa dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ma chags pa dang*/ zhe sdang med pa gnyis te/ gti mug med pa ni shes rab la btags pas spyir gyi mang ngo*// rnam par mi 'tshe ba gzhan la 'tho mi 'tsham pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dge ba la sems spro ba ste/ bcu ni dge ba'i sa mang zhes bya ste/ phal cher rtag tu dge ba'i sems nyid la 'byung ba'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ 'og nas 'chad pa'i rmongs pa ma rig pa dang*/ bag med pa dge ba'i chos mi sgom pa dang*/ le lo dge ba la sems mi spro ba dang*/ ma dad pa sems ma dwang ba dang*/ rmugs pa lus sems lci ba ste las su mi rung ba nyid dang*/

rgod pa sems (72) rnam par ma zhi ba ste/ drug ni nyon mongs can gyi sa pa zhes bya ste/ phal cher rtag tu nyon mongs can gyi sems nyid la 'byung ba'i phyir ro// bzhi pa ni ngo tsha med pa dang*/ khrel med pa ni mi dge ba'i sa mang zhes byas te/ phal cher rtag tu mi dge ba'i sems nyid la 'byung ba'i phyir ro// lnga pa ni/ phra rgyas su 'chad pa'i khro ba dang*/ 'khon du 'dzin pa dang*/ g.yo dang*/ phra dog dang*/ 'tshig pa dang*/ 'chab pa dang*/ ser sna dang*/ rgyu dang*/ rgyags pa 'chad pa dang*/ rnam par 'tshe ba ni/ nyon mongs chung ngu pa sa zhes bya ste/ ma rig pa tsam dang*/ sgom spang dang*/ yid kyi sa pa kho na dang*/ mtshungs ldan gyi blo yin pa'i phyir ro// ma nges pa'i sa brgyad ni/ dbyig shes kyi sdom tshig du/ rtog dang spyod dang 'gyod pa dang*// gnyid dang khong khro chags nyid dang*// nga rgyal the tshom zhes bya ba// brgyad ni nges pa min zhes bshad// ces so// de ltar zhe drug dang lta ba ste/ zhe bdun rtsa bar dngos su bshad cing*/ rgyal po sras lta ba'ang ma nges pa (73) yin pas sdom tshig de rnams mi spong gsung yang*/ de shes rab la rtags pas/ sdom tshig rigs so// des na zhe drug pa rdzas yod dang*/ 'grel bar 'byung ba drug ni rtags yod de/ brjed ngas dran pa nyon mongs can dang*/ rnam g.yeng ting nge 'dzin nyon mongs can dang*/ gti mug med pa dang*/ shes bzhin ma yin pa shes rab dang*/ tshul min yid byed yid byed nyon mongs can dang*/ log par mos pa mos pa nyon mongs can yin pas gud na med pas so// gnyis pa ma nges pa'i mtshungs ldan ni/ sde tshan de lngar ma nges pas de skad de/ de la gnyis te/ 'dod pa'i dang*/ khams gong ma'i mtshungs ldan no// dang po la lnga las/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi dge ba'i sa pa ni/ khyed las sems nyer gnyis 'byung ste/ sngar gyi sde tshan dang po gnyis dang*/ rtog spyod dang bcas pa 'byung ba'i phyir/

'di rnams la rang gzhan gyi dge ba ma byas pa dang*/ mi dge ba byas pa la (74) 'gyod pa yang mnan no// gnyis pa mi dge ba ni/ nyi shu 'byung ste ma rig pa tsam las chag sogs nyon mongs gzhan med pas ma 'dres pa dang*/ lta ba log lta dang*/ mchog 'dzin gnyis dang ldan pa la dang po bcu dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i sa mang drug dang*/ ngo tsha med pa dang*/ khrel med pa dang*/ rtog spyod dang bcas pa rnam 'byung ba'i phyir te/ lta ba ni shes rab du 'du'o// gsum pa ni mi dge ba 'dod chags sam/ khong khro'am/ nga rgyal lam/ the tshom ste nyon mongs bzhi dang*/ khro ba sogs nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa pa bcu dang*/ dge ba byas zhing sdig pa ma byas pa la 'gyod pa rnams dang ldan pa ni khyod la nyer gcig 'byung ste/ sa mang nyi shu dang*/ rang rang rnams 'byung bas so// bzhi pa sgrib la lung ma bstan 'dod pa'i 'jig lta dang*/ mthar lta dang ldan pa'i sems ni khyod la bco brgyad 'byung ste/ sde tshan dang po bcu dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i sa mang drug dang*/ rtog spyod rnams 'byung ba'i phyir ro// lnga pa lung ma bstan sgrib pa las (75) gzhan ma sgrib pa ni khyod la bcu gnyis 'byung ste/ dang po'i bcu dang rtog spyod dag 'byung ba'i phyir ro// nyi 'og pa ni 'gyod pa dang*/ yid mi bde lung ma bstan pa yang 'dod pas/ de lta na bcu gsum mo// gnyid ni rmi lam rmi bas gnas skabs te/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum ka yod pas/ sems kun la mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ gang la yod pa de mnan pas nyer gsum sogs so// gnyis pa khams gong ma'i mtshungs ldan ni 'dod pa'i mtshungs ldan de las yid la gcags pa'i 'gyod pa dang*/ gnyid dang mi dge ba g.yo rgyu rgyags pa bor ba'i khro ba sogs bdun dang*/ khong khro dang ngo tsha med pa dang*/ khrel med pa rnams bsam gtan dang po na med do// de rnams dang rtog pa'ang bsam gtan khyad par can na med la/ de'i gong bsam gtan gnyis pa sogs na dpyod pa med cing*/

yang gi g.yo rgyu yang med par bstan te/ gcig pa lta bu'i tha dad ni/ sems byung kha cig gi khyad par (76) ston te/ ngo tsha med pa dang*/ khrel med la khyad par ci yod ce na/ yon tan dang yon tan can rnams la ma gus pa lus ngag gi skur bsti dang*/ yid kyis 'jigs pas dbang mi sgyur ba ni ngo tsha med pa dang*/ khrel med pa ni/ dam pa smad pa kha na ma tho ba mi dge ba la 'jigs par mi lta ba ste/ de dag las ldog pa ni/ ngo tsha shes pa dang*/ khrel yod pa'o// dga' ba dang gus pa la khyad par ci yod ce na/ dga' ba ni gnyis las nyon mongs can min pa ni dad pa ste/ nyon mongs can ni sred pa'o// gus pa nyid ni ji skad bshad pa'i ngo tsha shes pa ste/ dga' gus de gnyis 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs dag na yod kyi/ gzugs med na med de/ de na gang zag la dmigs pa'i de dag yod la/ 'dir ni gang zag la dmigs pa'i dga' mgus la bsams kyi/ chos la dmigs pa la ma bsams so// rtog spyod gnyis la khyad par ci yod ce na/ rtog pa dang spyod pa rim pa bzhin sems rtsing ba dang zhib pa nyid do// nga rgyal dang rgyags pa'i khyad par ci zhe na/ nga rgyal ni pha rol po (77) las bdag lhag ces sems khengs pa ste/ rgyags pa nyid ni rang gi chos la chags pa'i sems yongs su btags pa'am/ gang ba gzhan gyi la ltos nas min pa'o// tha dad lta bu'i gcig pa ni/ sems dwang ba ni/ bzhi pa ni/ 'byed pas na sems dang shes pas na yid dang*/ rnam par shes pas na rnam shes ni gsung rab las ming de gsum tha dad du btags kyi/ don ni gcig go /gong ma pa ni de gsum phal pas rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang*/ gtso bor sems ni kun gzhi dang*/ nyon yid dang rnam shes ni tshogs drug yin pas don tha dad du bzhed do// brgyan stun po bkod par/ sems ni kun gzhi'i rnam par shes// ngar sems bdag nyid yid yin no// gang zhig yul la 'dzin byed pa// de ni rnam par shes zhes bya// zhes bka' stsal pa ltar ro// de gsum don gcig pa ltar/
sems dang sems byung dbang po la/ rten pas brten pa dang*/ yul 'dzin pas dmigs pa dang*/ dmigs

(78) pa de nyid la rnam pa re re nas bye brag tu gcod pas/ rnam pa dang bcas pa dang*/ mnyam par ldan pas mtshungs par ldan pa'ang don gcig go /mtshungs ldan de'ang rnam pa lnga ste/ sems dang sems byung gnyis rten dbang po gcig la brten pas rten dang*/ yul gcig la dmigs pas dmigs pa dang*/ sems sngon po'i rnam pa can yin na de dang ldan pa'i tshor ba sogs kyang sngon po'i rnam pa can yin pa sogs rnam pa dang*/ dus gcig pas dus dang*/ rigs 'dra rdzas re re bar 'dra bas rdzas mtshungs pa'o// gnyis pa ni ldan pa'i 'du byed la gsum te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ chos kyi khyad par gzhan bstan pas bsdu ba'o// dang po la spyi don ni mdor phung po tha dad du gsungs pa la rten nas/ mngon pa pa thams cad ldan min 'du byed ni sdug bsngal du grub pa dang*/ rig pa gang yang min pa'i 'du byas su bzhed la/ de las kyang bye brag du smra ba rnam gzugs sems sems byung las rdzas gzhan pa dang*/ (79) mdo sde pa dang*/ sems tsam pa rnams de gsum gyi gnas skabs btags yod yin pas rdzas su ma grub pa'i phyir/ rang gi gnas skabs can las rdzas gcig dang*/ tha dad gang yang min te/ gcig yin na gnas skabs mi rtag pa sogs du ma yin pa bzhin du/ gnas skabs can sems sogs kyang du mar thal zhing*/ gnas skabs can sems ni gcig yin pa bzhin du de'i gnas skabs skye 'jig sogs kyang gcig du thal ba'i phyir ro// gzhan yin na 'dus byas rtag par thal zhing*/ gsum las rdzas gzhan du tshad mas ma 'grub pa'i phyir ro// zhes 'chad do// yan lag gi don bdun te/ thob ma thob dang*/ skal mnyam dang*/ 'du shes med pa dang*/ snyoms 'jug dang*/ srog dang*/ mtshan nyid dang*/ ming gi tshogs sogs/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// thob bya'i chos ldan par byed pa'i rdzas gzhan blang la khal ldan byed thag pa'am/ 'byar byed sprin lta bu'o// dbye na gnyis te/

(80) gsar du rnyed pa dang*/ de'i rgyun ldan pa'o// gsar rnyed la'ang zag med dang po'i thob pa lta bu/ sngar bstan ma thob pa las gsar du rnyed pa dang*/ bsam gtan sogs sngar thob pa nyams nas slar thob pa'i skad cig dang po lta bu/ rnam par nyams pa las gsar rnyed gnyis dang*/ thob nas skad cig gnyis pa sogs dang de gnyis rgyun ldan pa dang*/ so skye la srid rtse'i nyon mongs ye nas ldan pa ste/ ldan pa gsum dang lnga'o// des na thob pa ni/ chos ldan byed kyi rdzas yin la/ ma thob pa ni ldan pa'i gegs su 'gyur ba'o// de yang gsum ste/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs can gyi bsam gtan lta bu rnam par nyams pas ma rnyed pa dang*/ de'i rgyun mi ldan pa dang*/ so skye la zag med kyi lam lta bu ye mi ldan pa'o// 'di dag chos gang gi yin zhe na/ thob pa dang ma thob pa ni rang rgyud du rtogs pa'i chos rnams kyi ste/ gzhan rgyud dang sems can gyi rgyud yin pa'i chos rang (81) rgyud la thob ma thob du mi 'gyur ro// dmigs gsal ni rtags 'gog dang*/ rtags min gyi 'gog pa dag rgyun du ma rtogs kyang*/ de gnyis kyi dgag bya rgyud du gtogs pas de bkag pa'i thob ma thob yod do// dus gsum pa'i thob pa yang*/ so sor dus rnam pa gsum te/ chos 'das pa la thob pa khyu mchog ltar dang la lding ba dang*/ lus kyi grib ma ltar lhan cig pa dang*/ be'u ltar rjes su 'brang ba ste/ dus gsum dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba la'ang sbyar te/ spyir btang ngo*// chos dge ba dang sogs pas mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi thob pa rim pa bzhin dge mi dge lung ma bstan no// khams gsum las gang rung der gtogs pa'i chos rnams kyi thob pa dang khams pa kho na'o// khams su ma gtogs pa'i chos rnams kyi thob pa ni khams gsum dang zag med de/ rnam pa bzhi ste/ rtags min gyi khams gsum dang*/ rtags 'gog zag bcas kyis thob pa'i gzugs dang gzugs med gnyis dang*/

de zag med kyis thob pa dang*/ lam bden gyis thob pa zag med do// slob pa'i chos kyi thob pa slob pa dang*/ mi slob pa'i chos kyi thob pa mi slob pa'o// slob pa dang mi slob pa gnyis min gyi chos kyi slob mi slob gnyis min gsum te/ rtags 'gog (82) slob lam gyis thob pa slob pa dang*/ de mi slob lam gyis thob pa mi slob pa dang*/ de so skyes thob pa dang*/ rtags min dang zag bcas kyi thob pa gnyis min no// mthong spang gi thob pa mthong spang dang*/ sgom spang gi thob pa sgom spang ste/ spang bya min pa'i rtags min gyi thob pa dang*/ rtags 'gog so skyes thob pa sgom spang dang*/ de zag med kyi thob pa dang*/ lam bden gyi thob pa spang bya min pa gnyis su 'dod do// yang dus gsum pa'i ces pa'i dmigs gsal ni/ ma sgrib la lung bstan min pa'i thob pa ni/ stobs chung bas lhan cig skye ba kho na ste/ snga phyir skye ba med pas 'das pa'i 'das pa kho na sogs so// thams cad du'am zhe na/ mngon shes lung ma bstan gnyis dang*/ sgom chung gi sprul sems ma gtogs te/ de dag stobs che ba bas snga phyi lhan cig skye ba gsum ka yod do// ma sgrib pa'i yin par ma zad sgribs pa'i lung ma bstan tshangs pa chen po g.yos kun nas slang ba'i gzugs kyi rnam (83) par rig byed kyi'ang thob pa lhan cig skye ba kho na ste/ kun slong stobs chung bas so// ci lung ma bstan gyi thob pa la bye brag yod pa ltar dge mi dge'i thob pa la yang bye brag yod dam zhe na/ yod de/ 'dod pa na dge mi dge'i gzugs kyi thob pa ni/ sems kyi rjes 'brang min pas thams cad du sngar skye ba ni med kyi/ lhan cig dang phyis skye ba ni yod do// gnyis pa ni/ ma thob pa thams cad ma sgrib lung ma bstan nyid de/ dgra bcom pa dang dge rtsa chad pa la yang yod pas so// dus ni 'das pa dang ma skyes pa'i ma thob pa de ni snga phyi lhan cig pa gsum ste/

chos rang yod dus na ma thob pa mi srid pas chos da ltar ba la ma thob pa da ltar ba med do// 'dod pa sogs khams gsum dang*/ dri med kyi'ang ma thob pa khams gsum na spyod pa gsum re ste/ ma thob pa ni rten dbang btsan gyi thob pa bzhin/ chos dbang mi btsan pas 'dod pa'i rten can gyi khams gsum dang*/ zag med kyi chos ma thob (84) pa bzhi ni/ 'dod pa na spyod pa dang*/ gzugs dang gzugs med kyi rten can gnyis la'ang sbyar bas gsum tshan bzhi pa'o// ma thob pa zag med ni 'ga' yang med de zag med kyi lam ye ma thob pa so so'i skye bor bye brag tu smra ba 'dod la/ so skye ni zag med du mi 'os pas so// ma thob pa de ji ltar nyams par 'gyur zhe na/ chos gang gi ma thob pa de chos de thob pa dang*/ sa gong 'og 'phos nas rnam par nyams shing*/ ma thob pa'i thob pa 'chad par 'gyur te/ dper na ma rnyed pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi so skye ni 'phags lam rnyed pas nyams la/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi so skye ni bsam gtan dang por 'phos pas dang*/ srid rtse'i so skye ni ci yang med par skyes pas nyams te/ 'phos pa'i so skyer gyur pa lta bu'o// de lta bu'i thob pa dang*/ ma thob pa gnyis gang la yang gnyis ka yod pas chos de dang de'i thob pa dang*/ thob pa'i thob pa gsum yod cing*/ thob pa'i chos de dang*/ thob pa'i thob pa dag (85) ldan par 'gyur la/ thob pa'i thob pas ni thob pa kho na dang ldan par 'gyur bas thug med du mi 'gyur bar 'chad do// gnyis pa skal mnyam sogs bshad pa ni/ skal mnyam zhes pa ci zhe na/ skal mnyam zhes pa'i rdzas ni/ sems can rnams kyi 'dra ba ste/ ris mthun pa zhes kyang bya'o// dbye na gnyis te sems can du 'dra ci dang*/ lha tshogs su 'dra ba'i bye brag ste/ sems can gyi spyi dang*/ bye brag gi chos mi 'dra ba du ma la sems can gyi sgra blo mtshungs par 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan du 'dod do// 'du shes med pa zhes pa ci zhe na/

'du shes med pa'i rdzas ni/ 'du shes med pa'i lhar skyes pa'i rten la ma 'ongs pa'i sems dang*/ sems byung rnams dus gzhan gyi bar du skyer mi gter bar 'gog pa'o// de yang cig du 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug gi rnam smin no// de'i lha de 'bras bu che ba'i phyogs gcig na 'khod pas 'bras bu che zhes bya ste/ bsam (86) gtan khyad par can bzhin no// snyoms 'jug zhes pa ci zhe na/ de bzhin du 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ gtso bor zhi gnas tsam la rten nas/ sems sems byung 'gog pa'o// sa bsam gtan gyi grangs tha ma bzhi par rtogs pa ste/ yid byed ni 'khor ba la nges par 'byung ba thar pa 'dod pas snyoms 'jug go /'du shes med pa ni/ lung ma bstan kho na yin la/ 'di dge ba kho na'o// 'bras bu ni skyes nas myong gyur nyid kho na ste/ nyams kyang nges par skyed nas 'du shes med par skye bas so// gang zag ni so skye'i ste/ 'phags pa ni 'di las ltung ba'i gnas lta bur gzigs pas snyoms par 'jug pa ma yin no// ci bsam gtan ltar dus gsum pa thob pa'am zhe na/ 'bad pas sgrub dgos pa dang*/ sems med pas skad cig dang po la dus gcig pa ste/ da ltar ba kho na dang*/ skad cig gnyis pa phan chad 'das pa dang yang ldan gyi sems med (87) pas ma 'ongs pa mi thob ste/ so thar gyi sdom pa bzhin no// de bzhin du 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ gtso bor lhag mthong la rten nas tshor 'du 'gags pa ste/ khyad par 'di ni tshor 'du'i skyo nas de dag zhi bar gnas pa'i don du 'jug gi nges 'byung gi yid byed kyis mi 'jug go /sa srid rtse las skyes pa dang*/ ngo bo dge ba dang*/ skye gnas dang*/ lan grangs gzhan gnyis su myong 'gyur dang*/ myong bar ma nges te gsum dang*/ gang zag 'phags lam gyi stobs kyis skyed pa'i 'phags pa'i dang*/ sbyor ba 'bad pas thob kyi 'dod chags dang bral tsam gyis min pas snga ma bzhin dang por da ltar ba dang*/

phyis 'das pa dang ldan gyi ma 'ong pa mi thob bo// dmigs gsal thub pa'i 'gog pa ni/ sbyor bas min gyis/ zad pa ma mkhyen pa dang dus mnyam du byang chub kyis 'thob ces pa'o// kha che'i yul gyi nub phyogs pa dag dang por te mthong lam skyes nas 'og sa la zhugs (88) pa langs te/ srid rtse'i sgom spangs spangs pa ste/ sangs rgyas so zhes zer ro// kha che ba ni de min te/ byang chub sems pa bden pa mngon rtogs skad cig bcu drug dang*/ srid rtse'i mnyen por bar chad med lam dang*/ rnam grol lam dgu gnyis bco brgyad de/ skad cig ma sum bcu rtsa bzhi bar ma chad par sgom pas byang chub thob phyir te/ 'og sa brgyad kyis spangs zin pas srid rtse'i spang bya las med la/ bar der 'gog pa skyed nas bsam pa ldang ba can du 'gyur ba can yin pas snyoms 'jug de gnyis ka 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs kyi rten can yin gyi/ gzugs med kyi rten can min la khyad par ni 'gog pa dang por skyed pa ni bka' bas blo gsal ba mi'i nang du skyed cing*/ phyis ni sngar nyams pas gzugs khams su skyed do// snga ma ni 'dris pas skyed sla bas dang por yang gnyi ka'i rten can no// bsdu bar ni dang por 'dod pa skyed par bshad do// de rnams ldang ba'i sems ni/ 'di pa 'du ba sems 'das pa rdzas grub dang*/ (89) mngon pa'i mdo sde pa dbang bcas kyi lung la yod pa'i sems kyi sa bon dang*/ dbyig shes snyoms 'jug gnyis ga yid shes mi gsal ba dang*/ bcas pas yid shes dang*/ sa sder kun gzhi ma bzhag na/ mdo sde pa ltar dang*/ bzhag na kun gzhi'i sa bon dang*/ rig pa'i mdo sde pa ltar na/ 'jug sems kyis bzhag pa'i nus pa las skye bar bzhed do// gong ma pa ni 'di gsum shes rig 'gags pa'i gnas skabs su bzhed la/ kun gzhi bzhag nas 'gog pa gzugs med du'ang mngon du byed par bsdu bar bshad do// mdo sde pa ni/
