rnag khrag du mthong ngo*// nang gi sgrib pa can bshes spring du/ kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam la// lto ba ri'i lto tsam bkres pas nyen// mi gtsang gi nar bor bcud kyang*// 'tshal ba'i mthu dang ldan pa ma lags so// zhes dang*/ kha cig lba wa smin pa'i rnag 'tshal lo// zhes pa ltar dang*/ zas skom nyid la sgrib pa can me lce'i phreng ba can/ zos 'thungs kun gyis tshig pa'o// dud 'gro'i gnas ni rgya mtsho ste/ stod 'grel las kha 'thor ba ni mi dang*/ 'dod lha dang*/ lhan cig rgyu'o// de yang bying na gnas pa rnams che bas chung ba mid de za ba dang*/ des che ba'i lus phug ste za ba dang*/ klu rnams ni nyin re bzhin bye tshan gyi rus pa la thug par bsreg pa dang*/ mkha' lding gis za ba ste/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro bas de dag zlog par bshad do// kha mthor ba rnams ni gsod pa dang*/ bskol 'tshog sogs kyis mnar te de nyid du/ kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa khrag / (184) sha dang lpags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur// dbang med gzhan dag rdog pa lag pa dang*// lcags dang lcags kyu rnams kyi btab te bkol// zhes te rgyas par gzhan du ltas la skyo ba skyed par bya'o// gsum pa lha'i gnas bshad pa la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ zhar la der gnas pa'i sems kyi khyad par ro// dang po la gnyis te/ sa dang 'brel ba dang*/ ma 'brel ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa dang*/ sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i gnas so// dang po la gnyis te/ gzhal med khang la dang*/ ri la rten pa'i gnas so// dang po la nyi zla'i rnam bzhag ni nyi zla dag 'di nas thag ji srid na yod ce na/ nyi zla ni lhun po phyed gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rtse dang mnyam pa na'o// tshad ji tsam na thad dkar zla ba dpag tshad lnga bcu dang*/ nyi ma gcig pa dang bcas pa nga gcig pa/ 'og gzhi'i me shel dang*/ chu shel gyi ngo bo ste/ gzhag par rngams su phyed dang (185)

drug dang bco brgyad cha yod pa/ gser gyi rwa ba/ dpag tshad phyed pas skor ba/ gser dngul shel bai ḍūr+ya'i gcig pa gcig dang*/ gser gyi sa gzhi dang*/ mtsho dang*/ rdzing bu dang*/ me tog sna tshogs dang*/ ljon shing dang*/ bya skad snyan pa dang*/ zam pa rgyud ma sogs can du bshad do// skar ma che ba rgyang grags bco brgyad dang*/ 'bring la bcu dang*/ chung ba la bzhi'o// zhes pa'o// 'dir chung ba la rgyang grags gcig por skar ma kun sdom na dung 'gyur gnyis dang*/ bye ba brgyad dang sa ya lnga'o// las kyi dbang gi bar snang la 'phul ba dang*/ 'degs pa dang*/ skyod pa'i rlung gi stobs kyis 'khor bas nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i tshe/ byang du nam phyed pa dang*/ shar du nyi ma nub pa dang*/ lhor nyi ma phyed pa dang*/ nub tu nyi ma 'char ba rnams dus gcig go /'o na zla ba mar ngo la rangs par srang ba ci zhe na/ gdags par mar ngo la nyi ma dang je nyer gyur pa las zla ba rang gi grib ma 'bab pas rim gyis ma rangs pa srang la/ gnam gang gi tshe/ shin du nye bas rang gi grib mas ril sgrib pas mi mthong la yar ngo la nyi ma dang je ring gyur pas grib ma bri zhing*/ chung ngu gyur nas 'phel zhing*/ nya ba'i tshe shin du ring bas sgrib byed grib ma med pa'i phyir rang (186) po mthong bar bshad de/ sgron ma la nye ring gi ka ba bzhin no// de la rten pa'i dus tshigs kyi khyad par ni/ 'dir 'jig rten pa dang mi 'dra bar gsung rab du lo la dus gsum ste/ smin drug gi nya nas gzung nas/ mgo dang rgyal dang mchu dang*/ dbo'i nya ba'i bar ni dgun dang*/ de'i nya nas nag pa dang*/ sa ga dang*/ sgron dang*/ chu stod nya'i bar dpyid de/ de'i nya nas gro gzhun dang*/ khrums dang*/ tha skar dang*/ smin drug gi nya ba'i bar ni dbyar ro// de la dbyar zla gnyis pa khrums kyi tha ma yar ngo'i tshes dgu nas mtshan mo ring du 'gyur la/ de nas dgun zla rnams kyi bzhi pa dbo'i tha ma yar ngo'i tshes dgu pa la mtshan mo thung du 'gyur ro// nyin mo de dag las zlog ste/

mtshan mo ring ba'i tshe thung la/ thung ba'i tshe ring ngo*// tha ma zhes pa dag ni zla ba thams cad mar ngo snga bas te/ khrums dang*/ dbo'i zla ba yin par ni 'grel pa dang*/ 'grel bshad kyi rgya dpe na yod kyang*/ (187) ston ra dang*/ dpyid ra zhes don 'gyur mdzad pa ni/ bod na dus tshigs bzhi grags che ba dang*/ mthun par sgyur bar zad do// gang dag 'dis dbyar nyi gang log ston ra dang*/ dgun nyi gang log dpyid rar bstan par bsams nas/ dgun mgo dbyug pa nas 'dzin pa dang*/ nyi ma ldog pa je snga la song bar 'dod pa ni/ mun sprul te/ mdo rgyud dang*/ rgya gar gyi rtsis rnam dag kun dang 'gal ba'i phyir te/ 'di ldog mtshams nas bshad na/ byin dang mi 'grig cing ring thung du 'gyur ba'ang mnyam pa nas rtsam ste/ mtshan nyid pa 'byung gi de'i sngon du mi 'byung bar dgongs nas ston dpyid kyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa gnyis dngos su dang*/ dbyar dgun gyi nyi ma ldog mtshams shugs la bstan par bzhed do// ji tsam gyi ring du 'gyur zhe na/ nyin mo'am mtshan mo ring bar 'gyur ba ni/ thang gcig re res so// des na mnyam pa na (188) yud tsam bco lnga dang*/ thung ba na bcu gnyis dang*/ ring ba na bco brgyad du 'gyur ro// de yang nyi ma lhor bgrod pa'i tshe/ mtshan mo ring zhing*/ byang du 'gro ba'i tshe nyi ma ring ste/ rim pa bzhin 'char ba bye dmar 'gyur bas mthong yun je thung dang je ring 'gyur bas so// kha cig mthur la 'gyogs cing gyen la 'gro ba bul yin pas 'chad do// bzhag par dgun grang ba ni nyi ma'i 'od kyi dngos gzhi lho'i rgya mtshor 'bab ste/ de'i dbang gi gting chu gro'o// sos ka tsha ba ni/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi dngos gzhi gling du 'bab pa ste/ de'i dbang gis/ rgya mtsho'i grang bas gting chu grang bar bshad do// ri la rten pa ni/ ri rab 'di la chu 'tshams nas rtsegs pa'i bang rim bzhi yod de/ de bzhi'i bar gyi tshad ni/
dpag tshad stong phrag bcu bcu yod pas/ ri rab kyi phyed man chad du phyin to// bang rim dang po stong phrag bcu drug dang*/ gnyis pa brgyad dang*/

(189) gsum pa bzhi dang*/ bzhi pa gnyis ri rab las 'phyar du 'phags so// de bzhi la rim pa bzhin/ gnod sbyin lag na gzhong thogs dang*/ phreng thogs dang*/ rtag tu myos pa dang*/ bzhi pa la rgyal chen bzhi po rang nyid dang*/ de'i 'khor gyi lha rnams gnas te/ gser gyi ri bdun la yang de rnams kyi grong dang*/ grong rdal gnas so// khor yug la'ang lung phran tshegs su lag na rdo rje gos sngon can zhes pa'i rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa gnas par gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang nyi zla skar ma dang*/ ri dang chu klung dang*/ ljon shing dang*/ nags tshal dang*/ sa bla dang*/ nam mkha' dang*/ rgya mtsho rnams la'ang*/ de rnams kyi lha gnas te/ 'grel par de nyid kyi phyir/ lha'i ris de ni thams cad pas che'o// zhes so// bzhag par yang gnya' shing 'dzin la rgyal chen bzhi'i gnas ming sa dang 'dra ba ste/ chu zheng du dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu dang*/ (190) khor yug du stong gis 'khor ba gru bzhi pa lam srang dang*/ skyed mos tshal dang*/ ljon shing dang*/ rdzing bu dang*/ gser gyi rwa ba dang*/ zam pa rgyud ma dang*/ gser gyi bye ma gdal ba dang*/ tsan+dan gyi chu'i chag chag btab pa dang*/ tshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gis mig mangs ris su bris pa sogs khyad par du ma can du bshad do// gnyis pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnas ni/ lhun po'i rtse na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha gnas so// lhun po'i rtse de'i ngos re re la dpag tshad brgyad khri re'o// phyogs mtshams na dpag tshad lnga brgya'i tshad tsam rtsegs pa bzhi la gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje gnas so bzhag par ni/ de'i rngams su dpag tshad phyed dang lnga dang*/ chu zheng du brgya nyer lnga dang*/ mtha' skor du lnga brgya par bshad do// rtse de'i dbus na brgya sbyin gyi pho brang grong khyer lta na sdug ces pa ngos re re la dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya pa/ rngams su dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis pa'i ra ba gser gyi rang

(191) bzhin te/ sa gzhi tshon rgyas bkra ba shing bal ltar 'jam pa/ rkang pa bzhag na nem pa dang*/ bteg na phar ces pa'i mnyen pa yod do// gzhag par gser gyi rwa ba dpag tshad phyed dang gsum pas skor ba/ rtsig skyabs gser dngul bai ḍūr+ya shel las byas pa/ ngos bzhi na mda' yab gyen mthur du 'phyang ba gnyis gnyis dang ldan pa/ sgo stong du gcig gi ma tshang ba/ sgo la spangs su dpag tshad phyed dang bcu gsum dang*/ zheng du phyed dang gnyis yod pa/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ sgo re re la'ang*/ srung ma go mtshon thogs pa lnga brgya yod pa/ lam srang zheng du dpag tshad bcu gnyis dang*/ ring bar nyis stong lnga brgya bas mdzes pa/ gser gyi bye ma gdal pa'o// zhes grong khyer gyi dbus de na brgya sbyin gyi khang bzang rnam par rgyal byed yod de/ ngos re re la dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu re'o// grong las dpag tshad phyed (192) dang lnga 'phags pa/ rmang rin po che bzhi las byas pa/ them skas bzhi dang ldan pa/ gser gyi ka rten dngul dang*/ dngul gyi ka rten gser dang*/ shel gyi ka rten bai ḍūr+ya dang*/ bai ḍūr+ya'i shel las byas pa/ ba gam brgya rtsa gcig pa/ ba gam re re la/ khang pa rtsegs ma bdun bdun dang*/ de re re la khang mig bdun bdun dang*/ de re re la lha'i bu bdun bdun dang*/ de re re la lha mo bdun bdun dang*/ de re re la g.yog mo bdun bdun dang*/ de re re la sil snyan 'khrol ba bdun bdun yod de/ grong gi mngon par dga' ba'o// grong khyer de'i phyi'i ngos bzhi na lha rnams kyi rtse ba'i sa skyed tshal bzhi bzhi ste/ shing rta sna tshogs can dang*/ der phyin na shes pa rtsub par 'gyur ba'i tshal dang*/ lha'i bu dang*/ bu mo rnams 'dres shing*/ 'dod yon la spyod pa'i tshal dang*/ der phyin na yid dga' ba skye ba'i tshal dang*/ bzhis brgyan te/ rtse tshul ni bdags pa dang*/ dkon mchog ta la'i (193)

gzungs su shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal na glang po sa srung gi bu bzang zhing mdzes pa dkar ba yan lag bdun legs par gnas pa/ mgo dmar ba/ mche ba drug pa/ srid du dpag tshad gcig khor yug du bdun yod pa/ 'khor glang po brgya stong dang ldan pa gnas te/ lha skyed mos tshal du 'gro ba na/ des mgo sum cu rtsa gsum du sprul zhing*/ mgo re re la mche ba drug drug dang*/ de re re la rdzing bu bdun bdun dang*/ de re re la pad ma'i sdong bu bdun bdun/ pad ma re re la lha mo bdun bdun dang*/ de re re la g.yog mo bdun bdun dang*/ de re re la sil snyan 'khrol ba bdun bdun dang ldan pa sprul ste/ mgo dbus ma la dbang po dang*/ gzhan la nye dbang po gnyis dang*/ glang po gzhan rnams la 'khor rnams zhon nas 'gro ba mi mngon pa lta bu'i 'gyogs pas lha rnams grong dang skyed mos tshal du skyel la/ de nas rdzu (194) 'phrul de btang ste/ lhar sprul nas 'dod pa la spyod par gsungs so// skyed tshal de rnams kyi ni phyogs bzhi dpag tshad nyi shu'i bcad pa na sa gzhi bzang po 'dren pa lta bu mdzes pa bzhi yod do// grong khyer de'i byang shar gyi mtshams na shing yongs su 'du sa rdol te/ dpag tshad lnga 'og du zug pa/ brgya gyen du 'phags pa/ yal ga dang*/ 'dab ma lnga bcur khyab pa/ me tog rgyas pa'i dri rdzi phyogs su dpag tshad brgya dang*/ de min du lnga bcu ldang ba'o// sar yal 'dab kyi brgya bcur khyab pa dang*/ de'i drung du zla bzhi 'dod pas rtse bar bshad do// bzhag sar yang dbyar rtse ba dang*/ de'i drung na ar mo li ka lta bu'i rdo leb dkar po chu zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu lnga bcu dang*/ rngams su drug dang*/ bco brgyad cha yod pa dbus na brgya sbyin gyi seng ge'i khri dang*/ nye 'khor na nye dbang rnams kyi khri yod par bshad do// lnga pa ni lho nub kyi mtshams na lha'i 'dun sa chos (195)

bzang ste/ der lha rnams bya ba dang bya ba min pa la 'gro'o// gzhag par shar lho na dang*/ byang shar na dang*/ de'i 'dab ma rdo leb yod par bshad do// gnyis pa sa dang ma 'brel ba'i gnas ni/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa de'i steng du 'thab bral sogs 'dod gzugs kyi lha rnams ni nam mkha'i gzhal med khang na gnas so// de yan chad kun 'thab bral yin yang spyi ming dgos la btags nas/ dang po la 'thab bral zhes bya ste/ lha 'og ma gnyis ni/ lha min dang 'thab pas so// de la lha min gyi gnas ni/ sar ri rab chu la nub pa'i khong seng na yod par bshad cing*/ 'di ltar dran pa nyer bzhag du gsungs te/ dpag tshad sum khri na/ 'od ldan gyi grong na sgra gcan dang*/ de nas bzhi stong na/ skar phreng gi grong na 'gul phreng dang*/ de nas bzhi stong na bstan pa'i grong na rab gnon dang*/ de nas (196) bzhi stong na zab pa'am/ gser ldan gyi grong na/ thag bzangs ris gnas la/ de rnams dma' shos bzang zhing*/ bzhi pa'i gser gyi sa gzhi la lta na sdug gi dod gser ldan dang*/ rnam rgyal gyi dod btams pa can dang*/ chos bzang gi dod nor bzang dang*/ yongs 'du'i dod tsi tra pa gnyis dang*/ zla ba dkar po'i dod rdo leb bzang po ste/ tshal bzhi ni shar sogs na kun dga' dang*/ rab dga' dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ kun dga' rwa ba'o// sa gzhi ni/ kun dga' can nas kun dga' rwa ba can gyi bar ro// glang po che rab brtan gyi dod/ bzod par dka' ba dang*/ sa srung gi bu'i dod de/ seng ge gangs rtsegs dang*/ rta sprin gyi shugs can gyi dod brag 'dzings zhes pa'o// lha dang 'thab pa ni/ lha lha min gyi bu mo 'dod pa dang*/ lha min lha'i bdud rtsi bzang po 'dod pas/ zhe 'gras te/ lha min rnams/ ri rab kyi khong seng (197) nas/ gser dngul/ shel man shel/ bai ḍūr+ya'i mtshon thogs zhing go cha gyon te/ chas pa na/ dmag gi ber gyis brgya sbyin gyi ba dan 'gul bas/

dmag 'ong bar shes so// de rnams klu dang 'thab pas pham na rang gi gnas su zam ldog la/ dkar po klu pham na/ chu mtshams nas thon te/ rdzu 'phrul gyi nam mkha' la 'phags shing*/ bang rim gyi lha sogs dang 'thab bo// de'i tshe lha'i gnas gsal ba'i ched du/ sgra gcan gyi nyi zla lag pas sgrib cing*/ rgyal pham dang*/ skye dgu'i bde sdug 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i dge sdig la rag las pas/ lha rnams gling 'di yang yang nyul lo// lha pham na pho nya ngu zhing song ste/ lha'i dbang po mkhyen par mdzod cig lha min gyi dpung sogs rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa'i ma thub pas/ rtsa gsum pas zlog par mdzod cig ces smras pas/ dbang pos gzhan rnams la bsgo'o// g.yul ngor spyad pa'i glang (198) po rab brtan yang*/ dbang po'i bsam pa shes te/ der phyin nas lha rnams rtsub 'gyur gyi tshal du phyin nas 'thab par mos te/ ri rab nub kyi steng du 'thab bo// gzhag par lhor 'thab par bshad do// lha min rnams ri 'phen cing*/ de kun dbang po'i rdo rjes bcom pa'i dum bu rol mtsho sogs su lhung bar srog chags du ma shi ba ste/ mtsho dmar por 'gro'o// lha'i mgo dang rked pa chad na 'chi yan lag thams cad kyang skye ste/ sdug bsngal chen po 'byung ngo*// lha min mi bzhin du gnad du phog na 'chi la/ de yang gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du mtsho kun snang la 'chi la/ de'ang gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du shi ba dang*/ rkang lag chad pa sogs kyi gzugs brnyan shar te/ dmag ma log pa'i gong du mya ngan byed la/ de dag su pham pa dang*/ rang gi grong khyer du zhugs nas zam pa bsdus sgo bcad de gnas pa dang*/ dngangs skrag byung yang phan tshun mi tshugs so// de dag gi khyad par bshad pa la/ 'dod pa spyod tshul ni/ (199) lha de rnams la 'dod pa spyod pa ni dang po drug yin no// drug gi yang rigs gong ma gnyis ni/ dang po gnyis sprad de dang*/

gsum pa 'khyud pa dang*/ bzhi pa lag bcangs dang*/ lnga pa rgod pa dang*/ drug pa ltas pa tsam gyis 'khrig pa'i bde ba myong ngo*// bye brag du smra ba ni/ drug car gnyis kyi gnyis sprod kyang gdags par/ de skad 'byung ba ni/ 'khrig pa'i dus kyi tshad do// ces smra ba'o// lha de drug gi 'dod yon gzhan ni/ gos srang phyed dang bzhi cha dang*/ brgyad cha dang*/ bcu drug cha dang*/ so gnyis cha dang*/ re bzhi cha'o// rje khol dang*/ bag ma gtong len dang*/ pha ma dang*/ pho mo'i dbang po dang*/ bkres skom dang*/ dus bzhi dang*/ nyin mtshan rnams yod la/ mu ge dang*/ nyo tshong dang*/ nad dang*/ rga ba med cing*/ tsha grang ni dang po na yod kyi/ de la gong na med ces gzhag par ro// sar 'dod lha gong ma gong ma gnyis la (200) chung ma 'chang ba dang*/ bag ma gtong len med par bshad la/ drug car lus kyi phyi nang gtsang zhing rdul dang*/ dri ma dang*/ rus pa dang*/ rtsa rgyus dang*/ nang khrol dang*/ bshang gci med do// gser dngul shel bai ḍūr+ya gzhal med khang*/ ba gam dang*/ bsil khang dang*/ stegs bu dang*/ skar khung drwa ba can nyams dga' ba nor bu sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ snang ba 'gyed pa mdzes pa yod do// bza' ba'i bdud rtsi sngo ser dkar dmar bzhi 'byung ba'i ljon shing dang*/ btung ba sbrang rtsi dang*/ sbrang chang 'byung ba'i dang*/ gzhon pa shing rta sogs 'byung ba'i dang*/ gos dang rgyan 'byung ba'i dang*/ dri bzang dang*/ gdug pa dang*/ me tog 'phreng ba 'byung ba'i dang*/ bzhad gad dang*/ glu dang*/ rol mo'i sgra 'byung ba'i dang*/ snod spyad dang*/ yo spyad sna tshogs 'byung ba'i ljon shing yod de/ ci 'dod pa tsam gyi lag du 'ong la/ sgra mi snyan na ni shing de dag la dpag bsam gyi shing zhes bya ste/ (201) rang gi len gyi bsam pa tsam gyis 'ong ba min no// chu yan lag brgyad ldan gyi rdzing bu dang*/ mtsho me tog sna tshogs dang*/ bya sna tshogs skad snyan pa 'byin pa can dang*/

dus dus su bag med pa la bskul bar byed pa'i rnga sgra dang*/ lam srang kun na sil snyan dang pheg rdob pa'i sgra sgrogs pa'i lha mo mdzes mas gang ba dang*/ sa la me tog man da rwa ba 'di pa'i pus mo nub tsam gyi khebs pa'i rnying pa rnams rlung gi 'dor cing*/ gsar pa legs par 'grems te/ dran pa nyer bzhag du/ lha rnams bsod nams dbang rkyen gyis// lha'i grong du rlung chen ldang*// me tog rnying pa 'dor byed cing*// me tog gsar pa legs par 'grems zhes so// lha skye ba'i tshul ni/ lha mo rnams la mngal gyi gnas med pas/ lha'am lha mo'i spang du byis pa lo lnga tsam lon pa tsam nas/ lo bcu lon pa lta bu'i bar du rim pa bzhin/ 'dod lha drug po de rnams su skye la/ (202) gzhan rnams lus myur du rdzogs zhing*/ brgya sbyin lus rdzogs pa skye bas/ snga phyi rje ba'ang*/ gzhan gyis mi tshor ro// gzugs can gyi lha rnams ni/ lus kun rdzogs pa dang*/ gos dang bcas pa nyid du skye zhing*/ 'dod khams pa ni/ ngo tsha khrel yod shas chung bas/ gcer bur skye la/ rgyal bu don grub dang*/ dge slong ma dkar mo dang*/ dge tshul ma ni gos dang bcas par ro// lha kun kyang saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du smra'o// kha cig bden pa smra ba'i dbang du byas pa'o// zhes zer ro// 'dod pa dang skye ba'i tshul ni/ 'dod pa ji ltar gnas pa dang*/ rang gi sprul pa dang*/ gzhan gyi sprul pa la dbang byed pa'i skye ba gsum po ni/ rim pa bzhin 'dod lha dang po bzhi mir bcas pa rnams dang*/ 'phrul dga' ba dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa'o// dben pa las skyes pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa dang*/ dga' ba med pa'i bde ba can gyi skye ba gsum po ni rim pa (203) bzhin/ bsam gtan dang po gsum gyi skye ba ste/ de re re la sa ni gsum gsum ste dgu'o// bar thag gi khyad ni/ lha gnas de rnams kyi bar thag ji srid ce na/

gnas dang gnas nas 'og 'dzam gling ji srid pa de dang*/ de'i gong du de srid de/ 'di nas rgyal chen bzhi'i pho brang la dpag tshad bzhi khri dang*/ de nas sum cu rtsa gsum la bzhi khri'o// 'di nas rtsa gsum la brgyad khri dang*/ de nas 'thab ral la brgyad khri sogs te/ 'di nas shin du mthong tsam de nas 'og min du'i bar ro// gdags pa las ni/ gong ma gnyis la drug 'bum brgyad khri dang*/ gzhan thams cad bzhi khri'i bar ro// ci 'og mas gong ma'i gnas su phyin nas mthong ngam zhe na/ rang gi sa gong ma'i rdzu 'phrul thob pa'am/ gzhan rten te/ de na gnas pa'i lhas khrid na mthong gi de dag ma gtogs pa de rnams khams dang*/ sa gong mar 'gro ba dang*/ mthong ba med do// rgyal chen bzhi pa ni/ rtsa gsum (204) par 'gro zhing*/ mngon par dga' ba'i zhing na'ang*/ gser dngul gyi skas la 'dzegs te/ mi rnams der 'gro bar bshad do// skye rabs su/ tshangs pa mthong bar bshad pa ni// 'dod pa'i lus su sprul pa'o// de rnams kyi tshad ni 'thab bral sogs bzhi/ ri rab kyi steng tsam zhes dang*/ gzhan ni gong ma nyis 'gyur du smra'o// bsam gtan dang po gling bzhi pa tsam dang*/ gnyis pa stong spyi phud tsam dang*/ gsum pa stong gnyis pa tsam dang*/ bzhi pa stong gsum tsam du smra ste gzhan ni dang po gsum stong spyi phud tsam dang*/ bzhi pa tshad med du smra'o// //gsum pa stong gsum ngos bzung zhing 'byung 'jig mnyam du bstan pa ni/ gling bzhi pa dang*/ nyi zla dang*/ ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang*/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bsam gtan dang po man chad la stong spyi phud lta bu yin no// spyi phud de stong la ni/ stong gnyis bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes pa yin no// stong gnyis pa de stong la ni stong gsum

(205) gyi 'jig rten zhes bya ste gling bzhi bye ba phrag rgya'o// de gsum ka la yang lcags ri re dang bdag byed pa'i tshangs pa re bshad do// de thams cad me sogs kyi mnyam du 'jig cing 'byung ba ste 'chags so// gnyis pa zhar la sems can gyi tshad bshad pa la gnyis te/ lus tshad dang*/ tshe tshad do// dang po la gsum ste/ mi dang*/ 'dod lha dang*/ gzugs khams pa'i lus tshad do// dang po la 'dzam bu gling pa tshe lo brgya pa rnams kyi lus tshad ni/ kha cig khru bzhi pa dang*/ phal che'i phyed dang bzhi ste/ khru ni chos mngon pa dus kyi mi'i khrus rtsi bar rgyal po sras su bshad la/ 'on kyang 'og nas 'chad pa'i 'gyur sgres pa'i khru'o// bskal pa dang po'i mi 'ga' zhig ni brgya sbyin dang mnyam ste yab sras mjal bar spyi bo skyes dang*/ brgya sbyin stan gcig la 'dug pa na mig 'byed 'dzum yod med ma rtogs pa khyad med par bka' stsal pas so// shar lus 'phags khru brgyad/ ba lang (206) spyod pa khru bcu drug dang*/ byang sgra mi snyan pa so gnyis pa zhes bya ba phyi ma nyis 'gyur du skyed do// lha'i gzugs tshad ni 'dod dang ldan pa lha'i lus tshad rgyal chen bzhi pa rgyang grags bzhi cha nas dga' ldan pa gcig dang*/ gzhan 'phrul ba rgyang grags phyed dang gnyis kyi bar du rgyang grags bzhi cha re skyed do// gzugs can dang po ni/ spyi'i bong tshod/ tshangs rigs pa dpag tshad phyed phyed skyed de/ 'od chung ba'i gnyis so// de'i lhag tshad med 'od yan chad kyi lus ni/ 'og mas gong ma nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur gyis che ste/ dge rgyas pa'i re bzhi dang*/ sprin med pas dpag tshad gsum dor bas/ brgya nyer lnga nas 'og min pa'i khri drug stong gi bar ro// tshe tshad gnyis te tshe tshad dngos dang*/ bar du 'chi ba yod med dpyad pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ bde 'gro dang*/ ngan 'gro'i tshe tshad do// dang po la mi'i tshe tshad ni/

spyi'i bong tshod tha dad pa rnams kyi tshe tshad kyang tha dad dam zhe na/ sgra mi snyan na tshe lo stong ste/ nub dang (207) shar gnyis na/ de'i phyed phyed spangs pa ste/ rim pas lnga brgya dang*/ nyis brgya lnga bcu'o// 'dzam gling 'di na ma nges te/ res thung ste tha mar lo bcu dang*/ res ring ste bskal ba dang po'i mi'i tshe lo dpag tu med do// 'dod lha'i tshe tshad ni/ mi lo lnga bcu la 'dod lha 'og ma rgyal chen bzhi pa'i nyin zhag gcig ste/ nyin zhag de'i bgrang pa'i zhag sum bcu la zla ba dang*/ de bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i rgyal chen bzhi pa'i tshe ni lo lnga brgya'o// 'dod la gong ma lnga'i zhag dang*/ lo'i tshad gnyis ka nyis 'gyur te/ rim pa bzhin mi lo brgya dang*/ nyis brgya dang*/ bzhi brgya dang*/ brgyad brgya dang*/ stong drug brgya nyin zhag ste/ de'i bgrang pa'i lo stong dang*/ nyis stong dang*/ bzhi stong dang*/ brgyad stong dang*/ khri drug stong ni tshe tshad do// gnya' shing 'dzin yan chad na nyi zla med kyang nyin mtshan ni/ ku mu ta dang pad ma ltar/ me tog kha bye zum dang*/ bya rnams skad 'byin mi 'byin dang*/ (208) gnyid sangs pa dang*/ bro ba las te/ snang ba'i bya ba ni rang gi 'od kyis so// khams gong ma'i tshe tshad la/ gzugs khams kyi tshe tshad ni/ gzugs can gyi khams rnams na nyin mtshan med de/ tshe ni rang gi lus gzhal ba'i dpag tshad kyi grangs kyi bskal ba yis te/ gzugs can dang po bskal ba phyed// de'i gong ma phyed phyed skyed// 'od chung rnams kyi lha yan chad// tshe ni nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur te// sprin med bskal ba gsum dor ro// zhes pa'o// gzugs med kyi tshe tshad ni/ gzugs med nam mkha'i tshe/ bskal pa stong phrag nyi shu ste/ gong ma gsum nyi shu res lhag go /'o na bskal pa de gang zhe na/ chad mnyam la/ rang gi nyin zhag de'i bgrang pa'i drug po de rnams kyi tshe 'dod lha drug dang*/

lo grangs 'dra ba yin te/ rgyal chen bzhi pa'i tshe tshad ni yang sos pa'i zhag gcig ste/ zhag de sum bcu la zla ba/ de bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i lnga brgya thub pa sogs so// rab tu tsha ba ni/ (209) bar bskal phyed dang*/ mnar med ni/ bar bskal gcig go /dud 'gro rnams tshe mchog du ring ba ni/ bar bskal gcig te/ dge slong dag klu brgyad pa ni/ klu chen po ste/ bskal par gnas pa 'dzin pa'o// zhes so// thung ba yud tsam par/ mdo nyi ma'i snying por/ yid btags rnams kyi tshe ni/ mi'i zla ba gcig nyin zhag du byas pa'i lo lnga brgya ste/ mi lo khri lnga stong ngo*// mdo nyi ma'i snying por thung bas stong dang*/ ring bas stong phrag brgyad cu thub par bka' stsal to// ma ga ta'i khal brgyad cu shong ba'i til gyi sbyang ba til gyis byur bur bkang ba'i nang na lo brgya brgya zhing*/ til nyag cig phyung bas zad par gyur pa ni/ chu bur can gyi tshe ste/ grang dmyal gzhan bdun gyi tshe ni nyi shu nyi shur sgyur ro// sar ni/ tsha dmyal rnams kyi phyed phyed du bshad do// tshe ma rdzogs par 'chi ba yod dam zhe na/ sgra mi snyan pa ni/ tshe nges par ring por 'tsho la/ de ma gtogs (210) pa la bar du 'chi ba yod do// gzhan yang bar skabs su mi 'chi ba byang sems skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dang*/ srid pa tha ma pa dang*/ rgyal bas bstan pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i thad du gtang ba'i pho nya dang dad pa dang*/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba dag dang*/ byang sems tha ma dang*/ 'khor lo sgyur ba dang*/ de dag mngal na yod pa'i yum dang*/ byams pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa med pa dang*/ 'gog pa dang*/ 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug la zhugs pa sogs so// gsum pa de dag 'jal byed kyi tshad ni/ gzugs kyi chung mtha' rdul phra rab dang*/ ming gi mtha' yi ge dang*/ dus kyi mtha' skad cig yin pa de dag las rtsam nas yul gyi tshad ni/ phra rab rdul dang*/ rdul phran dang*/

de bzhin du lcags rdul dang*/ chu rdul dang*/ ri bong rdul dang*/ lug rdul dang*/ glang rdul dang*/ nyi zer gyi rdul dang*/ sro ma dang*/ de las byung ba shig dang*/ de bzhin du nas dang*/ sor tshigs rnams ni gong nas gong du bdun sgyur (211) bar shes par bya'o// sor mo nyi shu bzhi la khru dang*/ khru bzhi las ni gzhu gang ste/ 'dom gang ngo*// gzhu de lnga brgya rnams la rgyang grags te/ de tsam grong nas 'phags pa la dgon par 'dod la/ rgyang grags de brgyad la dpag tshad ces bya'o// lung rnam 'byed du/ snga phyi rnams drug 'gyur dang*/ gdags par rdul phra rab bdun la nyi zer gyi rdul du bshad pa'ang yod do// dus kyi tshad la lo'i tshad ni/ dus mtha'i skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la/ de'i skad cig go /de'i skad cig drug bcu la thang gcig go /thar gcig sum cu la yud tsam ste/ de dang nyin zhag dang*/ zla ba gsum gong nas gong du sum cu sgyur ro// zhag mi thub drug dang bcas pa'i zla ba bcu gnyis la log gcig ste/ zhag mi thub ni dgun dang*/ dpyid dang*/ dbyar rnams kyi zla ba phyed gnyis 'das nas/ zla ba phyed ni lus pa na mkhas pas zhag mi thub pa dor/ zhes pa ltar te/ dgun ni mgo can (212) nas rtsom par dus tshigs ston pa'i gzhung khungs ma kun mthun pas/ rgyal dang*/ dbo dang*/ sa ga dang*/ chu stod dang*/ khrums dang*/ smin drug can rnams kyi gnam stong chad pa na zhag nyer dgu zla ba'o// de nas mar ngo sngon 'gro ltar na/ ston dpyid 'bring thub cing*/ dbyar dgun 'bring mi thub la/ yar ngo sngon 'gro dang sgo stun na ming de las zlog pa yin yang de dag gnad du ma shes na bab bcol du 'gyur ro// bskal pa'i tshad ni/ bskal pa mang po bar bskal 'jig 'chags kyi bskal pa sogs bshad pa de la 'jig bskal ni/ dmyal ba'i srid pa gsar skye med pa nas snod zad pa'i bar te/ sems can 'jig pa ni/ dmyal ba las zad pa rnams 'gro ba gzhan du skye la/

ma zad pa rnams zhing gzhan gyi dmyal bar skye/ zhing 'dir gcig kyang med pa 'jig la/ dud 'gro dang yi dwags kyang de dang 'dra'o// rgya mtsho'i dud 'gro sngar 'jig ste/ mi yul pa rnams mi dang lhan cig du'o// gling (213) gsum gyi mi gang rung res chos nyid kyis thob pa'i bsam gtan dang po skyed de/ gzhan rnams kyang de'i rjes su slob cing*/ shi na tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye la/ sgra mi snyan pa la chags bral gyi lam med pas 'dod lhar skye ste/ 'dod lha rnams bsam gtan dang po thob pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye la/ de rnams kyi bsam gtan gnyis pa chos nyid kyis thob pas 'od gsal du skye/ zhing chus 'jig pa na bsam gtan gsum pa dang*/ rlung gis 'jig pa na bzhi pa thob ste/ de dag tu skye bo/ de la bar bskal bcu dgu'o// snod 'jig pa ni/ char pa med pas rtsa shing dang*/ sman rnams nyi ma 'di nyid kyi bsregs te/ nyi ma gzhan drug 'di bas bzhi 'gyur bas tsha zhing*/ gnyis pas ldeng kha che chung dang*/ gsum pas chu bo che chung dang*/ bzhi pas mtsho ma drod pa dang*/ lnga pa dang drug pa'i phyogs kyis rgya mtsho chen po skem la/ drug pa dang bdun pas ri rab dang sa chen po bsregs te/ nyi ma'i dkyil (214) 'khor ni sems can gyis stong ba'o// de las me lce rlung gi khyer nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bsregs la/ de'i tshe 'od gsal ba'i lha gzhan pa rnams me de byung bar dogs nas skrag pa la/ lha rgan po srid pa chags 'jig la mkhas pa rnams kyis grogs po rnams ma 'jigs zhig me lce 'di ni/ sngon yang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stongs pa ste bsregs nas/ de nyid du med par gyur te/ zhes dbugs 'byin to// lha de dag lus shin du 'dra yang*/ de ltar du 'du shes tha dad du gyur pas na/ lus gcig cing 'du shes tha dad pa'o// zhes mdo sde pa 'dod do// des na mdor sa chen po dang*/

ri rab kyang bsregs te/ tshig pa na du ba yang med/ thal ba'i lhag ma yang med de/ dge slong rnams 'du byed thams cad ni/ de ltar mi rtag pa/ mi rten pa/ yid rten du mi rung ba'o// zhes bka' stsal to// chus 'jig pa na bsam gtan gnyis pa nyid las byung ba'i chus snod lan (215) tsha bzhin du zhu nas/ chu de yang med par 'gyur ro// rlung gis 'jig pa na/ bsam gtan gsum pa nyid las byung ba'i rlung khams kyis te/ rlung nad kyis lus skam pa ltar snod med par byed cing*/ rlung de yang med par 'gyur ro// des na bdags par de ltar lhun po rgya mtsho che dwang ba// de bzhin mtho ris zad gyur shes nas ni// skye bo dam pa rnams kyis bsten pa yi// 'phags pa'i gnas la rtag tu blo gzhol cig /ces so// 'chags pa'i bskal pa ni/ dang po rlung 'chags pa nas/ dmyal ba'i srid pa 'chags pa'i bar du bar bskal nyi shu'o// yang rlung gi zhig na bsam gtan gsum pa sogs dang*/ chus zhig na gnyis pa sogs dang*/ mes zhig na dang po nas 'dod lha'i gzhal yas khang rnams sprul par 'chags so// de nas snod kyi snga ltas rlung 'jam bu langs pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor du 'gyur zhing*/ de nas gser gyi snying (216) po can gyi sprin las char chen po 'bab pas chu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ de'i stod rlung gi mthas zhing*/ sra bar byas pas sa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ de'i steng du sprin khams sna tshogs pa can las char babs pas rgya mtsho 'byung ste/ snying rje pad ma dkar por/ chu'i nang na gser gyi pad ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa stong snang nas/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis ci'i ltas yin rtags pas bskal pa 'di las sangs rgyas stong 'byung ba'i ltas su shes te/ bskal pa 'di ni bzang po'o// zhes bka' stsal to// de'i khams bzang po rnams rlung gi srubs pas ri rab dang*/ 'bring rnams srubs pas gser gyi ri bdun dang*/

ngan pa rnams las gling dang*/ gling phran dang*/ khor yug gi ri rnams 'byung ste/ de la bar bskal gcig go /de rnams kyang bye brag pa 'jig rten 'jig dus rdul phra rab rtag pa ma zhig pa rnams las skye'o// zhes zer te/ de dgag pa 'brel par lta'o// sa ston sde pa'i mdor/ (217) 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan nas/ sa bon khyer te 'ong ngo zhes 'byung mod/ las las skyes pa'i rlung nus pa khyad par can las byung ngo zhes gnas so// sems can 'chags pa ni/ bzhi pa nas shi nas gsum bar dang*/ de nas shi ba gnyis 'ang skye ba yod cing*/ bskal pa 'di la ni 'od gsal gyi lha tshe dang bsod nams dang las zad pa zhig shi ste/ tshangs pa chen por skyes pa la/ shed bdag du rtog go /de skyo ste grogs skyes na ci ma rung mnyam pa dang*/ yang 'od gsal nas tshangs par skyes pa la shed las skyes bu rtog go /de bzhin du 'od gsal nas 'dod lha dang*/ byang nas nub dang*/ shar dang gling 'di'i mir rim gyi skye la/ sems can pa gang rung gcig bdag po nyor ba'i las nyon mongs can gyis dmyal bar gshin rje'i rgyal por skye zhing*/ yi dwags dang*/ dud 'gro dang*/ dmyal ba 'chags te/ de la bar bskal 'chags (218) pa rdzogs pa dang*/ gnas pa rtsom pa dang*/ gnad med par gcig skyes pa dang*/ tshe lo dpag med nas 'grib pa rtsom pa dang dus mnyam mo// gnas pa'i bskal ba ni/ bar gyi bskal pa dpag med nas 'grib pa nas rtsam nas tshe lo bcu par gyur pa'i bar du ste/ ya thog ring mo zhes grags la/ 'grib tshul 'og du 'chad do// yang de nas yar skye ba dang*/ mar 'grib pa zung re'i bskal pa ma thog las gzhan bco brgyad de/ snying rje pad dkar du/ tshe lo bcu pa'i tshe/ rje btsun byams pa khru gang pa zhig byon nas/ lus che ba'i rgyu mi dge ba spangs pa'o// zhes gsungs pas/ lus gsum spangs pa nyi shu pa dang*/ lnga bcu pa dang*/ brgya pa dang*/

ngag gi bzhi spangs pas nyis stong pa dang*/ yid kyi gsum spangs pas bzhi khri pa dang*/ pha dang mar gzung bas brgyad khri par 'phel te/ snye ma re la bre bzhi bzhi dang*/ bu mo lo lnga brgya lon ste/ bag mar gtong (219) ba sogs du mar bka' stsal to// yang yar skye zhing 'phel ba ni/ bar bskal gcig yin te/ ma thog ring mo zhes grags so// yar skye rnams ci tsam du skye zhe na/ yar 'phel bcu dgu po de rnams tshe brgyad khri'i bar du skye'o// thog mtha'i rkyang pa dang*/ bar gyi khug pa re dus mnyam la/ lo ji snyed re la 'phel 'grib byed ce na/ kha cig lo brgya re zhing gcig 'phel/ gcig 'grib ces dang*/ ngur mig pa rkyang pa la lo nyis brgya re zhing lo re re'o// zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad de/ yang sos kyi zhag gnyis ni/ mnar med kyi bar bskal bas ring bar thal te/ mi lo sa ya bco brgyad yod pa'i phyir ro// de yang bar gyi khug pa la ni/ sa ya bcu drug la nyis stong chad pa las med par 'gyur bas so// des na lo ji snyed re la 'phel ba dang*/ 'grib pa mi shes shing*/ dge sdig spyod pa stobs che chung gis lo 'phel 'grib stobs che chung du 'gyur ro// tshul (220) de ltar 'jig rten chags pa 'di ni bar kyi bskal pa nyi shur gnas pa yin no// bskal chen skyes mchog byung tshul dang bcas pa ni/ bskal gnas kyi dus de dang*/ 'chags pa dang*/ 'jig pa dang*/ zhig cing stongs nas 'dug pa gsum bar bskal nyi shur mnyam pa ste/ zhig pa'i tshe 'phel 'grib mi 'jug kyang dus mnyam par ci zhing*/ bar bskal nyi shu po de rnams sdom pa brgyad bcu la ni/ bskal pa chen po zhes bya'o// bskal chen de grangs med gsum du bsags pa las sangs rgyas 'byung ngo*// grangs med ni/ grangs rten med min gyi/ lung sil bur/ grangs kyi gnas gzhan drug cu gsungs pa'i tha ma ste/ de bsdus na/ gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum dang*// sa ya bye ba dung 'gyur rnams// zla bo med pa'i grangs su bshad// chen po zla ba'o dang bcas ni// ther 'bum phrag khrig rab bkram dang*// gtam bkrigs mi 'khrugs khyad phyin dang*// pa stengs deng 'dren mtha'

(221) snang dang*// rgyu rig 'od mdzes dbang po dang*// legs byin rtogs 'gros 'bying rdul dang*// brgya rtags stobs 'khor rta shes dang*// rnam 'byung stobs mig nyi shu gcig /grangs med kun kyang bcu 'gyur bsgre// bar nas brgyad ni ma rnyed pa// rang gi ming gang rung bas gzhug /ces pa ste/ grangs med de gsum nyan thos sde pa tshogs lam nyid du rdzogs par 'dod do// ci sangs rgyas yar 'phel lam/ mar 'grib nam gyi tshe 'byung zhe na/ mar 'grib pa'i brgyad khri pa nas/ brgya pa'i bar la sangs rgyas de 'byung ste/ yar yar 'phel la ni gdul bya rnams skyo ba dka' ba dang*/ brgya pa man chad la tshe dang*/ dus dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ lta ba dang*/ sems can gyi snyigs ma lnga shin du chas che bas so// rang rgyal dus gang du 'byung zhe na/ rang sangs rgyas rnams yar 'phel mar 'grib gnyis la (222) 'byung ngo*// rang rgyal la bse ru lta bu ni/ bskal chen brgya ru byang chub kyi tshogs la spyod pa'i rang byang chub ste/ lam kun stan gcig la skyed pas rgyud shin du smin dgos pas so// tshogs spyod ni/ lam lhag ma skyes sla bas de tsam mi dgos so// 'khor lo sgyur ba nam 'byung zhe na/ 'khor los rgyal srid sgyur ba'i ngang tshul can 'byung ba ni/ tshe lo dpag med nas stong phrag brgyad bcu'i bar la ste/ de las mi phyi ste/ de man chad du phun tshogs mi rdzogs pas so// stobs kyi 'khor lo sgyur ba ni/ de las phyis kyang 'byung ste chos rgyal mya ngan med bzhin no// snga ma la ni rin po che bdun phrag gsum las mchog gi rin po che sna bdun ni/ de tshes bco lnga la mgo dang bcas pa bkrus nas bsnyen gnas bya zhing blon po'i tshogs kyis skor te 'dug pa na/ shar phyogs na lha'i 'khor brgya sbyin gyi tshig gis las thams cad pas byas (223) pa rgyal po chen po bzhis/ rgyal po la bstan pa 'byung la/

de yang gzo bos byas pa min pa las kyis sprul pa yin no// de yang dran pa nyer bzhag du/ gser las byas pa dpag tshad lnga brgya pa rtsibs stong yod pas mdzes pa/ nam mkha' la dpag tshad 'bum du nyi ma gcig gis 'gro ba/ gling bzhi dang lha'i ris su'ang glang po sogs kun nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ rgyal pos mi thos pa des thos par byed pa 'dren pa su yang med par byed pa'o// rgyal po shi nas sgo khang du zug nas sdod de bu la mi phan no// nor bu ni mi chen po'i rla tsam pa/ zur brgyad pa ste/ mtshan mo dpag tshad brgyar 'od 'byung ba/ nyi ma tsha na bsil ba 'byung ba/ skom na chu yan lag brgyad ldan 'byung ba/ rgyal pos ci bsam pa 'byung ba/ 'od sna tshogs 'byung ba/ dpag tshad brgyar nad med par byed cing*/ las kun la ji ltar (224) 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'byung ba/ klu ngan pas ser ba sogs 'bebs mi nus pa/ mya ngan dang g.yang sa'i yul kun ljon pa dang*/ mtshe 'u sogs phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba/ mi dus min du mi 'chi zhing*/ dud 'gro gang gis kyang mi gnod pa/ sbrul dang ne'u le lta bu'i mi mthun pas rgyang mi gnod pa zhig dbang pos gter ro// bzhag par ni/ klu'am rgyal chen bzhis 'bul bar bshad do// btsun mo ni lus las tsan+dan dang*/ kha la ut+pal la'i dri 'byung ba/ reg na nyon mongs pa med par 'gyur ba/ gling de'i bkres skom dang*/ mya ngan dang bral bar byed pa/ rgyal pos mthong na grang dus su dro zhing*/ dro dus na bsil bar byed pa/ mi kun gyi ma dang sring mo ltar mthong ba bsam pa dang mthun cing*/ bu mang po btsa' ba/ khyim thab bud med gzhan la 'gro na phrag dog med pa/ khyim thab med kyang 'dod yod lnga'i (225) dbang du mi 'gyur ba zhig blon pos 'bul te/ de ni shi nas lhar skye'o// gzhag par ni bu mi 'byung zhing*/ rgyal po'i sngar 'chi bar bshad do// blon po ni bya ba ma bslab kyang shes nas/

byed pa mi dge ba spangs shing*/ nyon mongs pa med pa sems can kun la pha ma ltar phan pa'o// glang po ni cang shes shing*/ bka' nyan pas pha rol las rgyal bar byed pa/ glang po che stong gi stobs yod pa chu dang*/ skam dang*/ bar snang gsum la g.yul 'gyed pa/ nyi ma gcig la 'dzam bu gling lan gsum du 'khor ba/ skud pas kyang bkrir rung zhing*/ rgyal pos zhon pa'i tshe bskul mi dgos pa dal gyis 'gro ba zhig dbang pos ster ro// sa 'grel du/ glang po rab brtan gyi bu tha chung ngo zhes so// rta mchog ni ku mu ta dang*/ dung ltar dkar ba glang po dang yon tan mtshungs pa gcig dbang pos ster ro// bzhag par ni rta'i rgyal (226) po sprin gyi shugs can gyi bu tha chung lus sngo la/ mgo nag po ste/ de yang nub phyogs kyi gling phran khang bu can na/ rta de rta'i rgyal po brgya stong gi skor ba yod pa la/ brgya byin gyi 'khor lo sgyur ba 'jig rten du 'byung ba shes par gyis la rta rin chen thong cig ces bsgo bas bu thu bo gtor zhing de rgyal po'i sngar shi na de'i 'og ma stong la/ rgyal po sngar shi na rta rang gi gnas su ldog pa dang*/ glang po lus dkar la mgo sngo ba'i gdong ldog kyang rta dang 'dra bar bshad do// khyim bdag ni bang mdzod gser dngul sogs kyis 'gengs cing*/ rgyal po'i bka' nyan pa skye bo kun la mi gnod pa'o// zhes so// rgyal bu sras su/ khyim bdag ni mdzod kyi spyan dang*/ blon po ni dpung gi spyan lta bu'o// zhes 'chad do// nye ba'i rin po che sna bdun yang*/ mdo de nyid du/ ral gri ni rgyal po dang*/ 'gal ba byed 'dod pa der song ste/ ma btab kyang kun gyis (227) 'dud pa'o// dmag dpon ni dgra'i tshogs ma lus pa 'joms pa'i nus pa yod kyang gzhan la mi 'tshe ba'i skyes bu'o// dpe la lar 'byung ngo*/ lpags pa ni chur dpag tshad bcu pa/ zheng du lnga pa char chu'i mi rlan zhing rlung gis mi skyod la/

grang na dro zhing*/ dro na bsil bar byed pa/ bud med mi sdug pa mi mthong ba/ nyi zla'i 'od mthong ba/ klu'i lpags pa rgya mtsho nas byung ba/ gar 'gro sar blon pos khyer te/ khang pa'i bya ba byed pa zhig tshong pas 'bul lo// khang pa ni chur dpag tshad bcu gnyis pa/ zheng du bdun pa rin po che dang zla ba dang*/ rgyu skar lta bar 'dod na/ khang pa der 'ong ba/ rmi lam dge ba mthong ba/ grang na dro zhing tsha na bsil ba'i rlung ldang ba/ der lha mo 'ongs nas rol mo byed pa'o// gos ni 'jam la dri mi 'gos pa/ gyon na tsha grang ngal dub kyi mi gnod (228) pa/ mes mi 'tshig cing*/ mtshon gyi mi chod pa'o// tshal ni rgyal pos der phyin pa dang*/ tshal gyi mthus bu mo dang*/ bya sogs song ste/ 'dod yon la spyod pa'o// mal cha ni bsam gtan byed na rnam par grol cing*/ blo gsal ba dang*/ kun nas nyon mongs pa mi skye'o// l+h+wam ni gyon na chu la mi 'bying ba/ yud tsam gyis dpag tshad brgyar 'gro ba la'ang ngal ba med pa'o// rin chen bdun ni/ gser dngul bai ḍūr+ya shel spug rdo'i snying po/ mu tig dmar po'o// mi stong thub pa'i bu stong dang*/ dgra zil gyis gnon pa mda' gzhu'ang 'byung ngo*// 'khor lo sgyur ba de yang bzhi ste/ gser dang*/ dngul dang*/ zangs dang*/ lcags kyi 'khor lo can no// de bzhi rnams gling gcig dang gnyis dang*/ gsum dang*/ bzhi la mas rim bzhin du dbang byed la/ mdor gtso bo smos pa'i phyir gser gyi 'khor lo can kho na gsungs so// lhan gcig tu 'khor lo sgyur ba gnyis (229) mi 'byung te/ 'gran zla med pa'i las bsags pas so// dper na sangs rgyas bzhin te/ 'di la bye brag smra ba/ zhing kun du sangs rgyas re re las mi 'byung zer ro// phal chen sde pa sogs zhing gcig du mi 'byung bar 'dod de/ de theg chen gyi mdo bying dang mthun no// de bzhi pha rol po las ji ltar rgyal bar byed ce na/

gser 'khor can ni/ khams kyi rgyal phran rnams kyis phas bsu nas 'dud cing bka' gnyan to// dngul 'khor can ni/ de rnams kyi thad du rang nyid 'gro bas 'dud la/ sar ni pho nya btang bas 'dud ces so// zangs 'khor can ni song ste g.yul gsham pas 'dud do// lcags 'khor can ni song ste/ phan tshun rtsams te/ bzas pas 'du byed/ rgyal yang gsod pa med cing*/ rgyal nas sems can rnams dge ba bcu la 'god pas de rnams nges par lhar skye'o// bzhag par/ dang po 'khor lo'i rjes su dpung dang bcas pa byon (230) nas gzhug pa na/ de thos ma thag rgyal phran rnams 'ongs nas 'dud la/ gnyis pa la thos ma thag du min par/ 'degs pa'i tshe 'ongs nas 'dud par bshad do// rgyal po 'di rnams ni skyes bu chen po'i mtshan so gnyis kyis kyang rgyal po gzhan las khyad zhugs te/ 'on kyang thub pa'i mtshan ni rang gi yul na ma 'grus par gnas cing 'od gsal la/ cha shas rdzogs pas khyad par du 'phags pa yin no// 'di'i rgyu ni byams pa sgom pa dang*/ mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba sogs su gsungs so// grangs ma thog ring mo 'grib tshul ni/ ci bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams kyang rgyal po dang bcas sam zhe na min te/ sngar bskal ba chags ma thag gi sems can mi rnams gzugs can gyi lha bzhin te/ yid las byung ba yan lag dang*/ nying lag dang dbang po tshang ba rang 'od can nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ zas su dga' ba za ba/ tshe dpag med thub pa'o// de nas rim gyis ro la chags pa ste/ sa'i bcud (231) kha dog mar gsar 'dra ba/ ro sbrang rtsi ma skol ba ltar mngar ba/ sa'i steng chus khyab pa la rlung gis bkris mar byas pa byung ste de sems can skam chags can gcig gis sor mo'i rtse mos myangs te zos pas mi gzhan rnams kyang de ltar byed la/ kham zas za ba'i dang po'o// des lus sra zhing ljid la 'od nub nas mun pa 'byung ba dang*/ nyi zla 'byung zhing lha'i bu nyi ma ni ri rab kyi lho'am/

byang gi ngos gang du mthong ba der song nas 'jug go /de nas sa zhag ser po sbrang rtsi'i ro can 'byung ba'ang myangs pas nub cing smre sngags 'don te/ de nas ldum bu'i tshal snar po sbrang rtsi'i ro can yang myangs pas nub bo// de nas ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sa lu shun pa dang*/ phub ma med pa byung ba/ zos pas rgyu mthun 'byung ba'i gshang gci'i lam pho mo'i dbang po dang bcas pa 'byung ste/ sngon goms pas tshul min yid byed kyi 'khrig pa byed cing*/ de la smad pas (232) de'i phyed du khyim byed de/ mi dge ba dang khyim gyi dang po'o// sa lu nang bza' bya nang*/ nub gza' bya nub len pa na/ gcig gi le los sogs 'jog byas pa ltar/ kun gyis byas pas/ rngas pa mi skye'o// de rnams zhing dgos te/ rang gi la bdag du 'dzin pa dang*/ bcas nas gzhan gyi la rku'o// de dgag pa'i ched du 'dus nas de rnams kyis mi khyad par can zhig zhing dpon du skos nas rang rang gi ston thog gi drug cha btab ste/ de ni mang pos bkur ba zhes pa rgyal rigs kyi dang po'o// de nas rgyud de/ ston pa 'di dang sgra gcan 'dzin gyi bar ro// der kha cig yongs su 'dzin pa sdug bsngal gyi rtsa bar rig ste/ dgon par spyil por 'dug cing*/ zan 'dod pa na grong du 'jug pa la phyi rol yid do// zhes brjod pas bram ze dang*/ kha cig gis bsam gtan dang dben pa ma gtogs te/ sngags kyi gzhung dang*/ rig byed sbyor ba las 'dun na 'don dang*/ de'ang ma gtogs nas grong du zhugs te/ (233) khang pa sgo bzhi par 'khod nas sbyin pa byin no// zhes pa las grong mi 'byung ngo*// de nas rje rigs dang dmangs rigs 'byung ngo*// de nas phyis rgyal po gang rung gcig gis chags pas mi rnams la ma dgos pas rku po mang du byung ste/ des de rnams bsod cing*/ der bdag gis ma rkus so// zhes rdzun smra'o// de nas mi dge ba'i las kyis lam lhag ste/

'phel bas tshe khad kyis thung du song bas/ mthar tshe lo bcu par 'gyur ro// de'i dus su tshe rgud pa ring na lo bcu dang*/ lus rgud pa mtho gang ba dang*/ chang pa gang dang*/ yo byad rgud pa zas kyi mchog khri rgo dang*/ gos kyi mchog skra'i la ba dang*/ rgyan gyi mchog mtshon te/ 'o ma dang zho yod kyang mar mi 'byung*/ til yod kyang til mar mi 'byung*/ sbrang bu yod kyang sbrang rtsi mi 'byung*/ bur shing dang*/ de'i khu ba yod kyang bu ram mi 'byung*/ lan tshwa ye med do// bu mo zla ba lnga lon nas bag ma gtong pa sogs (234) du ma bshad do// 'gribs pa mthar byed tshul ni/ de lta bu'i bar gyi bskal pa de ni/ mtshon dang*/ nad dang*/ mu ge'i bskal pa rnams kyis mthar phyin te/ tshe lo bcu pa der/ mi rnams rngon pas ri dwags mthong ba ltar gnod sems mi zad par gyur te/ gang blangs pa mtshon cha rnon por gyur nas gsod res byed la/ gsad tshad dmyal bar skye'o// nad ni mi ma yin rnams kyis/ yam nad gsor mi rung ba gtong ste/ phal cher 'chi'o// mu ge ni/ mi dge ba'i nyes pas lhas char mi 'bebs pas/ phan tshun 'dus te 'chi bas dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i skye bo'i don du sa bon gab rtse'i nang du 'jog pa gab rtse dang*/ shi ma thag rus gong dkar por 'gyur bas dang*/ rus gong dkar po bsdus te skol nas mthungs pas rus gong dkar po ba dang*/ thur mas zas 'gyed pas dang*/ thur mas rtsig khung nas 'bru brus shing chur skol te 'thungs pas/ thur mas mtsho ste gsum mo// gang (235) nyi ma 'ga' srog gcod spangs pa dang*/ dge 'dun la a ru ra 'ga' dang*/ bsod snyoms 'ga' gus par phul ba de/ mtshon dang*/ nad dang*/ mu ge la mi skye bar bshad do// yang de gsum ji srid cig 'byung zhe na/ mtshon zhag bdun bdun dang*/ nad dang*/ zhag dang*/ zla ba bdun bdun dang*/ mu ge de gnyis dang*/ lo bdun tshar re rnams 'byung ste go rim bzhin no// de'i tshe shar nub gnyis su'ang*/

gnod sems tsam dang*/ mdog ngan zhing nyams chung ba dang*/ bkres skom tsam 'byung ngo*// zhag bar bcu pa re la/ re re las mi 'byung bar bshad do// 'jig pa'i bskal pa khyad par du bshad pa ni/ bskal pa 'jig pa ni du zhe na/ nyi ma bdun gyi me dang*/ char pa'i chu dang*/ rlung rab tu 'khrugs pa rnams kyis 'jig pa rnams ni gsum pa yin te/ bsam gtan gnyis pa dang*/ (236) sogs pas gsum dang*/ bzhi pa ni 'jig pa de gsum rnams kyi rtse mo ste lhag ma yin te/ go rim bzhin no// ci'i phyir bsam gtan dang po sogs gsum me chu/ rlung de gsum gyi 'jig ce na/ snod de dang de'i sems can gyi nang gi skyon dang po na rtog dpyod me lta bu dang*/ gnyis pa na/ dga' ba chu lta bu dang*/ gsum pa na dbugs 'byung rngub kyi rlung yod pa dang*/ chos mthun pa'i phyir ro// bsam gtan bzhi pa na/ 'jig pa de gsum med de/ nang gi skyon dang*/ bral bas mi g.yo ba'i phyir te/ bral tshul 'og du 'chad do// 'o na bzhi pa'i snod rtag gam zhe na/ mi rtag ste/ bzhi pa de'i gzhal med khang rnams skar ma ltar chad nas ma 'grel bas na/ sems can dang bcas nas 'byung zhing 'jig pa'i phyir ro// 'jig pa gsum go rim ji ltar 'byung zhe na me'i bar med pas bdun no// de'i rjes su chu'i sa lan gcig go /rim pa de ltar 'byung ba'i chu thal nas slar yang me yi bdun no// sar ni

(237) mes gcig du bshad do// de nas ni 'jug du rlung gi 'jig pa gcig yin te/ de ltar mes 'jig pa lnga bcu rtsa drug dang*/ chus bdun dang rlung gi gcig ni bskal chen re bzhi ste/ dge rgyas kyi lha'i tshe tshad do// de yang re gsum dang nga brgyad la der nye bas btags pa ste/ snod 'chags 'jig gi bar bskal gnyis dang*/ stongs pa'i nyi shu/ de'i tshe tshad du mi rung bas so// 'od gsal ba'ang*/ bskal chen bdun dang*/ bar bskal nga brgyad la/ brgyad du btags pas te/ rgyu mtshan snga ma ltar ro// tshangs chen pa'i yang snod chags 'jig gi bar bskal gnyis/ de'i tshe tshad du mi rung bas bar bskal nga brgyad la drug cur btags pa'o// chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa shes bya'i mdzod las 'jig rten bstan pa zhes pa gnas gsum pa'i 'grel pa'o// //bzhi pa las bstan pa las mdor bstan pa ni/ sems can dang snod kyi 'jig rten rnam pa du ma de sus byas zhe na/ (238) byed pa po su yang med kyi sems can gyi las las 'jig rten bzang ngan 'dren pa sna tshogs skyes so// gnyis pa la bstan bshad gnyis kyi dang po ni/ las de ci zhig ce na/ las de ni mdo las/ sems pa dang*/ de byas pa bsam pa'i las su 'jog go /rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ lus ngag gi las kyi rang bzhin/ las gsum spyi'i ngo bo/ bye brag rig byed min pa'i rnam bzhag go /dang po la rnam par rig byed dang*/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa gnyis las/ rnam par rig byed kyi las la lus kyi rnam par rig byed ni/ sems kyi dbang gis lus de lta de ltar gnas pa'i dbyibs rdzas su yod pa zhig du bye brag smra ba 'dod de/ de'ang rnam smin dang rgyas byung min gyi 'phral gsar du skyes pa'i rgyu mthun skyes so// 'on kyang rnam smin gyi lus gseb du zhugs pas/ lus che ru mi 'gyur zhing*/ 'phral bas lus lci zhing*/ 'khregs par yang mi 'gyur ro// zhes so// gnas

(239) ma bu pa blo dang*/ sgra dang*/ klog sogs skad cig mar 'dod kyang*/ 'dus byas phal cher skad cig mar mi 'dod pas 'dir yang*/ lus kyi rig byed yul gang du skyes pa de nyid ma zhig par yul gzhan du 'pho ba'i 'gro ba yin te/ lus g.yo ba lus kyi las yin pas so// zhes zer ro// de ni rigs pa min te/ gang gi phyir na/ 'dus byas thams cad skad cig ma yin pas gang du skyes pa de nyid du 'jig gi ma zhig bar yul gzhan du mi 'pho bas so// 'dus byas thams cad skad cig mar grub na/ de lta yin mod/ 'di ma grub bo zhe na/ grub ste/ 'dus byas rnams nges par phyis rgyu gzhan med par 'jig pa'i phyir blo bzhin no// gal te 'jig pa rgyu gzhan dang ldan na skye ba rgyu la ltos pa bzhin du rgyu gzhan med pa las dngos po 'ga' yang 'jig par mi 'gyur ba zhig na sgra blo sgyu gzhan med par 'jig pa mthong bas 'jig pa rgyu gzhan (240) la ltos pa mi 'gal te/ 'jig pa la rgyu gzhan nges par dgos na/ dngos po rnams ni/ khyod phyis rgyu med pa las 'ga' yang 'jig par mi 'gyur bar thal/ khyod 'jig pa phyis rgyu la nges par ltos dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ sgra blo sogs phyis rgyu med par 'jig pa tshad mas mthong ngo*// gal te shing sogs 'jig pa me'i rgyu las byung na/ skyed byed kyi rgyu nyid yang phyis 'jig pa po'i rgyur thal bar 'gyur te/ phyis mi sogs kyi rgyu byas te 'jig par 'dod pa 'gog pa'o// des na dngos po rnams skye ba'i rgyu nyid las 'jig pa'i ngang can du skyes pas skad cig par grub pa'i phyir 'gro ba med la/ yul gzhan du 'dab chags par 'byung ba la 'gro bar mngon pa'i nga rgyal byed par zad do// 'dir mdo sde pa ni dbyibs rdzas su med de/ kha dog gi gnas tshul la 'dogs pas so// gal te dbyibs ni/ mig dang dbang po gnyis kyi

(241) bzung bar thal bar 'gyur te/ mthong ba dang reg pa gnyis ka las ring po'i snyam du shes pa'i phyir 'dod mi nus te/ skye mched cig dbang po gzugs can gnyis kyis 'dzin pa mi srid pas so// yang de ni thogs bcas rdzas grub du med de/ rdul phra rab la med pas so// khyab ste/ thogs bcas rdzas grub ni rdul phra rab la yod pas khyab pas so// des na lus kyi rig byed kyang*/ kha dog gi bkod pa la btags pa'i lus kyi dbyibs so// yang ngag gi rnam par rig byed ni/ ngag gi rang bzhin gyi sgra ste/ rang kun nas slong ba'i sems rig par byed pas de skad do// zhes pa sgar ba'o// rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs la sgrub byed ni/ bye brag smra ba dag na re/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs ni rdzas su yod de/ mdo las rten yod thogs bcas dang*/ rten med thogs bcas dang*/ rten med thogs med de/ (242) gzugs rnam gsum gsungs pa'i gsum pa ni/ 'di min pa med pa dang*/ de med kyi gzugs gsungs pa ni/ zag med kyi sdom pa kho na yin pa dang*/ rdzas dang rdzas las byung ba min pa'i bsod nams ni/ yid gzhan dang ldan kyang 'phel bar gsungs pa'ang 'di yin te/ rig byed dang sems pa ni/ rgyun du mi 'byung bas dang*/ srog gcod sogs rang gi ma byas par gzhan byed du bcug pas srog chad pa'i tshe/ rang la las lam gyi dngos gzhi 'byung bar gsungs pa'ang 'di min te/ de'i tshe rig byed sems pa ni dge bar yod srid pas so// gzhan yang sogs pas bsdus pa/ 'di min pa chos kyi skye mched gzugs can med pas de gzugs can min pa kho nar ston par 'gyur ba la skye mched bcu gzugs dang*/ yid gzugs min par ma bstan pas dang*/ mnyam bzhag du rig byed mi 'byung bas yang dag pa'i ngag sogs gsum med par 'gyur ba las/ lam gyi yan lag brgyad bshad par ldan par bshad pa dang*/ (243)

yid nyon mongs dang ldan pa'i tshe/ dge ba med pas so thar gyi sdom pa med par 'gyur ba dang*/ spong ba ni 'chal tshul gyi gegs byed pas chu lon du gsungs na med pa ni chu lon du mi 'os pas so// zhe'o// mdo sde pa ni/ de dag rdzas su med de sdig pa spong bar khas blangs nas de mi phyed pa tsam gyi phyir dang*/ 'das pa'i 'byung ba rdzas su med pa la/ rten nas 'dogs pa'i phyir dang*/ gzugs kyi mtshan nyid med pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// rgyu ni 'di nyid rnam par rig byed pas phra bas de'i rgyu las gzhan pa'i 'byung ba skyed la/ dus ni 'dod par rtogs pa'i rnam rig byed min ni/ skad cig ma dang po'i sdom sogs nod pa'i tshe gzhi'i 'byung ba dang ltar ba la skye la/ de phyin chad ni/ 'jug cing 'phen pa'i rgyu'i gzhi'i 'byung ba (244) 'das pa re dang*/ rjes su 'jug cing rten pa'i rgyu da ltar ba'i 'byung ba dang*/ gnyis las skye ste/ dang po 'khor lo 'bul byed lag pa dang*/ gnyis pa rten pa gzhi lta bu'o// gzugs can bzhi ni/ gzhi'i 'byung ba da ltar ba kho na las skye bar 'dod do// sa ni zag bcas kyi lus dang*/ ngag gi las ni/ 'dod pa nas bsam gtan bzhi pa'i bar rang rang gis sa'i 'byung ba rnams rgyur byas nas skye la zag med kyi ni rten pa gang du skyes pa'i sa de'i 'byung ba las skyes pa yin te/ dang po 'khor lo 'bul byed lag pa dang*/ khams su ma rtogs pas nges pa med la/ rang gi 'byung ba med cing*/ 'bras gzugs yin pas 'byung ba'i stobs kyis skye bas so// ngo bo ni rnam par rig byed ma yin pa 'di nyid nang gi lus can min pas ma zin pa dang*/ dge mi dger nges cing*/ rdul bsags pa min pas rnam smin dang*/ rgyas byung min gyi rgyu mthun (245) las 'byung ba dang*/ sems can gyi rgyud du rtogs pas sems can du ston pa'o// lus kyi rig byed ni/

lus kyi 'byung ba dang*/ 'byung ba las min la/ so thar gyi spong ba re re la'ang 'byung ba bzhi tshan re las skye'o// ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa bsam gtan dang*/ zag med kyi sdom pa dag gi rgyu 'byung ba'ang sems kyi rjes 'brang yin pas ma zin pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis rgyas pa las 'byung ba ste/ de dag gi spong ba bdun ni 'byung ba bzhi tshan tha dad min pa cig las skye'o// gnyis pa la gsum gyi/ khyad par la gnyis te/ las gsum gyi ngo bo'i khyad par dang*/ kun slong gi khyad par ro// dang po ni rnam rig byed min la lung bstan dge mi dge min pa lung ma bstan med de/ lung ma bstan ni/ stobs chung bas rang 'gags nas kyang rgyun 'byung ba'i las stobs ldan 'phen mi nus pas so// de las gzhan rig byed dang (246) sems pa la ni dge mi dge lung ma bstan rnam pa gsum mo// mi dge ba'i las ni/ 'dod khams kho na la yod la/ gong ma gnyis na med de/ mi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams dang*/ ngo tsha med pa dang*/ khrel med pa gnyis spangs pas so// kun las btus su ni/ de gnyis nyon mongs kun dang ldan par bshad pas gong ma gnyis na'ang yod par mngon no// gzugs khams na dge ba'i rnam rig byed min yod de/ bsam gtan gyi sdom pa dang ldan pas so// 'ang gi sgras 'dod pa na dge ba'i rig byed min pa yod la/ gzugs med na ni gzugs med pas lus ngag gi sdom pa mngon gyur med do// rnam par rig byed ni/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa 'dod pa dang*/ bsam gtan dang po dag kho na na yod de/ kun slong rtog dpyod la ltos pas so// 'dod khams na sgrib pa'i rig byed med de/ yang ni gnyis pa sogs na rig byed med par ma zad pa'o// (247) gang gi phyir na/ kun slong med pa'i phyir te/ gnyis pa sogs na rtogs dpyod med la/ 'dod pa na sgom spang gi sgrib la/ lus ma bstan gyi sems med pas so// 'dod pa'i lta ba gnyis ni/

mthong yang kha nang ltas yin pas rig byed kun slong du mi rung la/ g.yo ni mi dge ba yin pas des slang na/ mi dge bar 'gyur bas so// des na sgrib pa'i rig byed ni/ tshangs pa'i 'jig tan kho na na ste/ tshangs chen pa/ g.yos kun nas slang ba'i ngag gi las yod pas so// ci kun slong kho na las dge mi dge min nam zhe na/ min gyi/ bzhi bzhir yod de/ re zhig dge ba'i gzhi la thar pa myang 'das ni/ sdug bsngal kun zhi bas mchog du bde ba'i phyir/ dam pa'i don du dge ba ste/ nad med pa bzhin gong mar ni de bzhin nyid du bshad do// dge rtsa gsum dang ngo tsha khrel yod ni/ skyes tsam nyid nas dge bar nges pas (248) bdag nyid de/ ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba ste/ 'phrod pa'i sman bzhin no// dad sogs bcu gcig du'ang ngo*// ngo bos dge ba de dang mtshungs ldan rnams ni de dang mtshungs ldan gyi dge ba ste/ sman dang sbyar ba'i btung ba bzhin no// de dag gi slang ba'i lus ngag gi bya ba dang*/ sogs pas skyes sogs dang*/ thob pa dang*/ snyoms 'jug gnyis ni/ kun nas slong ba'i dge ba ste/ btung ba de las byung ba'i 'o ma bzhin 'gog pa ni nyer bzhi'i dge bar yang ngo*// de rnams las zlog pa bzhin ni/ mi dge ba'i dbye ba ste/ 'khor ba dang*/ dug gsum ngo tsha khrel med dang bcas pa dang*/ de dang mtshungs ldan dang*/ des slang ba'i lus ngag gi las skye sogs thob pa dang bcas pa rim pa bzhin te/ nad dang mi 'phrod pa'i zas sman sogs dper bya'o// thob pa ni rjes su 'brel ba'i dge mi dger yang ngo*// 'on kyang 'khor (249) ba ni dge sogs kyang yod mod kyi mchog tu mi bde bas de dang der bzhag pa tsam ste/ gzhan ni mtshan nyid par 'dod do// mdo sde pa ltar na/ dang mtha' gnyis ka dge mi dger ma nges so// don dam par ni lung ma bstan pa rten pa nam mkha' dang*/ btags min gyi 'gog pa dag ste/

dbye ba gzhan gsum ni yod kyang ma bshad do// kun slong gi khyad par ni mthong spang rig byed slong byed min na/ thub pas log lta las log pa'i rtog pa dang*/ ngag dang*/ las kyi mtha' 'byung bar gsungs pa ji ltar zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ 'di ltar kun slong ni rnam pa gnyis te/ rgyu'i kun slong dang de dus kyi kun slong ngo*// de gnyis las dang po ni 'phen par byed pas rab tu gcig ste/ dang por 'jug par byed pa yin la/ gnyis pa ni rjes su ste/ bya ba'i dus su mthun par 'jug byed yin no// de la mthong bas spang bar (250) bya ba'i/ rnam shes 'khor bcas rtogs bcas ni/ rtog bcas su nges par rab tu 'jug byed yin la/ kha nang du ltas pas rjes su 'jug byed ni ma yin no// des na mdor ni/ rgyu'i kun slong la dgongs la 'dir 'dod pa na sgrib pa'i dus kyi kun slong med par bshad pa yin pas mi 'gal lo// yid kyi rnam shes sgom spang 'khor bcas ni rtogs bcas kyang yod/ kha phyir ltas kyang yod pas kun slong gnyis ka yod pa yin no// sgo lnga'i rnams shes 'khor bcas ni/ rtog med phyir ltas su nges pas/ rjes su 'jug byed kho na'o// de yang rab du 'jug byed dge tshogs gsum re re la rjes su gcig 'jug byed dge sogs rnam pa gsum gsum du'ang 'gyur bar dgu phrugs te/ dper na so thar gyi sdom pa rgyu'i kun slong gi bsam pa dge ba la dus kyi kun slong cho ga'i tshe'ang de dang ldan pa dang*/ zhe sdang dang bcas pa dang*/ spyod lam pa'i sems mngon du gyur pa na/ sdom pa (251) thob pa sogs lta bu'o// 'o na kun slong dang po gtso na 'dod pa na sgrib pa'i rig byed yod par 'gyur te/ rgyu'i kun slong lta ba yod pas so// gnyis pa gtso na/ so thar gyi sdom pa mi dge bar 'gyur te/ dus kyi kun slong mi dge ba ldan pa yod pas so// zhe na/ kun slong de gnyis spang bya rigs tha dad pas ma chod na dang po gtso la/

chod na gnyis pa gtso bas/ skyon gnyis ka med do// thub pa'i 'jug tshul ni/ 'jug byed gnyis ka dge ba las dge ba dang*/ lung ma bstan las lung ma bstan du 'dra ba'am/ rab 'jug lung ma bstan las rjes 'jug dge bar 'gyur gyi/ zlog par ni mi 'gyur te/ de'i stobs dman du mi 'gyur bas so// sde pa gzhan ni sangs rgyas la thugs lung ma bstan med de/ mdor glang chen gshegs na'ang mnyam par bzhag ces sogs gsungs pas so// zhes zer te/ theg chen dang mthun no// bye brag smra ba ni/ de mi bzhed (252) bzhin du/ mi 'gro ba la dgongs kyi/ rnam smin dang*/ spyod lam pa dang*/ sprul sems lung ma bstan mnga' zhes so// rnam smin la skyes pa'i sems ni sgom spang yang 'jug byed gnyis ka min te/ 'bad med du 'jug pas so// yid shes zag med kyang min te/ rtog med kha nang ltas su nges pa'o// gsum pa bye brag rig byed ma yin pa'i rnam bzhag la/ gnyis kyi/ mdor bstan ni/ rnam par rig byed min pa rnams gsum ste/ sdom pa dang*/ sdom min dang*/ gzhan bar ma rnams so// rgyas bshad la gnyis las/ sdom pa khyad par du bshad pa dang*/ thams cad thun mong du bshad pa'o// dang po ni sdom pa la so thar dang*/ bsam gtan/ zag med kyi sdom pa sogs gsum gyi/ so thar ni/ rigs rnams pa brgyad de/ dge slong pha/ dge slong ma/ dge slob ma/ dge tshul pha/ dge tshul ma/ dge bsnyen pha/ dge bsnyen ma/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa'o// de brgyad kyang

(253) ming gi sgo nas phye'i/ mtshan nyid tha dad pa'i rdzas su rnam pa bzhi yin te/ pha'i sdom pa gsum las ma'i gsum gzhan min cing*/ dge slong ma'i sdom pa dang*/ dge tshul ma'i sdom pa nyid chos drug dang*/ nye ba'i chos drug spong bas khyad par du byas pas der 'dus pa'o// ji ltar shes zhe na pho mo'i mtshan phan tshun gyur pa las/ dge slong ni/ dge slong ma'i zhes sogs su ming tsam 'pho'i sdom pa'i ngo bo gtong thob med pas/ mi 'pho ba'i phyir ro// gang gi sdom pa gsum rim gyis blangs na/ spong ba 'phel ba'am/ thams cad cha gsum skye na/ srog gcod spong ba gsum sogs tha dad cha gsum spong ba skye ste/ de gsum car yang ma 'dres pa/ lhan cig par 'gyur gyi phyi ma/ blangs pas snga ma mi gtong ste/ sdom pa de rnams 'gal ba med pas so// 'o na de dge bsnyen dang*/ dge tshul du'ang (254) 'gyur ro zhe na/ 'gyur mod/ yon tan gtso ba'i sgo nas dge slong zhes brjod cing*/ der 'dzin pa'i bsams pas kun slong ba'i phyir rig byed ni dge slong gi kho na yod la/ rig byed min pa ni so sor yod do// de yang rang rang gi sdom pa la gnas pa'i phyed du/ lus ngag gi spang bya srog gcod sogs lnga dang*/ brgyad dang*/ bcu dang*/ thams cad spong ba mnos pa las rim pa bzhin/ dge bsnyen dang*/ bsnyen gnas dang*/ dge tshul dang*/ dge slong nyid du 'gyur ro// dge slong gi bslab pa nyis brgya nga gsum ni pham pa bzhi/ lhag ma bcu gsum/ spang ltung sum cu/ ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu/ so sor bshags pa la bzhi/ nyes byas brgya bcu gnyis te/ ltung ba ltung ba sde lnga'i gnyen po la phye ba'o// de yang 'chal tshul gyi gdung ba las bsil ba'i gnas yin pas tshul khrims dang*/ mkhas pas sngags pas (255) legs spyad dang*/ bya ba'i rang bzhin yin pa las dang*/ lus ngag sdom pas sdom pa zhes bya'o// sdom pa thob ma thag gi skad cig gi dang po'i rnam par rig byed dang*/

rnam rig byed min pa dag ni sdig pa las dang por thar pas so sor thar pa dang*/ sdom pa gnyis ka dang*/ bya ba las lam gyi dngos gzhi yin la/ de phyin chad ni/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa kho na dang*/ 'jug yin gyi so so thar pa dang*/ las lam dngos ni min no// 'di pra ti mok+ṣa ces pa'i pra ti dang por bshad pa'o// bam po lnga bcu par/ tshul khrims srung pa'i gang zag so so thar pa dang*/ thar pa'i thabs yin pas thar pa'i thabs kyi sdom pa ces kyang bya ste/ pra ti so so dang thabs su bshad pa'o// so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ ldan pa'i gang zag ni/ dge slong nas bsnyen gnas kyi bar brgyad do// (256) bsam gtan sogs kyi sdom pa ni/ bsam gtan las skyes pa'i sdom pa dang*/ bsam gtan de nyer rtogs dang bcas pa ldan pa'i gang zag la/ nges par ldan no// zag med kyi sdom pa dang*/ ldan pa 'phags pa'i sems can slob mi slob rnams so// sngar sdom pa gnyis sems kyi rjes su 'brang bar bshad pa de gang zhe na/ sdom pa gsum gyi grangs tha ma 'di gnyis ni sems kyi rjes su 'brang ngo*// so thar ni sems med kyang 'jug pas de min no// bar chad med lam dgu rnams su skyes pa'i bsam gtan dang*/ zag med de gnyis ni sa mi lcogs med la rten pa na spong ba'i sdom pa zhes bya ste/ 'chal tshul dang*/ de kun slong gi nyon mongs dngos su spong bas so// sa lam gzhan la rten pa na ni rgyu mtshan de med pas spong sdom zhes mi bya ste/ des na de gnyis dang*/ spong sdom la mu bzhi sbyar ro// 'o na yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ (257) zhes dang*/ mig gi dbang po sdom pas sdam te gnas zhes gsungs pa de gnyis gang yin zhe na/ bya ba dang mi bya shes pa'i shes bzhin dang*/ de ma rjes pa'i dran pa dag sdom pa ni yid kyi sdom pa dang*/ dbang po'i sdom pa'o// thams cad thun mong du bshad pa la bzhi ste/ dus ji srid ldan tshul ji ltar thob rgyu gang gi stong rten gang la ldan pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/

rig byed min pa'i ldan tshul/ rig byed kyi ldan tshul/ de dag gi mu bzhi'o// dang po la so thar dang (258) sdom min ldan tshul ni/ so so thar pa la gnas pa'i gang zag de sdom pa ma btang ba'i bar du rtag par da ltar gyi rnam rig min pa dang ldan zhing*/ skad cig dang po phyin chad ma btang gi bar du 'das pa dang yang ldan no// sdom min la gnas pa'i gang zag la'ang ldan tshul de dang 'dra'o// mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i ldan tshul ni/ bsam gtan gyi sdom pa dang ldan pa'i skye 'phags ni ma gtang bar du rtag tu 'das ma 'ongs gnyis dang ldan te/ skad cig dang po la'ang sngon gtang ba'i 'das pa thob bo// 'phags pa ni zag med skad cig dang po'i tshe sngon zag med ma skyes pas 'das pa dang ldan pa min zhing de phyin chad 'das ma 'ongs pa dang ldan no// 'jig rten pa'i mnyam bzhag dang 'phags lam snyoms par zhugs pas gnas pa'i tshe ni/ sdom pa de gnyis da ltar ba dang yang ldan pas/ dus gsum car dang ldan la/ langs pa ngag ni da ltar gyi mi ldan te/ sdom pa de (259) gnyis sems kyi rjes su 'jug pas so// bar ma ldan tshul ni/ sdom pa dang sdom min gnyis ka med pa'i bar mar gnas pa'i gang zag la bar ma'i rig byed min pa gal te yod na skad cig dang po bar da ltar gyi kho na dang ldan zhing*/ de phyin chad 'das pa dang da ltar gyi dus gnyis dang ldan no// der ma zad sdom min la gnas pa'ang mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba sogs byed na/ bar ma'i dge ba'i rig byed min pa dang ldan la/ sdom pa la gnas pa'ang ra bsod pa sogs byed na/ bar ma'i mi dge ba'i rnam rig byed min ldan te/ de yang rim pa bzhin/ ji srid du rab du dwang ba dang*/ nyon mongs kyi shugs ldan pa de srid kyi bar du rtag tu da ltar dang*/ dang po phyin chad 'das pa dang ldan no// rnam par rig byed kyi ldan tshul ni/ rnam par rig byed sdom pa sdom min bar ma thams cad la ji srid rig byed byed pa rnams da ltar ba ldan la/

'di yang skad cig ma (260) dang po phyin chad ji srid ma gtang bar du/ 'das pa dang yang ldan gyi/ ma 'ongs pa'i rig byed dang ldan pa med de/ sems kyi rjes su mi 'jug pas so// de yang dge mi dge'i dbang du byas kyi sgrib pa dang*/ ma sgrib pa'i rig byed dag ni 'das pa dang yang ldan pa med de/ chos nyams chung ba'i thob pa'ang nyams chung bas so// des na thams cad du da ltar ba kho na dang ldan no// sdom pa min pa zhes pa ci zhe na/ lus ngag gi sdom pas sdom pa min pa dang*/ dam pas smad cing 'bras bu yid du mi 'ong bas nyes spyad dang*/ tshul khrims kyi mi mthun phyogs yin pas 'chal ba'i tshul khrims dang*/ lus ngag gi las min pas las dang*/ las dngos gzhis bsdus pas de'i ste las lam zhes so// de dag gi mu bzhi ni rnam rig dang*/ rnam rig min pa dang ldan pa mu bzhi la bar ma la gnas pas sems gzhan pas dge mi dge byed na/ rnam rig (261) min pa dang mi ldan pas so// rdzas las byung ba dang*/ las lam ni ma gtogs so// tshe 'phos te/ tshe snga ma'i rnam rig gtang ba dang*/ tshe'i rnam rig ma skyes pa'am/ nyams pa'i 'phags pa'i gang zag ni zag med kyi rnam rig min pa dang ldan gyi/ rnam rig dang mi ldan pa'o// de 'dra'i gzugs kyi so skye'ang srid do// gnyis yin ni bar ma la gnas pas sems drag pos dge mi dge byed pa sogs so// gnyis min ni gzugs med kyi so skye sogs so// ji ltar thob tshul gsum te/ sdom pa sdom min bar ma'i thob tshul lo// sdom pa'i thob tshul la/ thun mong du bstan pa ni/ bsam gtan las skyes pa'i sdom pa ni/ zag bcas kyi bsam gtan gyi nyer sdogs sam/ dngos gzhi'i sa thob pa nyid kyi sa thob ste/ bsam gtan gyi sems dang*/ lhan cig 'byung bas so// (262) zag med kyi sdom pa ni 'phags pas te/ zag med kyi bsam gtan pa drug gi sems thob pa des sa thob bo// so so thar pa zhes pa'i sdom pa ni gzhan dge 'dun nam gang zag gi sdom pa sbyin pa go bar byed pa'i rnam par rig byed kyi thob bo// sogs pa'i sgra ni bye brag du smra ba 'dul pa rnam pa bcu'i bsnyen pa rdzogs so// zhes zer ba bsdus te/

sangs rgyas sogs rig byed la mi ltos pas so// bcu 'brel par 'byung ba lung ma mo ltar te/ lung gcig las 'phros pa las ni bzang ste/ dor nas gsol bzhi'i cho ga grangs so// phri na ni da ltar gyi cho ga ste/ ding sang yang bya rung bar bshad de ma bris so// khyad par du bshad pa la dus ni so thar dus ji srid du slang zhe na/ sdom pa ni rigs bdun gyi ji srid mtsho'i bar du dang*/ bsnyen gnas nyin zhag gcig du yang dag par blang bar bya ste/ dus kyi mtha' srog dang*/ nyin zhag (263) gi mtha' gnyis yin pa dang*/ ston pas gzhan ma bstan pas so zhe na/ slob dpon ni dang po rigs te/ tshe phyi ma'i sdom pa da lta blangs kyang mi skye ste/ tshe 'di dang*/ lus skal ba mi 'dra bas dang*/ mi 'dra ba'i lus des kyang*/ da lta blangs pas/ der sbyor ba ma byas pa dang*/ blangs pa mi dran pas so// gnyis pa ni mi rigs te/ ston pas ma bstan pa dbang po 'dul bka' ba ma dgongs kyi/ mi skye nas min pas/ zhag lnga la sogs pa skye ba la rigs pas mi gnod par bzhed de/ bsdu ba dang yang mthun no// sdom min gyi dus nges pa gang zhe na/ de ni las smad pas len pa med kyang stan du log par zhugs pa'i rgyus thob pas ji srid 'tsho ba yin la/ nyin zhag pa'i sdom min med de/ sdom min de bsnyen gnas de ltar nyin zhag gcig du nod pa med cing*/ tshe'i dus la gzhan du log par zhugs pas (264) sdom min mi thob pas so// grag ces pa zur za ba ste/ dus re shig pa'ang yod par ston pa'o// mdo sde pa ni/ sdom min yang sdig pa bya ba'i sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa ste/ shan pa sogs sems dge ba la'ang sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa de ma spangs pas ldan par 'dod de/ theg chen dang mthun no// bsnyen gnas ni bsnyen gnas nyin zhag gcig du nod na ji ltar nod par bya zhe na/ nad pa min pas dma' bar gtsog pur thal mo sbyar nas 'dug cing 'bogs pa pos smras pa'i rjes su bzlas pas brgyad nar ma las gzhan pas mi brgyan par srung dus sang nam langs shing nyi ma shar gyi bar du/

dgra bcom pa dang*/ nye bar gnas pas bsnyen gnas te/ de'i yan lag brgyad tshang bar/ len dus nang par snga dro zas ma zos pa'i tshe/ yul gzhan las nod par bya'o// gang gi tshes brgyad la rtag tu bsnyen gnas srung ba'i nges pa byas pa des ni zas zos (265) kyang gzhan las nod par byas te/ rkyen yod kyang mi 'da' ba'i dgos pa yod pas so// gnas mchog gis zhus pas/ dge slong ngam bram ze shes pa gcig gi gnas su song ste ces pa dang*/ 'dul ba lung du/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis mgron po la/ bsnyen gnas phog par bshad pas/ dge bsnyen las kyang blang du rung la/ dge bsnyen yang dge bsnyen sdom brgyad du/ dge bsnyen las kyang slang bar bshad do// bsdu bar ni/ khyim pa'i sdom pa rang gi kyang len par bshad do// 'di ni dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gsos 'debs pa'i gso sbyong ngo*// yan lag brgyad ni/ srog gcod ma sbyin len/ mi tshangs spyod rdzun te rtsa ba bzhi/ chang 'thung ba/ gar sogs/ 'phreng sogs/ mal che mtho/ phyi dro'i kha zas te yan lag bzhi spong ba'o// ci phyir yan lag brgyad nod ce na/ rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba spong ba tshul khrims kyi yan (266) lag dang*/ bag yod pa'i yan lag dang*/ brtul shugs kyi yan lag ste/ dang po bzhi dang*/ lnga pa gcig dang*/ phyi ma gsum ste/ brgyad po rim pa bzhin no// ci bag yod dang*/ brtul shugs kyi yan lag ma nod na/ cir 'gyur zhe na/ chang 'thungs pas dran pa nyams pa dang*/ gar sogs gsum gyi dregs par 'gyur la/ de ltar na 'chal tshul thag mi ring bas so// gar sogs phreng sogs rab byung gi tshul dang mi mthun pas dge tshul la gnyis su bcas zhing*/ khyim pa de lta min pas gcig tu'o// gser dngul len pa la ma bcas pa ni/ 'dod pa sogs 'jog gtso bo dang*/ rtsa ba yin pas so// ci bsnyen gnas 'di dge bsnyen las gzhan la yod dam med ce na/ dge bsnyen las gzhan pa'i khyim pa la'ang yod mod kyi/

dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su ma song ba la med do// ma gus pa min kyang*/ 'bogs pa po'am nod pa po rjed pa'am ma byang bas (267) skyabs su ma song ba ni ma gtogs so// dge bsnyen ni mdo las/ ming chen 'di ltar khyim pa gos dkar po gyon pa/ skyes pa pho'i dbang po dang ldan pa zhig sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro/ chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ bdag la dge bsnyen du bzung du gsol zhes tshig tu smra na/ 'di tsam gyis dge bsnyen du 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa de ci/ skyabs 'gro kho nas dge bsnyen du 'gyur ram zhe na/ nyi 'og pa 'gyur zhes zer ro// kha che ba sdom pa med par mi 'gyur te/ lung gi don ni/ dge bsnyen nyid du bzung du gsol/ deng phan chad nam 'chi'i bar du srog spong ngo*// zhes khas blangs pa kho na las 'di'i sdom pa skye'o// 'on kyang bslab pa'i gzhi bstan pa ni/ de shes pa'i ched du ste/ dper na dge slong dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob zin kyang*/ shes pa'i ched du bslab pa'i gzhi brjod pa bzhin no// zhe'o// gal te (268) dge bsnyen thams cad dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa la gnas pa yin na/ ston pas bslab bzhi gcig srung ba sna gcig spyod pa dang*/ sogs pas gnyis srung ba phyogs gcig spyod pa dang*/ gsum mam bzhi/ srung na phal cher spyod pa dang*/ lnga car srung na yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen zhes gsungs pa ci lta bu zhe na/ de ni dang po yongs rdzogs blangs pa phyis yan lag kha cig nyams kyang*/ lhag ma de dang de srung ba las/ de spyod par gsungs pa'o// zhe'o// grag ni mdo las 'das par ston pa ste/ srog spong ngo zhes ni gang du'ang mi 'byung zhing*/ nyams na sna gcig spyod pa sogs zhu ba nyid kyang mi 'thad na lan lta ci smos/ des na dang po nyid du bslab bzhi de dang de blangs te/ srung ba rnams sna gcig spyod pa sogs so// zhes nyi 'og pa sogs 'dod do// spyir gsung rab tu dge bsnyen bdun 'byung ste/

skyabs gsum (269) 'dzin pa/ sna gcig spyod pa/ phyogs gcig spyod pa/ phal cher spyod pa/ yongs rdzogs tshangs spyod/ bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du blangs te/ srung ba gong ma'i dge bsnyen no// de la dang po lnga/ ming chen gyi mdo dang*/ drug pa lung rnam 'byed dang*/ bdun pa kun du rgyu pen rigs kyi zhus par des de 'dra ba'i sdom pa sangs rgyas la blangs par gsungs la/ dge bsnyen sdom brgyad kyi 'grel pa sogs su bshad do// kha che ba ni lha drug gnyis min pa mi 'dod la/ 'dir ni yongs rdzogs kyi dbang du byas so// 'o na sdom pa che chung sogs ji ltar zhe na/ sdom pa chung ngu dang*/ sogs pas 'bring dang*/ chen por gyur ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni/ dad sogs che chung dang ldan pa'i yid ji bzhin gyi dbang gis te/ des na so thar dgra bcom la chung la/ so skye la che ba'ang yod do//

(270) 'o na skyabs su ji ltar 'gro zhe na/ skyabs 'gro ni/ blang ba thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro bas gang zhig dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul sangs rgyas ni gang mnyes pas sangs rgyas su 'jog par byed pa'i chos mi slob pa'i lam chos sku dang*/ dge 'dun ni gang thob pas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun du 'jog par byed pa'i chos sangs rgyas las gzhan pa'i slob mi slob gnyis ka'i lam bden dang*/ chos ni mya ngan sdug bsngal rgyu bcas la 'das pa'i so sor btags 'gog go /sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun gyi rten gzugs sku ni zag bcas yin pas skyabs gnas min no// slob dpon ni de ltar na 'jig rten pa'i sems la gnas pa na/ sangs rgyas dang dgra bcom min par 'gyur la/ dge slong du byed pa'i tshul khrims kho na dge slong du 'gyur ro// zhes te/ chos 'dra zhing*/ gzhan (271) gnyis rten yang de dag tu bzhed do// skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo ni/ yul dam pa la rten par khas len cing*/ blo gtod pa ste/ 'grel par ngag gi rig byed du bshad pa ni nod pa'i dus kyi dbang du byas pa'o// skyabs kyi don ni/ de la rten nas sdug bsngal kun las nges par thar par 'gyur ba'o// 'o na sdom pa gzhan la mi tshangs spyod spong ba bslab pa'i bzhir bzhag la/ dge bsnyen la 'dod log spong ba ci zhe na/ log g.yem ni gzhan gyi chung ma sun 'byin cing*/ ngan song ba'i rgyu yin pas shin du smad pa'i phyir dang*/ khyim pas sdom pa sla ba'i phyir dang*/ 'phags pas tshe gzhan du'ang mi byed pa'i sdom pa thob cing*/ mi tshangs spyod de lta bu yin pa'i phyir ro// dge bsnyen gyi chung ma len na/ sdom pa mi nyams sam zhe na/ mi nyams te/ sdom pa ni ji ltar khas blangs pa bzhin thob pas/ (272) 'dod log spong bar khas len gyi/ rgyud 'di la mi tshangs spyod spong ngo*// zhes ni ma yin pas so// gnyis pa ni/

ngag gi bzhi las rdzun spong ba kho na yan lag du bzhag pa ci zhe na/ smad pa sogs gsum dang*/ yang bslab pa thams cad las 'das par gyur na/ 'das sam dris pa na bdag gis ma byas zhes rdzun du thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir spang ste/ 'das na bshags pa'i don du'o// bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba 'di'i bslab gzhir ma bzhag pa ci zhe na/ bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba myos 'gyur bzhag go /de kho na 'jog pa ci zhe na/ de las yan lag gzhan yang srung ba'i phyed du'o// chang 'thung ba ni nyan thos 'dul ba pa rang bzhin gyi dang*/ mngon pa ba bcas pa'i kha na ma tho bar 'dod de/ rgal na 'grel par lta'o// de gnyis kyi khyad par slob dpon ni sems nyon mongs can kho nas spyod pa dang*/ nyon mongs can min pa'i sems kyis kyang spyad (273) par nus shing*/ nyes pa gzhan spang ba'i ched du bcom ldan 'das kyis spyad pa la bzhed do// 'di la yan lag lnga par bzhag pa ni/ bir 'dzi'i bu la bslab pa bzhag pa bzhin/ gdul bya skrag pa spang ba'i ched yin gyi/ don du na/ 'dis kyang mi dge ba bcu car spang dgos te/ dge bsnyen sdom brgyad du/ gang phyir lus ngag mi dge las// ldog pa yid kyi dge ba las// de phyir brnab sems gnod pa'i sems// lta bas ldog rnams grub pa yin// zhes so// gang las thob pa ni/ ci sdom pa gsum rnam bzhi gang las thob pa de las lhag ma dag thob bam zhe na/ min te/ 'dod rtogs so thar ni/ spang bya'i sbyor dngos 'jug gsum thams cad las dang*/ sems can du ston mi ston nam/ bcas rang bzhin gnyis ka las dang*/ da ltar gyi phung khams skye mched rnams las spang bya de dang de'i gnyen por (274) sdom pa de dang de thob par 'gyur gyi/ 'das ma 'ongs las ni min te/ da lta sems can du mi 'gyur bas so// bsam gtan dang zag med kyi sdom pa dag ni chos nyid kyis thob pa yin pas las kyi lam dngos gzhi kho na las dang*/

sems kyi rjes 'brang yin pas/ dus gsum po thams cad las thob kyi/ sbyor 'jug dang bcas pa las ma min no// des na sdom pa dang po'i bzhi dang*/ phyi ma gnyis kyi bzhi la mu bzhi ste/ dang po ni da ltar gyi bcas pa dang*/ sbyor 'jug go /gnyis pa ni 'das ma 'ongs kyi dngos gzhi'o// gsum pa ni da ltar gyi dngos gzhi'o// bzhi pa ni/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi bcas pa dang sbyor 'jug go /slob dpon ni spang bya 'das da ltar ni/ skyes zin pas/ sdom mi nus pas ma 'ongs pa sdom par bzhed do// 'o na sdom pa rnams sems can thams cad dang*/ yan lag thams cad dang rgyu thams cad las (275) thob pa'am 'on te/ dbye ba yod ce na/ sdom pa ni/ sems can thams cad las thob ste/ gzhan la gnod pa bzhi dang bcas pa las ldog pas so// yan lag las kyi lam la ni/ dbye ba yod de/ dge slong gi spong bdun dang*/ dge tshul sogs kyi spong bzhi yin pas so// rgyu la dbye ba yod de dge rtsa gsum rgyur 'dod na/ thams cad las dang*/ sems chung 'bring che gsum rgyur 'dod na/ de gsum car mi 'byung bas re re las thob bo// gnyis pa sdom min thob tshul ni/ sdom pa min pa/ sems can thams cad dang yan lag las lam kun las thob ste/ sgo thams cad nas gnod pa la zhugs pas so// rgyu ni thams cad las thob pa min te/ dge gsum mam/ sems chung ngu sogs gang du 'dod kyang cig car mi 'byung bas so// zhe'o// slob dpon ni de ltar na shan pa sogs la'ang sdom min med (276) par 'gyur te/ rang gi pha ma sogs gsad 'dod med pas so// ci ste de dag lug sogs su 'gyur ba na gsang 'dod 'byung ngo zhe na/ 'o na lug sogs kyang pha mar gyur pa la/ gsad 'dod med pas de la sdom min mi thob par 'gyur ro// shan pa ma sbyin len sogs spong ba'ang yod pas ji ltar yan lag kun las sdom min thob ces 'gog bye brag du smra ba ni/
