khyad par can bsam gtan dang po sogs dang*/ bcas pa btang ste/ rnon po'i lam gyi 'bras bu 'dod pa la chags bral tsam thob par 'gyur bas/ phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu gzugs med kyis bsdus pa med pas so// gnyis pa dgur dbye ba ni dgra bcom pa la dbang po'i bye brag gi dgu ste/ sangs rgyas la rang 'byung gnyis dang*/ nyan thos la nyams pa'i chos can sogs lnga dang*/ mi g.yo ba la sbyangs pa dang*/ dang po nas de'i rigs can gnyis te bdun to// de dgu dbang po (472) chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa rnam pa dgu'i bye brag gis te/ sangs rgyas ni/ mi g.yo ba'i bye brag yin pas/ de chen po gsum du phye nas/ nyams pa'i chos can ni chung ngu'i chung ngu yin pa nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chen po'i chen po yin pa'i bar du'o// spyi'i gnyis pa rnam grangs bdun du dbye ba ni/ 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams ni/ bdun por yang 'dus te/ 'di ltar sbyor ba las dad pa dang*/ chos kyi rjes 'brang gnyis dang*/ dbang po las dad mos mthong thob gnyis dang*/ snyoms 'jug las lus mngon byed dang*/ rnam grol las shes rab kyis rnam grol dang*/ snyoms 'jug dang*/ rnam grol gnyis kas byas pa las/ gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol lo// rdzas drug du bsdu ba ni/ de rnams kyang rdzas drug ste/ rgyu mtshan 'di ltar mthong sgom mi slob pa'i lam gsum la rim pas rjes 'brang gnyis dang*/ dad mos mthong thob gnyis dang*/

(473) dus sbyor dus mi sbyor gnyis gnyis so// dgra bcom rnam grol gnyis po gang zhe na/ mi slob pa 'gog snyoms thob pa ni/ nyon mongs dang rnam thar gyi sgrib pa gnyis las rnam par grol ba yin la/ shes rab kyi nyon sgrib tsam las grol ba ni/ cig shos shes rab kyis rnam grol lo// 'gog pa thob pa snyoms 'jug gis rdzogs pa dang*/ mi 'phrog pa'i dbang rnon/ dbang pos rdzogs pa dang*/ tha ma'i cha mthun lnga spangs pa'i phyir mi 'ong thob pa 'bras bu rdzogs pa ste/ de gsum rnams kyi ji rigs par slob pa yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya'o// dbang po dang snyoms 'jug gnyis kyis mi slob pa yongs su rdzogs te/ 'bras bu ma rdzogs na mi slob pa nyid kyang med pas de ma bzhag go /lam nyid khyad par du bshad pa la gsum las/ lam bzhir/ dbye ba ni skye tshul ltar mas rim gyis bshad de/ gang gi 'jug (474) du bar chad med lam skye ba sbyor lam dang sgrib pa dngos su spong bar byed pa bar chad med lam dang*/ sgrib pa las grol ba dang por skyes pa rnam grol lam dang*/ de phyin chad kyi lam ni/ khyad par can gyi lam zhes bya'o// ci phyir lam zhes bya zhe na/ snga ma gnyis myang 'das tshol bas dang*/ phyi ma gnyis gong nas gong du phyin par byed pas so// yang lam bzhi ste/ mngon shes bul la dka' ba dang*/ myur la dka' ba dang*/ bul la sla ba dang*/ myur du sla ba'o// de la lam nyid myang 'das sgrub par byed pas sgrub pa zhes gsungs la/ de bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi bzhi rnams la rten na/ yan lag gis zin pa dang*/ zhi lhag ma nyams pas 'bad mi dgos pa rang gis 'byung ba'i phyir sla la/ sa gzhan rnams la dka' ba yin te/ yan lag gis ma zin pa dang*/ mi lcogs med dang*/ khyad par can ni zhi gnas chung (475) zhing*/ gzugs med ni lhag mthong chung bas so// dka' sla gang yin yang blo ste dbang rtul ni/ mngon shes bul ba ste/

gcig shos dbang rnon gyi ni mngon shes myur ro// byang phyogs bdun bstan pa la dbye bsdu ni/ 'dir zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa ni/ gang zag gi bye brag gis theg pa gsum gyi byang chub ste spangs pa dang rtogs pa mthar thug pas so// byang chub de dang mthun te/ rgyur gyur pa nyid kyi phyir sum cu rtsa bdun ni/ byang chub de'i phyogs dang mthun pa zhes bya'o// de rnams ni dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi dang*/ yang dag spong bzhi dang rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi dang*/ dbang po lnga dang*/ stobs lnga dang*/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang*/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad do// de'i dang po bshad zin cing*/ gnyis pa ni mi dge ba skyes pa spang ba dang*/ ma skyes pa mi skyed pa dang*/ dge ba ma skyes pa skyed pa dang*/ skyes pa (476) gnas pa sogs kyi ched du 'dun cing 'bad pa sogs so// gsum pa ni 'dun pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ sems spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin bzhi'o// bzhi pa ni dad pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ dran pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab kyi dbang po lnga'o// lnga pa ni/ de lnga nyid dang*/ ma dad pa sogs mi mthun phyogs kyi mi rdzi bar 'gyur ba'o// drug pa ni dran pa dang*/ chos rab du rnam par 'byed pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ shin du sbyangs pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go /brgyad pa ni lnga pa'i lnga pa dang*/ rtogs pa dang*/ ngag dang*/ las kyi mtha' dang*/ 'tsho ba dang*/ rtsol ba dang*/ dran pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin to// de ltar so bdun ni/ ming gi sgo nas bzhag gi rdzas su ni bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ dad pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ shes rab dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ btang snyoms (477) dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ rtog pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ shin du sbyangs pa'o// ji ltar byas pas zhe na/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ shes rab dang*/ yang dag 'jog bzhi brtson 'grus dang*/

rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ dbang po lnga/ stobs lnga ni dngos su smos la/ sde drug pa'i chos rab tu rnam 'byed ni shes rab ste/ gzhan ni zin la/ bdun pa'i lta ba ni shes rab dang*/ rtsol ba ni brtson 'grus dang*/ ngag sogs gsum ni tshul khrims so// bye brag smra ba lus ngag gnyis tha dad pas tshul khrims kyi yan lag rdzas gnyis su byas te/ bcu gcig du 'dod do// sde dang po gsum/ shes rab sogs gsum du bzhag pa ni/ gtso bo smos pa ste/ de gsum rnams ni sbyor byung gi yon tan thos bsam sgom gsum zag bcas zag med kun kyang yin no// rnam bzhag ni gnas skabs gang du byang phyogs gang phye zhe na/ bye brag smra ba sde tshan bdun ni/ (478) go rim bzhin du/ las dang po dang*/ nges byed cha mthun pa bzhi rnams dang*/ sgom lam dang mthong lam la rab du phye'o// sde phyi ma gnyis kyi go rim mdor 'byung ba ni/ grangs kyi rim pa dang bstun pa'o// zhe'o// slob dpon ni phyi ma gnyis kyang skye rim ste/ mthong lam la byang chub yan lag dang*/ mthong sgom gnyis ka la lam gyi yan lag brgyad yod par bzhed de/ mdo sde pa'i lugs so// byang phyogs sde bdun las zag bcas du zag med du zhe na/ byang chub kyi yan lag dang*/ lam gyi yan lag gnyis ni lam phyi ma gsum gyis bsdus pas zag med nyid dang*/ sde gzhan lnga ni/ zag bcas zag med gnyis te/ lam lnga car gyi mnyam rjes na ji rigs par yod pas so// de na sa mtshams ni khyad par can/ gtso bo dbang du byas nas ma mtha'i sa mtshams bzhin bzhag 'dir khyad par can min pa'i dbang du byas so// (479) gang na byang phyogs su du yod zhe na/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam na so bdun po thams cad sred la mi lcogs med na/ stobs kyis drang dgos pa dang*/ sa 'og ma'i dogs pa dang bcas pas dga' ba ma gtogs pa so drug dang*/ bsam gtan gnyis pa na rtog pa ma rtogs pa so drug dang*/

gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa gnyis na dga' ba dang*/ rtog pa de gnyis ma gtogs pa so lnga re dang*/ bsam gtan bar te khyad par can na'ang dga' rtog min pa so lnga dang*/ gzugs med pa dang po gsum na'ang dga' rtog de gnyis dang tshul khrims kyi yan lag dag sogs gsum min pa so gnyis so// byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang*/ lam gyi yan lag brgyad ma gtogs pa nyer gnyis ni/ 'dod khams dang srid rtse na ste/ de gnyis la zag med kyi lam med pas so// gzugs med na lus dran pa nyer bzhag ci ltar yod ce na/ de'i (480) zag med kyi shes rab kyis gzugs kyi zag med kyi sdom pa la dmigs pa na yod de/ sdom pa de 'byung 'gyur yin pas so// byang phyogs kyi gnas skabs gang du shes nas dad pa thob ce na/ mthong lam du ste/ shes nas dad pa la sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun la shes nas dad pa dang*/ tshul khrims dri med bzhi'o// de la bden pa dang po gsum mthong na/ 'phags pa dges pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ chos la bden pa rnams ji ltar shes te/ rtogs nas yid ches pas dad pa thob la lam bden mngon par rtogs na sangs rgyas mi slob khyad par can dang dge 'dun slob mi slob kyi lam gyis phye ba dag la yang shes nas dad pa sogs thob cing*/ yang gi sgras tshul khrims dang chos la dad pa thob pa'ang bsdu'o// 'dir gang la chos (481) su dgongs pa gang yin zhe na/ 'dir chos ni bden pa dang po gsum dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems pa'i lam yin no// 'di bzhi'ang rdzas su ni gnyis te/ dang po gsum dad pa dang*/ bzhi pa tshul khrims yin pas so// ngo bo ni gcig du dri ma med pa yin la/ rim pa ni langs nas/ e ma bcom ldan 'das ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so// de'i chos 'dul ba ni legs par gsungs pa'o// de'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni legs par zhugs pa'o// zhes mngon du byed cing*/ de gsum gyis byas pa'i tshul khrims kyang rab du dwang ba yin pas tha mar bzhi pa bshad de/

sman pa dang*/ sman dang*/ nad g.yog dang*/ nad med pa lta bu'o// lam gyis thob pa'i rnam grol ni/ mdo las/ yang dag pa'i rnam grol dang*/ shes pa gnyis slob pa la ma bshad pa ci zhe na/ da dung nyon mongs pa 'chi bas bcings pa'i phyir/ slob pa'i lam gyi yan lag du/ rnam grol (482) mdo las ma bshad do// rnam grol de ni 'dus byas dang*/ 'dus ma byas rnam pa gnyis te/ nyon mongs bcom pa'i 'gog pa ni/ de 'dus ma byas dang*/ mi slob pa'i mos pa ni 'dus byas so// mi slob pa'i yan lag ni rnam grol 'dus byas de yin la/ rnam grol 'dus byas de nyid/ mdo las/ sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol ba gnyis su gsungs so// yang dag pa'i lta ba min pa'i shes pa ni gang zhe na/ byang chub ces sngar ji skad bshad pa zad mi skye shes pa nyid 'dir yang dag pa'i shes pa'o// ci dus gsum gyi sems gang grol bar 'gyur zhe na/ mi slob sems ni skye 'gyur ma 'ongs pa sgrib pa nyon mongs pa'i thob pa las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro// gnas skabs gang gi lam gyis de'i sgrib pa spong zhe na/ 'gag par 'gyur ba da ltar gyi lam gyis mi slob pa'i lam de'i sgrib pa de'i skye ba'i gegs nyon mongs pa'i thob pa rab du spong ngo*// tshig tsam la rten nas gang dag 'dis gnyen po skyes zin nas 'dod (483) 'gag bzhin pas spang bya 'gag bzhin pa sel bar bstan no// zhes smra ba ni nyi ma shar zin nas rgas bzhin pas mun pa sel bar 'dod ces pa ltar/ ma brtags pa'i rlabs bcol lo// de bzhin du gong ma pa gnyen po skye 'gyur ma 'ongs pas spang bya da lta 'gag bzhin pa spong bar 'dod ces pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pas bya ba byed pas rdzas su grub pa'i phyir zag byed pa'i phyogs la slan no// des na gong 'og gnyis ka spong gnyen da lta bas/ spang bya da ltar ba spong bar bzhed par 'dra la/ da ltar ba de nyid la gong mar da lta bzhin pa yin pas/

skyes pa zhes dang*/ 'og mar (484) 'gag 'gyur zhes tha snyad byas par zad do// mngon pa ba spang bya'i sa bon nam thob pa la dmigs rnam med par 'dod la/ rigs pa pa nus pa can rdzas gcig pas spang bya'i sa bon dmigs rnam can du 'dod pas spong tshul cung zad mi 'dra'o// rnam grol 'dus ma byas de dang*/ spangs pa'i khams dang*/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i khams dang*/ 'gog pa'i khams zhes 'byung ba de rnams la khyad par ci yod ce na/ 'dus ma byas de nyid/ khams de gsum zhes bya la/ de gsum gyi khyad par ni/ 'dod chags kun zad pa ni/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i khams dang*/ spangs pa'i khams ni/ 'dod chags las gzhan pa'i nyon mongs rnams zad pa dang*/ 'gog pa'i khams zhes pa nyon mongs min pa'i gzhi gzugs sogs zag bcas so// gong ma pa ni de gsum mthong spang dang*/ sgom spang dang*/ phung po kun zad pa la bzhed do// yid 'byung ba'i dngos po des 'dod chags dang (485) bral bar 'gyur ram/ zhe na/ sdug bsngal dang rgyu kun 'byung la bzod shes rnams kyis yid 'byung la/ bzod shes gang gang gis spang bya spong bar 'gyur ba kun gyis 'dod chags dang bral bar 'gyur ro// de lta na ni/ mu bzhi srid de/ yid 'byung la 'dod chags dang mi 'bral ba ni spong lam min pa'i sdug kun gyi yul can gyi lam dang*/ gnyis pa 'gog lam yul can gyi spong lam dang*/ gsum pa sdug kun gyi yul can gyi spong lam dang*/ bzhi pa spong lam min pa'i 'gog lam yul can gyi lam mo// chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa las/ lam dang gang zag bstan pa zhes bya ba gnas drug pa'i 'grel pa'o// bdun pa ye shes bstan pa la bzhi ste/ shes pa/ ldan pa/ thob pa/ yon tan no// dang po la gnyis te/ bzod shes lta ba'i dang*/ zag bcas dang po la/ bzod shes lta ba'i khyad par ni/ bzod pa dang*/ shes pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang*/ yang dag (486) pa'i shes pa zhes 'byung ba/

bzod pa yin la shes pa min/ yang dag pa'i shes pa yin la/ lta ba min zhe na/ dri med bzod pa brgyad rnams yang dag par rtogs pas lta ba yin zhing*/ bzod pa spang bya'i phra rgyas the tshom spangs pas shes pa min la/ zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i blo ni/ rtog cing tshol ba'i bsam pa can min pas lta ba min no// de rnams las gzhan pa'i 'phags pa ste/ zag med kyi blo ni shes rab dang*/ lta ba gnyis ka'o// zag med las gzhan 'jig rten pa'i shes rab thams cad kun rdzob shes pa ste/ shes pa 'di la the tshom spangs pa nges par mi dgos so// 'jig lta sogs lnga dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba ste/ drug ni lta ba yin gyi/ gzhan ni lta ba min la/ 'ang gi sgras de drug shes pa'ang yin par bstan no// shes pa bcu bstan pa ni shes pa bcus shes pa bsdus te/ bcu ni/ chos dang*/ rjes dang*/ kun rdzob dang*/ (487) gzhan sems dang*/ sdug bsngal dang*/ kun 'byung dang*/ 'gog pa dang*/ lam dang*/ zad pa dang*/ mi skye ba shes pa'o// shes pa gzhan ni bcur 'dus pas 'dir bcur grangs nges so// bsdu na shes pa gnyis te/ zag bcas dang zag med do// dang po ni rang spyi'i mtshan nyid 'dzin pa yang yod mod/ phal cher bum rnam sogs kun rdzob shes pa zhes bya'o// zag med ni rnam gnyis te/ chos shes pa dang*/ rjes su shes pa'o// sdug bsngal shes pa sogs kyang 'di gnyis su 'dus pas kho na zhes smos so// de ltar kun rdzob dang*/ chos dang*/ rjes su shes pa gsum yin la/ kun rdzob shes pa'i yul ni/ ji rigs par chos thams cad do// chos shes pa zhes bya ba'i spyod yul ni/ 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal bden pa bzhi dang*/ rjes su shes pa'i spyod yul ni/ khams gong ma'i sdug bsngal sogs bden pa bzhi'o// chos shes (488) rjes shes de dag nyid dmigs pa bden bzhi'i bye brag gis sdug bsngal shes pa sogs bzhi'o// chos shes rjes shes rnam pa bzhi po de rnams nyid lta ba'i rang bzhin min pa ni/

mi skye ba shes pa dang*/ zad pa shes pa dag go /zhes spyir btang nas zad mi skye shes pa de gnyis dang por skyes pa ni sdug bsngal lam/ rgyu kun 'byung la rjes su shes pa yin te/ srid rtse'i phung po la sdug bsngal lam kun 'byung gi rnam par dmigs pas so// chos shes rjes shes lam shes/ kun rdzob shes pa bzhi las/ pha rol gyi sems rig pa skye'o// sems shes des ni mnyam pa dang dman pa shes kyi sa 'das pa gong mas gong ma'i sa pa'i dang*/ dbang po 'das pa dad mos kyis mthong thob kyi sogs dang*/ gang zag 'das pa phyir mi 'ong gis dgra bcom gyi sems mi shes so// zhig pa 'das pa dang*/ ma skyes pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa mi rig gi da ltar ba na kho na shes so// (489) chos blo dang*/ rjes blo'i phyogs mthun gyi sems shes dag gis phan tshun shes pa min te/ rim pas 'dod pa dang*/ gong ma'i gnyen po la dmigs pas so// mthong lam la sems shes kyi sbyor ba'i sems shes kyi skabs med pas de med kyang*/ gang zag gzhan gyi sems shes kyis/ mthong lam shes tshul ni/ nyan thos kyi sems shes pas mthong ba'i lam gyi skad cig dang po gnyis rig ste/ rjes bzod sogs dmigs pa mi mthun pa ni/ sbyor ba chen pos yang sgrub dgos cing*/ de'i bar la mthong lam rdzogs 'gro bas mi shes so// rang rgyal bse ru lta bus ni/ dbang po rno bas sbyor ba gnyis 'grub pas skad cig dang po gnyis dang*/ brgyad pa'am/ gzhan ni dang po gnyis dang*/ bco lnga pa zhes te/ gsum kho na shes te/ sangs rgyas kyis ni sbyor ba med par skad cig ma kun mkhyen no// zad pa shes pa dang*/ mi skye ba shes

(490) pa gnyis la khyad par ci yod ce na/ zag pa shes pa ni bden pa shes pa rnams la bdag gis sdug bsngal spongs su shes so// sogs pas kun 'byung spangs so// 'gog pa mngon du byas so// lam sgoms so zhes nges pa'o// bdag gis sdug bsngal shes te yang yongs su shes par byar med do// zhes sogs nas/ bdag gis lam sgom te sgom du med do// zhes pa'i bar du shes pa ni mi skye ba'i blo na 'dod do// de yang kha che ba de gnyis kyi mnyam bzhag 'dra yang khyad par ni rjes kyi nges pas yin pas 'di dag rjes thob du 'chad la/ gzhan ni rnam pa bcu drug min pa'i zag med kyi rnam pa'ang yod pas 'di dag mnyam bzhag gi rnam pa'i khyad par du bzhed do// 'o na kun rdzob dang*/ chos dang*/ rjes su shes pa gsum la bcur bzhag pa ci zhe na/ yul gyi rang bzhin phal cher kun rdzob yin pa la/ kun rdzob shes pa ste/ don dam mi shes pas so// 'dod khams (491) dang gong ma'i gnyen po las chos shes dang*/ rjes shes te/ 'dod pa'i chos shes pa'i rjes su khams gong ma'i chos shes pas de'i rjes shes la rjes su zhes bshad pa bzhed la/ dmigs pa 'dra yang rnam pa mi rtag sogs dang*/ rgyu sogs tha dad pa las/ sdug kun shes pa gnyis dang*/ rnam pa dang spyod yul gnyis ka tha dad pa las 'gog lam shes pa gnyis dang*/ sems byung yang shes mod kyi sems shes pa'i phyir du sbyor ba byas pas grub pa las gzhan sems shes pa dang*/ bya ba byas pa'i rgyu las dang po nyid du skyes pa zad shes dang*/ zag med kyi shes pa thams cad kyi skal mnyam gyi rgyu rgyas pa las skyes pas mi skye ba shes pa ste/ bcur nges pa yin no// chos shes ni gong ma'i gnyen po yang yod de/ sgom pa'i lam la 'gog pa'am lam la chos shes gang yin pa de dag ni/ dang por 'dod pa las rgyal bar byas nas lam gyi rgyun de (492) nyid kyis gong ma las kyang rgyal bar byed pa srid pas khams gsum car gyi gnyen po byed pa yin pas so// 'dod khams kyi gnyen po rjes shes kyi byed pa ni/

srid pa min te/ de skyes pa na chos shes kyis rgyal bar byas zin pa'i phyir te/ de ni chos shes kyi rjes su skye bas so// yang 'gog lam ni/ khams su ma rtogs pas 'og ma'ang dman par mi bzhag la/ 'og ma'i sdug kun ni dman pas de dag la dmigs pa'i sgom lam la chos shes kyis gong ma'i gnyen po byed mi srid pas na/ 'gog lam la (493) zhes smos la/ gong ma'i mthong spang ni rjes bzod kyi gzhom bya yin pas/ sgom lam gyi chos shes kyi mi spong ba dang*/ mthong lam gyi 'gog lam la chos shes kyis kyang mi spong bas sgom lam la zhes smos so// de'i khyad par bshad pa la gsum ste/ rnam pa dang*/ shes pa dang*/ dmigs pa'i khyad par ro// dang po la shes pa so so'i rnam pa ni shes pa de bcu las/ chos shes pa dang rjes su shes pa gnyis ni mi rtag sogs rnam pa bcu drug can no// kun rdzob shes pa ni de bzhin du rnam pa bcu drug can yang yin la/ la la de las gzhan rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi rnam pa can dang*/ kha cig zo cig 'dug shig song shig sogs de gnyis min pa'i rnam pa can no// bden bzhi shes pa ni/ rang rang gi bden pa'i rnam pa 'jug pas/ bzhi bzhi pa yin no// pha rol yid shes dri med kyang de bzhin (494) du bzhi pa ste/ lam shes pa yin pas lam bden gyi rnam pa can no// dri ma dang bcas pa'i gzhan sems shes pa ni shes bya sems dang sems byung rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid kyi rnam pa can te/ dri bcas dri med gnyis ka dang*/ rdzas re re'i spyod yul can yin pas sems 'dzin pa na sems byung mi 'dzin la/ tshor ba 'dzin pa na 'du shes mi 'dzin pa sogs so// lhag ma zad mi skye shes pa rnams ni bden pa'i rnam pa las stong pa dang*/ bdag med pa ma rtogs btogs pa bcu bzhi can te/ de gnyis kyi stobs kyis rjes thob du bdag gi skye ba zad do// 'di las srid pa gzhan mi shes so// zhes bdag gi tha snyad 'dogs la/

stong pa dang*/ bdag med sgom stobs kyis tha snyad de 'dogs par mi 'thad pas so// rnam pa so so'i ngo bo ni ci/ zag med la rang bzhin gyi rnam pa yod dam med ce na kha che ba dri med la bcu drug las (495) gzhan pa'i rnam pa med par 'dod la/ gzhan nyi 'og pa rang bzhin gyi rnam pa'ang yod par 'dod de/ bstan 'chos rnam shes kyi tshogs las 'di ni gnas yod do// 'di ni gzhi yod do// zhes bya bar shes par 'gyur ro// zhes pa'i gnas ni mtshan nyid dang*/ gzhi ni rgyu yin pas so// zhes so// ci rnam pa bcu drug po 'di dag ming gi sgo nas sam/ 'on te rdzas su yin ce na/ kha cig rdzas su sdug bsngal gyi gzhi dang*/ gzhan gsum gyi re re ste/ bdun nyid yin gyi/ gzhan rnams rnam grangs pa zhe'o// bye brag smra ba ni/ rdzas su grub pa nyid rnam pa bcu drug ste/ 'di ltar rkyen la rag las pas mi rtag pa dang*/ gnod pa'i bdag nyid yin pas/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ bdag gir dang*/ bdag du lta ba'i mi mthun phyogs yin pas rim pas stong pa dang*/ bdag med pa dang*/ sa bon gyi tshul gyis rgyu dang*/ 'byung ba'i tshul gyi kun 'byung ste/ (496) snga ma ring rgyud dang*/ 'di nye rgyu'o// rgyun 'brel ba'i tshul gyis rab du skye ba dang*/ rgyu du mas mngon par 'grub pa'i don gyis rkyen dang phung po zhig pas 'gog pa dang*/ me gsum zhi bas zhi ba ste/ gsum ni dug gsum mo// 'tshe ba med pas gya nom pa dang*/ skyon thams cad dang bral bas nges par 'byung ba ste/ snga ma sdug bsngal dang*/ 'di de'i rgyu dang bral ba'o// myang 'das su bgrod pa'i don gyi lam dang*/ 'thad pa'am thabs dang ldan pas rigs pa dang*/ myang 'das sgrub pas sgrub pa dang*/ gtan du 'byin pas nges par 'byin pa'o// rnam pa shes pa ci zhe na/ bye brag smra ba shes rab du 'dod do// de lta na shes rab gnyis mi ldan pas de rnams med du 'gyur bas/

mdo sde pa/ shes pa'i 'dzin stangs su 'dod pa rigs so// ci shes rab kho nas 'dzin nam zhe na/ shes rab de dang bcas pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas pa thams cad kyis 'dzin par byed la/ gang (497) ci yod pa thams cad bzung bya yin no// shes pa'i khyad par ni/ shes pa bcu la dang po kun rdzob shes pa ni/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan rnam pa gsum dang*/ gzhan dgu rnams dge ba kho na'o// dang po sa rnams thams cad na yod la/ bsam gtan pa drug na chos shes yod kyi/ de 'dod pa'i gnyen pos phye bas gzhan na med do// zag med pa dgu na/ rjes shes zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin du bden pa bzhi shes pa dang*/ zad mi skye shes pa ste/ drug po rjes shes kyis bsdus pa rnams kyang sa dgu na ste/ chos shes kyi bsdus pa ni/ sa drug na'o// gzhan yid shes pa ni skye dka' bas/ lam bslab pa bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi kho na yod do// sems shes de ni bsam gtan nyid la rten pas 'dod pa dang gzugs kyi rten can nyid du nges la/ chos shes zhes bya ba ni gtso bor 'dod pa sun 'byin pas 'dod pa'i rten can kho na ste/ gong ma gnyis de las grol bas sun (498) mi 'byin pas so// khams gsum pa'i sems can de gnyis las/ gzhan brgyad do// 'gog blo ni 'dus ma byas nyid la dmigs pas chos dran pa nyer bzhag gcig pu ste/ pha rol sems blo ni mtshungs ldan nyid 'dzin pas sems tshor chos dran pa nyer bzhag ste gsum mo// de gnyis las lhag ma brgyad ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi car yod do// dmigs pa'i khyad par ni shes pa du/ shes pa gang gi dmigs pa yin zhe na/ chos blo'i spyod yul rjes min pa dgu ste/ lam la chos shes kyi yul chos shes gzhan sogs zag med brgyad dang*/ sdug bsngal la chos shes kyi yul kun rdzob shes pa yin srid pas so// lam shes pa'i yul kun rdzob min pa dgu dang*/ rjes blo'i yul chos shes yin pa dgu yin te/

lam shes zag med kyi lam la dmigs par nges shing chos rjes kyi blo gnyis phan tshun mi dmigs pas so// sdug bsngal shes pa dang*/ (499) rgyu kun 'byung blo'i yul ni sdug kun gyis bsdus pa'i kun rdzob shes pa dang*/ gzhan sems shes pa zag bcas te/ gnyis yin no// kun rdzob shes pa'i yul chos thams cad dang*/ sems shes dri med kyi yul shes pa dgu dang*/ dri med bcas kyi yul kun rdzob shes pa dang*/ sems shes dag yin srid la/ zad mi skye shes pa ni sdug kun shes pa sogs kyi ngo bo yin pas/ de dag gis yul shes pa bcu car yin srid pas shes pa de bzhi'i yul ni/ shes pa bcu car yin du rung ba'o// 'gog shes gcig gi yul na/ shes pa min te/ des 'dus byas mi shes pas so// chos bcu rnams ni shes pa gang gi dmigs pa du yin zhes sbyar bar bya la/ bcu gang zhe na/ khams gsum pa dang*/ dri med kyi chos te bzhi la mtshungs ldan yin min rnam pa gnyis gnyis te brgyad dang*/ 'dus ma byas pa dge (500) ba dang lung ma bstan de rnam pa gnyis dang bcu'o// de la kun rdzob shes pa'i yul ni bcu car ro// chos shes kyi lnga ste/ 'dod pa dang*/ dri med kyi mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis gnyis te/ bzhi dang*/ 'dus ma byas dge ba'o// rjes shes kyi bdun te/ gong ma gnyis dang dri med kyi mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis gnyis te drug dang 'dus ma byas dge ba'o// sdug kun shes pa'i drug ste/ khams gsum gyi mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis gnyis so// 'gog shes kyi 'dus ma byas dge ba gcig pu'o// lam shes kyi dri med mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis so// sems shes kyi 'dod gzugs dang dri med mtshungs ldan gsum mo// zad mi skye shes pa'i 'dus ma byas lung ma bstan min pa dgu ste/ de dag gis bden bzhi la dmigs la/ nam mkha' dang rtags gnyis min ni bden bzhir ma 'dus pas so// shes pa gcig gis chos bcu car shes pa yod dam zhe na/

med de/ mdor dge slong ngam/ bram ze yang rung*/ gang (501) gcig char thams cad shes pa'am mthong ba de ni 'ga' yang med do ces gsungs pas so// 'on kyang thos bsam las byung ba'i kun rdzob shes pa gcig pus rang gi tshogs te rang nyid dang lhan cig 'byung ba'i chos mtshungs ldan yin min las gzhan pa'i chos thams cad ni bdag med pa nyid do// zhes rig par 'gyur ro// rang tshogs ni min te/ rim pas ral gris rang mi gcod pa ltar rang la bya byed 'gal bas dang*/ mtshungs ldan 'dzin na de dang dmigs pa gcig pas mtshungs ldan rnams kyang rang rang la dmigs dgos pa la/ rang rig med pas de 'dra mi srid pas dang*/ mig gi mig sman mi mthong ba ltar ha cang nye bas ldan min mi 'dzin no// gnyis pa ldan pa ni/ so skye chags bcas kun rdzob shes pa dang chags bral sems shes dri bcas dang yang ldan no// 'phags pa ni zag med skad cig dang po la chags can rgyun zhugs sam/ phyir 'ong yin na kun rdzob shes pa gcig pu dang (502) ldan te/ bzod pa ni shes pa min la/ zag med kyi shes pa gzhan yang med pas so// de skad cig gnyis pa la sdug bsngal la chos shes nyid ming tha dad pa tsam gyis phye nas chos shes dang sdug bsngal shes pa gnyis bsnan te gsum dang*/ de yan chad skad cig ma bzhi la shes pa/ re re 'phel ba dang ldan te/ sdug bsngal rjes shes la rjes shes 'phel ba bzhi dang*/ kun 'byung chos shes la kun 'byung shes pa 'phel bas lnga dang*/ 'gog pa chos shes la 'gog pa shes pa 'phel bas drug dang*/ lam chos shes la lam shes pa 'phel bas bdun te/ de chos shes lngar nas ldan pa ni mi 'phel lo// sgom lam pa yang de bdun te/ phyir mi 'ong sogs chags bral yin na thams cad du sems shes bsnan nas skad cig dang po la gnyis nas sgom pa la brgyad brgyad ldan pa'i bar du sbyar ro// mi slob pa la zad mi skye shes pa ldan pa ni go sla bas ma bshad do// gsum pa thob sa ni/

(503) skabs gang du shes pa du thob ce na/ mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa brgyad dang*/ shes pa bdun skyes pa'i tshe/ ji ltar skyes pa rnams dang 'dra ba ma 'ongs pa dang*/ de'i rnam pa bzhi kho na rang rang gi tshe thob ste/ sdug bsngal chos bzod skyes pa'i tshe/ de dang dmigs rnam 'dra ba'i chos bzod ma 'ongs pa dang*/ bzod pa de'i rnam pa mi rtag sogs bzhi kho na 'thob la/ sdug bsngal chos shes skyes pa'i tshe/ de nyid ma 'ongs pa dang*/ de'i rnam pa bzhi kho na thob ste/ rjes shes sogs la'ang sbyar ro// de rnams mngon du mi 'gyur te/ mthong lam lan du mar mi skye bas so// mthong lam de nyid la bzod shes rigs 'dra kho na thob par ma zad rjes shes dang po gsum la ni/ bden pa de dang zad pa shes pa'i mngon par rtogs pas kun rdzob shes pa khyad par can sngon med pa dag kyang thob la/ chos shes la ni mi thob ste/ (504) bden pa zad par ma rtogs pas so// bden pa re mngon par rtogs pa'i rjes la thob pa de'i phyir/ kun rdzob shes pa de ni mngon par rtogs pa'i mtha' las byung ba zhes bya'o// lam la rjes shes la mi thob pa ci zhe na/ lam bden ni/ sngon 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis ye ma gtogs shing lam la rjes shes kyi tshe yang tshang bar ma gtogs la/ mthong spang gi gnyen po'i lam nyid la'ang nyan rang byang sems kyis bye brag gis du ma yod pas gang zag gang gis zad par sgom mi nus pa'i phyir/ mngon par rtogs pa'i mtha' med pas so// kun rdzob shes pa de res 'ga' sngon du byed dam zhe na/ de ni mthong lam gyis thob bya yin pas/ sgom lam du ni mngon du mi 'gyur zhing*/ mthong lam du ni skye ba'i skabs med pas/ mi skye ba'i chos can kho na yin zhe'o// sa du'i kun rdzob shes pas de thob ce na/ mthong lam gyi sa de gang yin pa'i rang sa dang*/ 'og sa'i (505) kun rdzob shes pa thob ste/ sa gnyis nas bdun pa'i bar du'o// de dran pa nyer bzhag du yin zhe na/

'gog pa rtogs pa'i mtha' las 'byung ba ni/ mtha' ma chos dran pa nyer bzhag gcig pu dang*/ sdug kun gyi bzhi car ro// bden pa gang rtogs pas rang nyid thob pa'i bden pa de'i dmigs rnam can dang*/ mthong lam gyis thob bya yin pas 'bad pa ste sbyor ba las byung ba yin gyi/ skyes thob min no// chags bcas kyi bcu drug pa lam la rjes shes la drug thob ste/ de yang rjes shes lam shes da ltar ba dang*/ bden pa bzhi shes dang*/ chos shes rjes shes de drug car ma 'ongs pa thob pa'o// kun rdzob shes pa ni/ sngon rnyed zin pas yang mi thob bo// de 'dod chags dang bral bas ni/ de drug dang sems shes te bdun thob la/ bcu drug pa de'i gong ma chags bcas kyi sgom lam 'dod nyon brgyad pa spangs pa'i bar la (506) gong gi drug dang*/ kun rdzob shes pa ste bdun thob cing da lta ba ni lam zag bcas yin na/ kun rdzob shes pa dang*/ zag med yin na/ bden bzhi'i chos shes gang rung ngo*// slob pa'i bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gzugs med dang po gsum ste/ sa bdun las rgyal ba'i bar chad med lam rnams dang*/ mngon shes dang po lnga'i bar chad med lam dang*/ mi g.yo ba thob ste/ rtogs par byed pa'i bar chad med lam dang*/ bsam gtan spel ma sgom pa'i bar chad med lam rnams la bdun thob ste/ gzhan la chags bcas sgom lam gyi bdun dang*/ mi g.yo ba la kun rdzob shes pa srid rtse'i gnyen po min pas dor te/ zad shes dang bcas pa'i bdun no// dbang po 'pho ba ma rdzogs pas mi skye ba shes pa mi thob la/ sems shes ni bar chad med lam thams cad la bkag pas chags bral yin yang mi thob bo// sa bdun gyi'ang gong ma srid rtse las rgyal bar byed pa'i rnam par

(507) grol ba'i lam dang po brgyad la'ang kun rdzob shes pa sngar bzhin dor te/ sems shes dang bcas pa'i bdun thob ste/ de rnam grol lam lam bkag pas so// slob pa dbang po sbyong ba'i rnam grol la chags bcas kyis drug dang*/ chags bcas kyis bdun bcu drug pa ltar thob la/ 'ang gi sgra ni/ kha cig 'dis 'bras bu thob par byed pas mthong lam dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ mngon par rtogs pa'i mtha' las byung ba'i kun rdzob shes pa'ang de gnyis kas thob zer ro// gzhan ni 'di bden pa rtogs zin dang*/ 'bras bu thob zin pas mthong lam dang mi 'dra'o// zer ba'i lugs tha dad pa ston pa'o// slob pa dbang po sbyong ba'i bar chad med lam la drug dang*/ de bzhin du srid rtse las rnam par rgyal bar byed pa'i bar chad med lam la'ang drug thob bo// de'i rnam grol lam dgu pa zad pa shes pa la/ rtul pos mi skye ba shes pa min pa dgu dang*/ (508) mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyis ni bcu car thob bo// mi g.yo ba der dbang po 'pho ba'i rnam grol tha ma la'ang bcu thob ste/ de'i tshe mi g.yo bar 'gyur bas so// bshad pa'i lhag ma la slob pas zad mi skye ma gtogs shes pa brgyad thob ste/ chags bcas sgom lam gyi rnam grol gyi dgu pa dang*/ sa bdun pa las rgyal mngon shes dang spel sgom gyi rnam grol rnams dang*/ mi g.yo ba rtogs byed kyi rnam grol lam dang po brgyad dang*/ phyir mi 'ong gi sbyor ba dang*/ khyad par gyi lam rnams te/ de gnyis kyi thob pa ma smos pas lhag ma'o// gzhan yang mi slob pa ni/ dbang po rtul rno'i bye brag gis mngon shes dang spel sgom gyi sbyor ba dang*/ rnam grol dang*/ khyad par gyi lam la dgu'am bcu dang*/ bar chad med lam la sems shes dor bas brgyad dam dgu thob bo// so skyes ni/ kun rdzob shes pa dang*/ res 'ga' sems shes kyang thob la/ (509) nges 'byed cha mthun ni/

mthong lam gyi 'khor yin pas sems shes mi thob bo// yang lam gang la/ sa du'i shes pa thob ce na/ kun rdzob shes pa ni/ snyoms 'jug shes brgyad kyi bar chad med lam dgu pa yan chad du/ nyer rtogs nyid dang*/ rnam grol dgu pa la dngos gzhi dang gnyis ga'i sa thob bo// zag med kyi shes pa ni/ zag med kyi bsam gtan gnyis pa la rten nas gsum pa la 'dod chags dang bral bar byed pa lta bu'i tshe/ lam sa gang yin pa gnyis pa'i sa pa'i zag med kyi shes pa thob par ma zad rnam grol dgu pa'i tshe gsum pa lta bu/ sa gang las 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir/ sa gang thob pa de'i sa pa gsum pa'i lam zag med kyi shes pa thob la/ dus der yang 'og ma dang po skor gsum gyi shes pa thob pa sogs so// zad pa shes pa la ni/ zag med du ma zad zag bcas kyi yon tan sbyor ba la mi ltos (510) pa rnams kyi thob pa rnams gsung ba'i tshul gyis 'byung ste/ de'i tshe rang gi sems la nyon mongs kyi gzhan dbang med pa'i rgyal srid thob pa'i phyir te/ rgyal srid thob na/ yul mi'i skyes kyis bsu ba bzhin no// de yang sa kun te rten 'dod pa pas sa dgu nas srid rtse pas rang sa pa nyid thob pa'i bar du 'og mas gong ma'i thob kyi/ gong mas 'og ma'i mi thob bo// de rnams kyang sngon ma rnyed pa kho na thob kyi/ rnyed zin pa ni mi thob bo// ci thob pa zhes pa rnyed pa kho na yin nam zhe na/ thob pa bzhi las sngar med gsar rnyed ni/ rnyed pa thob pa dang*/ yang yang mngon du byed pa ni/ rten pa thob pa zhes pas te/ de gnyis ni dge ba 'dus byas kyi dbang du byas pa'i thob pa'o// lam sgom pa ni/ gnyen po thob pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i thob pa gcod pa ni/ thag sring ba'i thob pa ste/ de gnyis ni zag bcas spong ba'i dbang du byas pa yin no// des na dge ba zag (511) bcas kyi bzhi car dang*/ chos zag med kyi dang po gnyis dang*/

zag bcas lhag ma'i phyi ma gnyis so// yon tan la gnyis las/ thun mong ma yin pa la mdor bstan ni/ sangs rgyas kho nas brnyes pa'i chos ni gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pas ma 'dres pa ste/ stobs la sogs pa bco brgyad do// gzhan las ni/ spyod pa dang rtogs pas bsdus pa drug drug dang*/ ye shes dang phrin las kyi bsdus pa gsum gsum las 'chad do// bshad pa la bzhi las/ dang po stobs bcu ni/ gnas dang*/ gnas min pa dang*/ las dang*/ rnam par smin pa dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ rnam par thar pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ dbang po mchog dang*/ mchog ma yin pa dang*/ mos pa sna tshogs dang*/ khams sna tshogs dang*/ thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam dang*/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang*/ 'chi 'pho dang*/ skye ba dang*/ (512) zag pa zag pa mkhyen pa'i stobs so// de la gnas dang gnas min ni/ sngar chos bcu sbyar ba yin pas shes pa bcu ste/ srid pa gnas so// mi srid pa gnas min no// las 'bras mkhyen pa la 'gog lam shes pa min pa brgyad de/ de ni sdug kun gyis bsdus pas so// bsam gtan sogs kyi kun byang dang*/ dbang po mchog dman dang*/ mos pa dang*/ khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa la ni/ 'gog shes min pa dgu ste/ rnam thar ni brgyad dang*/ ting nge 'dzin ni stong nyid sogs gsum dang*/ snyoms 'jug ni/ thar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dang*/ dbang po ni dad sogs chung 'bring chen po dang*/ mos pa ni/ nyan rang sangs rgyas la mos pa sna tshogs pa ste/ sems byung dang*/ khams ni slob dpon 'dus bzang sngon gom pa'i bag chags kyis grub pa'i bsam pa la bzhed de/ sems sems byung gi khyad par du ma ste/ de rnams 'dus byas nyid yin no// 'khor (513) 'das thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam rnams ni/ ngan 'gro dang*/ bde 'gro dang*/ thar par 'gro ba'i rgyu ste/ de ma lus par mkhyen pa la lam de 'bras bu dang*/ bcas na bcu'am min na 'gog shes dor ba bzhi'o// sngon gyi skye ba du ma khyad chos dang bcas pa dang*/

lha'i spyan rnam par dag pas sems can gyi skye 'chi dang*/ kha dog bzang ngan dang*/ las dge mi dge bde 'gro dang*/ ngan 'gror 'gro ba mkhyen pa gnyis ni/ rang bzhin gyi rnam pa can du nges pas kun rdzob shes pa yin no// zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs 'gog shes nyid yin na/ chos rjes su 'gog pa zad mi skye kun rdzob shes pa ste/ drug gam/ zag zad kyi rgyud la yod pa'i shes pa yin na/ shes pa bcu car yin no// sa ni sngon gyi gnas dang*/ 'jig rten snga ma nas 'chi 'pho ba dang*/ phyi mar skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs gnyis ni/ (514) bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi rnams na ste/ stobs lhag ma brgyad ni nyer ldog gong ma bdun dor ba'i sa bcu gcig po rnam kun na yod la/ rten 'dzam gling gi skyes pa kho na ste/ gzhan du na sangs rgyas mi 'byung bas so// ci'i phyir shes pa de bcu gzhan gyi la stobs shes mi bya bar/ sangs rgyas 'di kho na'i lam stobs zhes bya zhe na/ gang gi phyir mkhyen pa shes bya thams cad la thogs pa mi mnga' bar 'jug pa de'i phyir/ stobs te/ gzhan gyi shes pa ni/ thogs pa dang bcas pas stobs kyi ming mi thob bo// sangs rgyas kyi sku la sred med kyi bu'i stobs mnga'o// gzhan dag tshigs re na stobs de mnga'o/ zhes te/ sangs rgyas dang*/ rang rgyal dang*/ 'khor lo sgyur ba'i tshigs ni/ rim pas klu bdud pa dang*/ lu gu rgyud dang*/ gzer bus btab pa lta bu'o// btsun pa na re/ sku'i stobs kyang thugs kyi stobs bzhin du (515) mtha' yas te/ de lta min na/ mkhyen pa'i stobs mtha' yas pa bzod par mi 'gyur ro zhes te/ slob dpon yang de ltar bzhed do// sred med kyi bu'i stobs kyi tshad ji tsam zhe na/ glang chen phal pa dang*/ sogs pas spos kyi glang po dang*/ tshan po che dang*/ rab gnon dang*/ yan lag mchog dang*/ stobs mchog dang*/ sred med kyi bu ste/ bdun po/

snga ma bcus lhag pa'i stobs ni/ phyi ma'i mtshan nyid do// gzhan ni stobs mchog bcu sred med bu'i phyir du 'dod do// lus kyi stobs de ni/ reg bya'i skye mched de/ de yang 'byung ba chen po'i khyad par ram gzhan ni 'jam rtsub sogs bdun las gzhan pa'i 'bras bu'i reg byar 'dod do// gnyis pa mi 'jigs pa bzhi ni/ ston pas bdag nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so// bdag nyid zag pa kun zad do// zhes zhal gyi mches/ nyan thos rnams la 'di dag ni thar pa la bar du gcod pa'o// 'di dag ni 'khor ba las (516) nges par 'byin pa'i lam mo// zhes bstan pa gnyis te bzhi la/ de lta min no// zhes sus kyang chos mthun du rgol nus pa'i rgyu ma gzigs pas mi 'jigs pa thob bo// shes bya kun mkhyen pa yin pas ji ltar stobs dang po bzhin shes pa bcu yin no// bdag nyid kyi zag pa zad pa yin pas stobs bcu pa bzhin shes pa drug gam bcu yin la/ bar chad kyi chos sdug kun gyis bsdus pa kho na mkhyen pas stobs gnyis pa bzhin 'gog lam shes pa dor ba brgyad yin zhing*/ stobs bdun pa bzhin/ las 'bras can mkhyen na/ shes pa bcu'am/ lam nyid mkhyen na dgu'o// des na bye brag smra ba shes pa nyid mi 'jigs pa yin par 'dod cing*/ slob dpon ni shes pas byas pa der rung gi shes pa nyid de min par bzhed do// gsum pa dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum ni/ ston pas 'khor kun gus par chos nyan pa la rjes chags dang*/ 'khor kun ma gus par nyan pa la/ khong khro dang*/ gus ma gus (517) 'dres ma la de gnyis kar mi 'gyur bar dran pa dang*/ shes bzhin du btang snyoms su bzhugs pa ste/ des na de'i ngo bo ni dran pa dang shes bzhin gyi bdag nyid yin la/ 'khor gyi bye brag gis gsum du gsungs pas so// 'o na de nyan rang la'ang yod na/ cis ma 'dres pa zhes bya zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pas so// bag chags ni 'grel bshad gnyis su/

sngon nyon mongs spyad pa'i mthus lus ngag g.yo ba'i rgyu nus pa'i khyad par sems la yod par bshad la/ btsun pa go cha mtha' yas ni sems kyi khyad par lung ma bstan no// zhes zer ro// gong ma pa ni/ kun gzhi'i steng gi chos rnams skye ba'i nus pa lung ma bstan du bzhed do// bzhi pa thugs rje chen po'i ngo bo ni/ kun rdzob shes pa'i blo ste/ rtse bas nyin mtshan dus drug du ni nyams su ni 'phel zhes 'jig rten la gzigs pa'o// cis thugs rje chen po zhes bya (518) zhe na/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen pos 'grub pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gsum la rtog pa'i rnam pa che ba dang*/ sems can thams cad la dmigs pas spyod yul che ba dang*/ sems can kun la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rnam par mnyam par 'jug pa'i phyir dang*/ shes rab kyi ngo bo yin pas shin du rno bas na/ ches che ba'i phyir ro// snying rje dang thugs rje chen po gnyis la tha dad du bya ba ci yod zhe na/ rnam pa brgyad de/ ngo bo zhe sdang gti mug med// dmigs pa khams cig khams gsum pa// rnam pa sdug bsngal gcig dang gsum// sa ni bsam gtan bzhi bzhi pa// rgyud ni nyan thos sogs rang rgyal// thob pa 'dod dang srid rtse'i bral// don ni yongs su mi skyob skyob// las ni mi 'dra 'dra bar mdzad// ces pa rnams so// ci sangs rgyas thams cad rnam pa thams cad kyis mnyam mam zhe na/ rgyu phun tshogs tshogs gnyis kyis grub pa dang*/ 'bras bu phun tshogs chos sku zag med (519) kyi chos kyi rgyun gyi tshogs sam/ gnas gyur pa brnyes pa dang*/ phan 'dogs phun tshogs 'gro ba mtho ris dang*/ byang grol la 'god pa'i don mdzad par spyod pa gsum gyis mnyam pa nyid do// 'on kyang sku tshe ring thung dang*/ rgyal rigs dang*/ bram ze sogs rigs dang sku'i bong tshad che chung rnams kyis ni mnyam pa min te/ de gsum gdul bya dang mthun par sna tshogs ston pa'o// thun mong ba la/

mdor bstan ni/ chos de min pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gzhan dag slob ma nyan thos dang thun mong pa yin pa dang*/ kha cig so so'i skye bo dang*/ yang thun mong ba yod de/ sangs rgyas la mnga' ba dang*/ rigs 'dra ba de dag la'ang yod pa'i phyir te/ rim bzhin nyon mongs med dang smon nas shes pa dang*/ so so yang dag rig dang*/ mngon shes drug pa dang*/ 'gog pa'i rnam bcad lta bu dang*/ dang po lnga dang*/ sogs kyis bsam gtan (520) gzugs med/ tshad med/ rnam thar bdun/ zil gnon zad par/ stong nyid sogs kyi rang bzhin gsum lta bu'o// bshad pa la gnyis kyi 'phags pa nyan rang dang thun mong ba ni nyon mongs pa med zhes pa dgra bcom pas sems can gyi sdug bsngal ni nyon mongs las skye zhing bdag kyang yon gnas su rig nas/ mnyam par bzhag ste/ bdag la dmigs nas/ gzhan gyi nyon mongs skye bar mi 'gyur ba'i shes pa skyed nas langs kyang*/ de dang rjes su mthun par byed pas kun rdzob shes pa'i rang bzhin te/ 'di gzhan gyi sems srung ba'i thabs kyi khyad par yin gyi/ ting nge 'dzin tsam gyis nyon mongs mi skye ba ni min no// zhes so// sa ni lam sla ba'i mchog bsam gtan gyi ya mtha' bzhi pa na yod la/ gang zag ni dgra bcom mi g.yo ba'i chos can kho na dang*/ rten ni blo gsal ba gling gsum gyi mis skyed cing*/ dmigs pa ni mi'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs yin (521) pas 'dod par rtogs pa dang*/ skyes zin dang*/ gzhi med mthong spang spang mi nus pas ma skyes pa dang*/ gzhi bcas sgom spang gi chags sogs spyod yul du byas nas mi skye bar gyur cig snyam pa'i rnam pa can no// smon nas shes pa'ang*/ ngo bo dang*/ sa dang*/ gang zag dang*/ rten ni nyon mongs med pa de bzhin du yin no// de'i dmigs pa chos thams cad yin pa ni/ snga ma dang gnyis kyi bye brag go /bye brag smra ba ni/ des gzugs med pa mngon sum du mi shes kyi/

rgyu 'bras las rjes su dpog go /zhes zer la/ gzhan ni sangs rgyas kyi des zag med kyang mngon gsum du shes par 'dod de 'thad do// smon pa sngar btang ba'i shes pa ni/ de ste 'di shes par bya'o// zhes smon nas rab mtha'i bzhi pa la snyoms par 'jug cing*/ ting nge 'dzin de'i yul du gyur pa de ji tsam du shes pa'o// snga ma'i gang zag dang*/ rten de bzhin du (522) chos dang*/ don dang*/ nges tshig dang*/ spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa ste bzhi'o// dmigs pa dang ngo bo'i bye brag gis tha dad de/ dang po gsum ni/ go rim bzhin du/ bstan pa'i chos kyi ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs dang brjod bya'i don nam/ don gyi mchog myang 'das dang*/ bshad pa rgyu mtshan can gyi ngag la thogs med du shes pa yin pas dmigs pa'ang de dang de yin no// so so rig pa bzhi ni/ rigs pa ste/ don dang 'brel par mngon par brjod pa dang*/ grol ba ste/ thogs pa med par mngon par brjod pa dang*/ lam ting nge 'dzin la dbang ba gsal bar bya zhing*/ mi brjed par bya ba la thogs pa med par shes pa yin pas/ de'i dmigs pa ni ngag dang lam yin la/ ngo bo ni/ 'gog shes dor ba'i shes pa dgu'o// sa ni 'dod pa nas srid rtse'i bar thams cad do// don so so yang dag par rig pa ni/ don chos thams cad yin na/ shes pa bcu'am/ don

(523) myang 'das yin na/ 'gog pa'i yul can gyi shes pa drug yin zhing*/ de ni sa kun na snga ma bzhin yod do// gzhan chos dang nges tshig rig pa gnyis ngo bo kun rdzob shes pa ste/ sa ni chos rig gang na ming tshig yod pa'i 'dod pa dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi na yod la/ ngag ste/ nges tshig rig pa ni/ rtog dpyod dang bcas pa'i sa 'dod pa dang*/ bsam gtan dang po kho na na yod do// gcig yod na nges par bzhi car yod pas thams cad ma tshang bar so so rig pa de dag kyang thob pa med do// nyon mongs med pa sogs drug po de rnams rab mtha'i bsam gtan gyi stobs kyis thob la/ rab mtha'i bsam gtan de ni/ nyon mongs med smon nas/ shes rig pa nges tshig min pa gsum rang nyid 'ba' zhig pa ste/ rnam pa drug gi bdag nyid do// nges tshig rig pa ni/ rab mtha'i stobs kyis thob kyi/ rab mtha' nyid ni min te/ rtogs dpyod kyis (524) kun nas slong bas so// rab mtha' sa zhes pa 'di ci zhe na/ bsam gtan mtha' ste bzhi pa'o// rab mtha' de ni 'dod pa nas srid rtse'i bar du lugs mthun dang*/ srid rtse nas 'dod pa'i bar du/ lugs mi mthun du 'ongs nas/ yang 'dod pa nas bzhi pa'i bar du zhugs te/ sa kun gyis mthun pa byas pa'i rgyu las 'phel ba'i chung ngu las 'bring*/ de las rab tu chen por phyin pa yin no// yon tan de drug kyang sangs rgyas las gzhan pa'i sbyor ba las skyes pa yin gyi/ chags bral gyi thob pa min la/ sangs rgyas kyi ni sbyor ba las byung ba cung zad kyang med kyi/ yon tan thams cad mngon du 'gyur ba bzhed pa tsam la rag lus te/ yon tan thams cad kyi dbang phyug yin pas so// phal cher so skye dang yang thun mong ba ni mngon shes dang*/ bsam gtan sogs las mngon shes ni/ rdzu 'phrul dang*/ lha'i rna ba dang*/ pha rol gyi yid dang*/ sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran pa dang*/ 'chi 'pho dang*/ skye ba dang*/

(525) zag pa zad pa dang*/ drug shes pas mngon sum du bya ba'i mngon par shes pa drug go /de drug gi spyi'i ngo bo/ rnam grol lam gyi blo ste shes rab bo// so so'i ngo bo ni/ gsum pa dang drug pa dor ba bzhi ni/ kun rdzob shes pa kho na ste/ sems las shes pa ni bzhi las/ pha rol sems rig pa shes pas gdags gzhi bzhi dang*/ dang nyid de shes pa lnga yin no// zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes ni/ zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs bzhin du shes pa drug gam bcu'o/ gsum pa ni drug pa sa kun na yod la/ lhag ma lnga ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi bzhi na'o// bzhi pa ni de lnga rang sa dang*/ 'og sa'i yul can yin gyi/ gong sa'i yul can min te/ dang po rang sa'am/ 'og sar 'gro ba dang*/ sprul par byed kyi/ gong du min la gnyis pas kyang rang sa dang*/ 'og sa'i sgra thos kyi/ gong sa'i mi thos pa sogs so// des na sems shes dang*/ (526) sngon gnas dran pas gong sa gzugs med kyi/ sems mi 'dzin no// lnga pa ni/ mngon shes rnams ji ltar thob ce na/ sngon ma 'dres pa rnams ni/ sbyor bas thob par bya dgos la/ tshe rabs gzhan du 'dris pa ni/ 'dod chags dang bral bas thob cing*/ gnyis ka'ang mngon du 'gyur ba sbyor ba la ltos so// sbyor ba ni dang po'i yang ba yid la byed pa dang*/ gnyis pa'i rna ba'i sgra dang*/ gsum pa'i mig gi snang ba yid la byed pa dang*/ sems shes kyi rang gi lus 'di 'dra ba las sems 'di 'dra zhes lus sems kyi mtshan ma 'dzin cing*/ de ltar pha rol la'ang sbyar bas 'grub la grub nas gzugs la mi ltos par shes so// sngon nas rjes dran gyi/ rang gi yid 'das ma thag pa'i mtshan ma bzung nas skye bar nying mtshams sbyor ba'i sems kyis bar du rim gyis snga ma snga ma la yid gtod pa ste/ bar do'i skad cig dran na grub cing*/ de bzhin du (527) gzhan gyi'ang dran la byang nas thod rgal du'ang dran no// gzugs med nas 'dir skyes na/

rang gi tshe snga ma'i gzugs med yul min pas gzhan gyi rgyud las rten nas skyed de/ gzhan gyi yid 'das ma thag pa'i mtshan ma bzung nas zhes sogs rgyas par sbyar ro// de dag kyang sngar mthong thos kyi yul du byas pa kho na dran gyi/ gzhan ni mi dran la/ zag med kyi ni gang spel du// tshul gnas thos dang bsam gtan pa// zhes bshad pa rnams so// de nyid gtan la dbab pa la/ spyir bstan pa ni/ spyir gsum pa sems shes ni/ tshor sems chos dran pa nyer bzhag gsum dang*/ rdzu 'phrul dang*/ lha'i rna ba dang*/ mig gis mngon shes gsum ni gzugs la dmigs pas dang po lus dran pa nyer bzhag go /'o na mig gi mngon shes gzugs kyi skye mched la dmigs na las dge sdig shes par bshad pa ci zhe na/ (528) de ni des mi shes kyi 'phags pa la mngon shes kyi 'khor du yid kyi shes pa skye bas de shes pa'o// sa ni/ lha'i mig dang*/ rna ba'i mngon shes ni lung ma bstan te/ de dag gi rnam shes dang*/ mtshungs ldan gyi shes rab bo// rab du byed par/ mngon par shes pa gang zhe na/ shes rab dge ba'o// zhes bshad pa ni/ gtso ba'am/ phal che ba bstan pa'o// bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sa sar bshad pa'ang rten mig dang rna ba'i sgo nas yin pas mi 'gal lo// lhag ma bzhi rnams dge ba'o// mngon shes phyi ma gsum gsum ni/ mi slob pa'i rig pa gsum ste/ sngon gnas dran pas sngon gyi mtha' dang*/ sogs pas 'chi skye shes pas phyi mtha' dang*/ zag zad shes pas bar da ltar te/ dus gsum la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa zlog pa'i phyir ro// de gsum las don dam par mi slob pa'i rig pa ni/ tha ma zad mkhyen kho na ste/ gzhan gnyis ni zag bcas (529) yin yang*/ mi slob pa de'i rgyud las skyes pa'i phyir de'i rig pa zhes bya'o// de gnyis ni slob pa chags bral la'ang yod par 'dod de/ 'on kyang slob pa ma rig pa dang bcas pa'i rgyud yin pa'i phyir na rig par ma bshad do// bzhi pa ni mngon shes dang po dang*/

gsum pa dang drug pa rnams rim pas rdzu 'phrul dang*/ kun brjod pa dang*/ rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul rnams yin te/ dang por gdul bya'i yid 'phrog pa'am/ zhe 'dras pa dang*/ bar mar gnas pa'i yid 'phrog pas so// de la gnyis pas khyod kyi sems ni 'di 'dra'o// zhes kyang brjod cing*/ gsum pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin bstan to// de gsum gyi nang nas rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul mchog ste/ de ni nyon mongs zad pa med na mi 'byung bas mi 'khrul la gnyis po rig sngags kyis kyang byed pa'i phyir dang*/ gnyis pos gtod pa tsam du zad la/ 'dis thabs bstan nas phan pa dang*/ yid du 'ong ba'i (530) 'bras bu la sbyor ba'i phyir ro// khyad par bshad pa'i rdzu 'phrul zhes pa'i bar ci ltar zhe na/ gzhan dag sprul 'gro sogs su bzhed kyang*/ bye brag smra ba ni/ rdzu 'phrul ni 'dis 'byor bar byed pas ting nge 'dzin te/ des ci 'byor bar 'gyur zhe na/ de las ni sprul pa dang*/ 'gro ba'o// 'gro ba la gsum ste/ bya ltar lus phyin byed dang*/ thag ring po la nye bar mos pas myur du bgrod pa mos pa las byung ba dang*/ yid ltar 'gyogs pa'o// ston pa kho na la thugs skyed pa'i dus kyis 'byon pas yid 'gyogs kyi 'gro ba mnga' na gzhan gnyis lta ci smos so// gzhan nyan thos sogs rnams la'ang*/ lus phyin byed dang*/ mos pa las byung yod kyi/ yid 'gyogs med do// de la sems can gsar skye med pas nang gi dang*/ chos kyi skye mched sprul mi nus la/ rgyun med pas sgra yang mi sprul lo// des na 'dod par rtogs pa'i sprul pa ni/ gzugs dri ro reg bya'i rang (531) bzhin yin pas phyi'i skye mched rnam pa bzhi yin la/ de yang rang dang gzhan gyi lus dang 'brel pa rnam pa gnyis so// gzugs na dri ro med pas der gtogs pa'i sprul pa ni/ gzugs dang reg bya gnyis yin la/

de'ang rang dang gzhan gyi lus dang 'brel pa gnyis so// de ltar sprul pa ni/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyis 'dod gzugs su rang gzhan gyi lus dang 'brel pa gnyis re ste/ bzhi dang*/ gzugs kyi rten can gyis kyang de ltar bzhi ste brgyad do// ci mngon shes kho nas sprul lam zhe na/ min gyi mngon shes kyi 'bras bu sprul sems rnams kyis sprul la/ sprul sems de rnams kyang ni bcu bzhi ste/ bsam gtan dang po'i 'bras bu sprul sems ni 'dod pa dang*/ dang po'i sa pa gnyis nas gnyis pa'i gsum dang*/ gsum pa'i bzhi dang*/ gzhi pa'i 'og sa bzhi dang*/ rang sa ste lnga'i bar mas rim bzhin yin gyi/ 'og ma'i 'bras bu sprul sems gong ma las skyes pa (532) min pas gong du sprul mi nus so// sprul sems de snyed pa ni bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi dag pa bzhin du chags bral gyis rnyed do// sprul sems de ni rnyed pa ni thog mar 'jug pa'i tshe/ bsam gtan dag pa ba dang*/ rgyun gyi tshe rang las skye la/ de las ma langs bar du rang rgyun dang*/ langs pa na bsam gtan dag pa gnyis kho na skye ste/ ting nge 'dzin de la ma zhugs par ting nge 'dzin de las ldang ba med do// sprul pa thams cad rang gi sa pa'i sprul sems kho nas sprul par byed kyi/ sa gzhan gyi sprul sems kyis sa gzhan gyis sprul pa mi byed do// sprul pa dag smrar 'jug pa'i smra sems ni/ 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po'i sa pa'i sprul pa ni rang sa'i sems kho nas smrar 'jug pa la de yan chad na rang sa pa med pas 'og ma dang po'i rtog dpyod mngon du byas nas smrar 'jug go /ston pa min pa'i sprul pa ni/ sprul po dang bcas te/ smra bas sprul pa mang po smra ba na gcig car smra ste/ (533) lung du gcig gcig smra bar byed pa na sprul pa thams cad smra bar byed/ gcig mi smra bar gyur pa dang*/ de dag thams cad smra mi 'gyur zhes so// ston pa ni sprul pa smra na'ang rang nyid mi gsung ba sogs ji ltar bzhed pa'o// smra sems mngon du byas pa'i tshe sprul sems med pas na/

sprul pa med na ji ltar sprul pa smrar 'jug ce na/ sprul pa la byin gyis brlabs nas smrar gzhug go /zhes sngar 'phangs zhing*/ de nas gnas par 'dod pa'i sprul sems kyis sprul te/ 'di srid gcig gnas par gyur cig ces byin gyis brlabs nas yid gzhan smra sems kyis smrar 'jug pa'i phyir te/ byin gyi rlob sems ni/ dag pa bar chad do// ci gson po kho na la byin brlabs yod dam zhe na/ der ma zad shi ba la byin brlabs yod de/ 'od bsrung chen po'i byin brlabs kyis de'i keng rus gnas pa lta bu'o// de'ang mi gtan pa la (534) byin rlabs med de/ 'od bsrung gi sha sogs lta bu'o// gzhan rnams ni shi ba la byin brlabs yod pa min gyi/ 'od bsrung gi keng rus gnas pa ni/ lha'i mthus so zhes zer ro// ci sems gcig gis sprul pa gcig kho na sprul lam zhe na/ dang po ni/ sprul sems du mas sprul pa gcig sprul par byed pa yin te/ mngon shes byang bar gyur nas de las zlog nas sprul sems gcig gis sprul pa ci 'dod pa du ma sprul lo// bzhi pa ni/ ci sprul sems thams cad lung ma bstan yin nam zhe na/ bsam gtan sgom pa las skyes pa mngon shes kyi 'bras bu ni/ lung ma bstan kho na yin la skye ba las skyes pa/ lha klu sha za sogs kyi ni gzhan la phan gnod byed 'dod pa'i dbang gis dge mi dge lung ma bstan rnam pa gsum srid do// ci rdzu 'phrul ni sgom byung dang*/ skyes thob gnyis kho nar zad dam zhe na/ rdzu 'phrul ni bsdu na/ sgom byung mngon shes su bgrang ba dang*/ yi dwags (535) kha cig gi lta bu skyes thob dang*/ ghaṃ dha ra zhes pa'i gsang sngags kyis mkha' la 'gro ba lta bu/ sngags las skyes pa dang*/ sman dang*/ nor bu las skyes pa dang*/ nga las nu dang*/ 'dod lha dang*/ bar do'i lta bu las las skyes pa rnams te/ rnam pa lnga'o// ci lha'i mig dang*/

rna ba dag lha'i kho na'am/ byang sems dang 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ khyim bdag rin chen gyi ltar lha dang 'dra ba yin zhe na/ snga ma ltar yin te/ de gnyis bsam gtan gyi mthus mig dang rna ba'i tshogs par bsam gtan gyi sa pa'i 'byung gyur gyi gzugs dang ba 'grub pas so// de gnyis ni rtag tu rnam shes dang ldan pas rten bcas kho na dang*/ zhar ba dang*/ 'on pa med pas ma tshang ba med pa dang*/ yul yang gzugs sgra thag ring ba dang*/ cha phra ba dang*/ sogs pas sgrib pa dang*/ rgyab 'dun thams cad du mthong bas de rnams kyi spyod yul can te/ gang phyir sha'i mig (536) gis gzugs// thag ring gnas dang sgrib pa dang*// phra dang thams cad mi mthong ba// de phyir lha yis mthong bar 'dod do// zhes so// yum du/ sha'i mig gis dpag tshad brgya nas stong gsum gyi bar mthong bar gsungs pa ni/ yum gyi rnal 'byor gyis sbyangs pa'i byang sems kyi dbang du byas la/ sangs rgyas kyi sha'i spyan gyis chos thams cad kyang gzigs mod kyi rnam bzhag gzhan yin no// lha'i mig gis thag ji srid cig mthong zhe na/ nyan thos dgra bcom dang*/ rang rgyal bse ru lta bu dang*/ lha mi'i ston pa rnams kyi/ mig gis mngon par 'du mdzad na/ rim pas stong gnyis pa dang*/ stong gsum pa dang*/ ji tsam bzhed pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa mthong la 'du ma mdzad na ni/ stong dang*/ (537) stong gnyis dang*/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten mthong ngo zhe'o// ci rdzu 'phrul 'ba' zhig skyes thob yin nam zhe na/ der ma zad lha'i mig dang*/ rna ba dang*/ sngon nas rjes dran dang*/ sems shes te gzhan bzhi yang skye bas thob pa yod la/ skyes thob kyis ni mngon shes kyi ming mi thob bo// mi skyes thob des ni srid pa bar ma mi mthong la/ yum du/ 'chi 'pho dang*/ skye ba shes par gsungs pa ni/ snga ma ltar ro// sems shes skyes thob de ni/ bsam pa'i dbang gis/

dge mi dge lung ma bstan rnam pa gsum srid la/ gang yang mtshan mas pha rol gyis sems shes pa rtog ge pa dang*/ rtog byed ces pa'i rig sngags kyis byas pa'i sems shes de yang*/ dge sogs gsum mo// sems shes dang*/ sngon nas rjes dran skyes thob dmyal ba yod pas ni/ dang po sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas ma nyen bar du shes la/ 'gro ba gzhan na yod (538) pas rtag tu shes so// rten gyi khyad par mi la rdzu 'phrul sogs sngar skye bas thob pa med cing*/ mi rang bzhin gyis tshe rabs dran pa ni/ las las skyes pa yin la/ des na mngon gnas rjes dran ni/ sgom 'bras dang lha sogs kyi lta bu skyes thob dang*/ byang sems 'dis gnas kyi lta bu las byung ba gsum mo// chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'brel pa las ye shes bstan pa zhes bya ba gnas bdun pa'i 'grel pa'o// //brgyad pa snyoms 'jug bstan pa la gnyis te/ snyoms 'jug dngos/ de la bstan pa'i yon tan no// dang po la gsum ste/ snyoms 'jug brgyad ting nge 'dzin gsum/ ting nge 'dzin bzhir dbye ba'o// dang po la snyoms 'jug gi dbye ba ni/ shes pa'i rang bzhin gyi yon tan bshad nas rang gzhan snyoms 'jug sogs ston pa la/ yon tan gyi rten yin pas/ bsam gtan dang por ston te/ de la bsam gtan rnams ni/ 'bras bu

(539) skye ba dang*/ rgyu snyoms 'jug ste/ rnam pa gnyis yin la/ de gnyis re re la bsam gtan dang po sogs bzhi'o// de la bsam gtan der skye ba rnams 'jig rten bstan par rab du bshad zin pas yang mi brjod do// snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan ni/ dge ba'i sems rtse cig pa ste dmigs pa gcig pa yin te/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin yin pas so// rjes 'brang 'khor dang bcas na gzugs sogs phung po lnga'o// bye brag smra ba ni sems gcig nyid rtse gcig pa ting nge 'dzin ma yin gyi 'du byed pa'i chos de ting nge 'dzin yin pas 'di'i gtso bo ni sems ting nge 'dzin sems las rdzas gzhan par 'dod la/ snga ma ni/ mdo sde pa'i lugs te/ ting nge 'dzin dang rdzas gcig pa'i sems gtso bor bzhed do// nges tshig ni/ 'dis sems par byed pa na ste/ dmigs pa gcig la bsam pa gtan po byas te/ sgom (540) pas bsam gtan zhes dka' spyad du bshad do// nyon mongs can ji ltar bsam gtan yin zhe na/ de dang rigs mthun pas te/ sa bon rul pa bzhin no// yang na bcom ldan 'das kyis bsam gtan mi dge ba dag kyang gsungs pas nyes pa med do zhes te/ ting nge 'dzin tsam ni yid kyi sa mang po pa yin pas dge sogs gsum car srid la/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin la khams gong du 'phen dgos pas dge ba zag bcas su nges so// yang bsam gtan dang po nas bzhi pa'i bar ci lta bu zhe na/ dang po ni dpyod pa dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ bde ba dang*/ ldan pa'i dge ba rtse cig pa ste/ de na rtog pa'ang yod pa ni/ dga' ba bde dang ldan pa'i spyod pas mtshon nus so// lhag ma gsum ni/ yan lag de gsum gyi/ snga ma snga ma spangs ste/ gnyis pa ni spyod pa spangs zhing*/ dga' bde dang ldan pa'i dge ba rtse cig (541) pa dang*/ gsum pa ni/ spyod dga' spangs zhing bde ba dang ldan pa'i dge ba rtse cig pa dang*/ bzhi pa ni/ spyod dga' bde ba gsum spangs pa'i gzugs kyi dge ba rtse cig pa'o// bsam gtan de bzhin du gzugs med rnams ni rnam gnyis bzhi// der skye ba rnams rab du bshad// snyoms 'jug dge ba rtse cig pa// rjes 'brang bcas na phung po bzhi// zhes pa ste/

rjes su 'brang ba'i gzugs med pas so// so so'i ngo bo 'og ma'i sa las dben pa las skyes pa ste/ bsam gtan bzhi pa las dben pa las skyes pa ni nam mkha' dang*/ de las dben pa rnam shes sogs so// dben pa ni 'og sa las 'dod chags dang bral bar byed pa'i lam ste/ nyer ldog yin la/ de las skyes pa'o// dngos gzhi bzhi po nyer ldog gong ma gsum dang bcas par ni/ gzugs kyi 'du shes bshig ces bya'i// nam mkha'i (542) nyer ldog ni bsam gtan bzhi pa la dmigs pas gzugs kyi 'du shes dang ma bral lo// gzugs med na gtan nas med do// phal chen pa sogs gzugs phra bas gzugs med du brjod do// zhes brjod pa ni mi rigs te/ rnam pa phra bas yin na/ chu'i skye bo phra mo yang der 'gyur la/ rang bzhin phra bas yin na gzugs khams pa'ang der 'gyur zhing*/ ches phra zhing dwangs pas yin na srid rtse ba kho na der 'gyur te/ rgyas par 'grel par lta'o// 'o na de nas khams 'og mar skye ba'i gzugs ci las skye zhe na/ gzugs de ni rnam smin gyi rgyus sgom pa'i sems 'jug pa rnyed pa las skye bar 'gyur te/ mdo sde pa'i lugs so// bye brag smra ba ni 'das pa'i gzugs las skye bar 'dod do// ci nam mkha' mtha' yas sogs bzhi po nam mkha' mtha' yas pa sogs kho na la dmigs pas ming de skad ces bya'am zhe na/ min te/ dang po gsum po nam mkha' (543) mtha' yas so// rnam shes mtha' yas so// ci yang med do// zhes bya ba de ltar yid la byed cing*/ rab du sbyor ba'i phyir/ sbyor ba'i ming gis btags pa ste/ gzhan na ni chos gzhan la'ang dmigs so// bzhi pa ni 'du shes sman pa'i phyir/ ming de skad de 'du shes gsal ba'ang med la/ 'du shes med pa kho na'ang ma yin pas so// tshul de ltar snyoms 'jug dngos gzhi'i rdzas bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gzugs med bzhi ste rnam pa brgyad do// srid rtse min pa bdun ni rnam pa gsum ste/

ro myang dang mtshungs ldan dang*/ dag pa ba dang*/ zag med de brgyad pa srid rtse ni zag med med pas rnam pa gnyis so// de la ro myang mtshungs ldan ni srid pa dang bcas te/ gong ma pa ni/ nyon mongs can gyi snyoms 'jug la sred pa dang*/ lta ba dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ the tshom shes (544) che ba bzhir bzhed do// 'jig rten pa'i dge ba ni ma chags pa sogs chos dkar po dang ldan pas na dag pa ste/ dag pa de ni ro myang ldan des myang bya'o// zag med ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'o// de nyid gtan la dbab pa la bsam gtan gyi yan lag ngos bzung ba ni/ bsam gtan dang po la yan lag lnga ste/ rtog pa dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ bde ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rnams so// gnyis pa la ni/ yan lag bzhi ste/ nang rab du dwang ba dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ sems rtse gcig pa'o// gsum pa la yan lag lnga ste/ 'du byed btang snyoms dang*/ dran pa dang*/ shes bzhin dang*/ bde ba dang*/ gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin no// mtha' ste/ bzhi pa na yan lag bzhi ste/ dran pa dang*/ 'du byed btang snyoms gnyis skyon brgyad las grol ba dag pa dang*/ bde min sdug min gyi tshor ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gnyis yongs su dag pa ste/ (545) yan lag gi don ni/ bye brag smra ba/ ting nge 'dzin bsam gtan dang*/ yan lag gnyis ka dang*/ gzhan rnams yan lag kho nar 'dod la/ slob dpon ni/ yan lag bzhi pa'i dmag ltar/ yan lag can dang*/ yan lag don gzhan min gyi spyi dang bye brag lta bur bzhed do// de ltar ming gi sgo nas bco brgyad yod kyang rdzas su bcu gcig ste/ dang po lnga dang*/ gnyis pa'i nang rab dang*/ gsum pa'i dang po bzhi dang*/ bzhi pa'i tshor ba'o// bsdu bar ni/ btang snyoms dran pa shes bzhin gsum yod kyang*/ dang por ma smos cing*/ gnyis par rtog dpyod kyi 'phrug pa dang*/ bral bas nang rab dang gi ming gis smos la/ gsum par rang ming gis smos par bshad pas rdzas bdun du'ang 'dus so// cis gsum pa'i bde ba dang po'i bde ba las rdzas gzhan du brjod ce na/

bsam gtan (546) dang*/ dga' bde dang po dang*/ gnyis pa na/ shin du sbyangs pa bde ba yin gyi/ tshor bde min te/ lus tshor ni kha phyir ltas pas yan lag du mi rung la/ sems tshor ni dga' ba yid bde yin pas/ sems de dang gcig car mi 'byung bas so// zhe'o// mdo sde pa ni bsam gtan gsum car na lus kyi bde ba yan lag du 'dod la/ gong ma pa'ang de gsum gyi bde ba rdzas so sor mi bzhed de/ gnyis pa ni nang rab du dwang ba ni/ mnyam bzhag gi sa las nges par 'byung ba la yid ches pa'i dad pa yin no// gong ma pa ni/ nang ni sems dang sems byung ste/ dang po ni rtog spyod kyi 'khrug pa dang bral ba la bzhed do// lung rnam pa gnyis kyi phyir dga' ba ni/ yid bde ste/ rnam par sgyur ba'i mdo las/ bsam gtan gsum pa gsungs nas/ 'dir 'di'i yid bde'i dbang po skyes pa ma lus pa 'gag par 'gyur ro// (547) bsam gtan bzhi pa la ni/ bde ba'i dbang po 'gag par 'gyur ro zhes dang*/ yang bde ba'ang spangs te/ snga nas sdug bsngal ba yang spangs zhing*/ yid bde ba dang mi bde ba yang nub pas ces so// bsdu bar ni/ dga' ba dang*/ yid bde ba tha dad pa'ang bshad la/ bde ba gzhan dag kyang dga' ba sems byung gi chos gzhan du 'dod do// yan lag gi grangs nges dang gzugs med na yan lag med tshul sogs bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi rnam bzhag rgyas par kho bos byas pa'i bsam gtan dang*/ gzugs med gtan la dbab pa'i rab byed du lta bar bya'o// ci nyon mongs can gyi bsam gtan la'ang yan lag dag yod dam zhe na med de/ dang po las dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' bde dang*/ gnyis pa la rang du dwang ba dang*/ gsum pa la shes bzhin dang*/ dran pa dang*/ bzhi pa la btang snyoms dang*/ dran pa yongs su dag pas med ces (548) kha cig zer ro// kha cig ni dang po la shin du sbyangs pa dang*/ phyi ma la btang snyoms med de/ de gnyis ni dge ba'i sa mang yin pas so// zhes zer ro// ston pas bsam gtan gsum ni/

skyon dang bcas pas g.yo ba dang bcas par bka' stsal la/ skyon brgyad las ni grol ba'i phyir/ bsam gtan bzhi pa g.yo ba med pa yin te/ skyon brgyad gang zhe na/ rtog pa dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ dbugs rngub pa dang*/ 'byung ba dag dang*/ bde ba dang*/ sogs pas sdug bsngal yid bde yid mi bde bzhi yin no// ci skye ba'i bsam gtan rnams na'ang*/ snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan na yod pa'i tshor ba de rnams nyid yod dam zhe na/ med kyi de rnams na/ dang po na yid kyi sa pa'i yid bde dang*/ rnam shes tshogs gsum pa'i bde ba dang*/ tshogs bzhi pa'i btang snyoms dang*/ gnyis pa na yid sa pa'i btang snyoms dang*/ yid bde dang*/ gsum pa na yid sa pa'i bde ba dang*/ btang snyoms dang*/ bzhi pa na btang snyoms (549) gcig pu'i tshor ba yod do// gal te gnyis pa sogs na shes tshogs gsum dang*/ rtog dpyod med na mthong bas na reg pa'i bar dang*/ rnam rig slong bar ci ltar 'gyur zhe na/ de rnams su skyes pa la mig shes sogs yod pa'ang min la/ rang gis 'ang min gyi/ sprul sems bzhin du/ bsam gtan dang po'i sa pa'i lus dang*/ mig dang rna ba'i rnam shes dang*/ rnam rig slong ba mngon du byed cing*/ gus pas min yang dgos pa'i dbang gis mngon du byed pa gang yin pa de ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i sa par rtogs la/ mngon du byas pa'i rnam shes de ma sgrib lung ma bstan yin gyi/ 'dod chags dang bral bas nyon mongs can min la/ sman pas dge ba'ang min no// snyoms 'jug thob tshul sogs ni/ dag pa sogs kyi bsam gtan dang*/ gzugs med ji ltar thob ce na dngos gzhi de rnams dang da mi ldan na/ 'og sa las 'dod (550) chags dang bral ba dang*/ gong nas 'og du skye ba dang gnyis las dag pa rnams thob bo// srid rtse ni skye bas mi thob ste/ gong sa med cing rang sa dang*/ 'og sa nas skye ba la sngar nas ldan pas so// rigs tsam sngar nas ldan pa la ni sbyor bas nges 'byed cha mthun dag pa ba dang*/

gnas pa cha mthun las nyams pas nyams pa cha mthun dag pa ba thob bo// zag med kyi dngos gzhi rnams sngar mi ldan na/ 'og pa las 'dod chags dang bral ba yis thob kyi/ skye ba dang nyams pas mi thob bo// ldan pa la ni zad pa shes pa las mi slob pa thob pa la dad mos mthong thob du gyur na slob pa thob cing*/ dus sbyor mi g.yo ba rtogs na mi slob pa thob bo// nyon mongs can ni chags bral las nyams pa dang*/ srid rtse min pa rnams gong nas 'og du skye ba yis de dang mi ldan pa thob kyi/ chags bral gyis mi thob bo// snyoms 'jug gi rdzas rnams gang gi 'jug du skye zhe na/ (551) zag pa med pa'i snyoms 'jug gi 'jug thogs su/ rgyun gyi tshe rang dang*/ ldang ba'i tshe rang dang*/ ltag dang 'og na snyoms 'jug gi rdzas gzhan yod na gsum pa'i bar gyi dge ba dag pa ba dang*/ zag med kyang skye ste/ thod rgal la 'jug tshul gyis shes par bya'o// des na bsam gtan dang po zag med kyi 'jug du drug skye ste/ rang sa dang*/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa'i dag pa ba dang*/ zag med gnyis re'o// ci yang la bdun te/ rang sa dang*/ rnam shes dang*/ nam mkha' gsum gyi dag pa dang*/ zag med gnyis re dang*/ srid rtse'i dag pa'o// de bzhin du gnyis pa la brgyad dang*/ rnam shes la dgu dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa dang*/ nam mkha' gsum la bcu bcu re skye'o// dag pa ba las zag med de bzhin du skye la/ khyad par ni rang sa'i nyon mongs kyang skye bas grangs re res lhag par sbyar ro// de rnams su gzugs med kyi dge ba ni zag med rjes shes dang*/ phan tshun du skye ba'i chos (552) shes dang ni min te/ chos shes ni 'dod khams la dmigs pas so// nyon mongs can las der shes na/ rang sa'i dag pa dang*/ rgyun gyi tshe nyon mongs can nyid dang*/ nyon mongs kyis gzir ba'i tshe 'og ma'i dag pa gcig kyang skye'o// shi 'pho ba'i tshe ni/

dag pa skyes thob las sa thams cad kyi nyon mongs kun ji rigs par skye ste/ sa gong 'og kun du skyer rung bas so// 'chi ba na nyon mongs can gyi snyoms 'jug las rang sa dang 'og ma'i nyon mongs can skye'i gong ma'i nyon mongs skye ba min te/ de nyon mongs can snyoms 'jug yod na 'og sa'i nyon mongs ma spangs par gong sar skye mi srid pas so// dag pa thams cad las zag med skye ba min gyi de ni nyams pa'i cha mthun dang*/ sogs pas gnas pa'i cha mthun dang*/ khyad par gyi cha mthun dang*/ nges 'byed cha mthun dang*/ rnam pa bzhi ste/ srid rtse la khyad par cha mthun min pa gsum mo// de bzhi'i mtshan nyid ni/ go rim bzhin (553) du nyon mongs skye ba dang*/ rjes su mthun pa dang*/ rang sa dang*/ rjes su mthun pa dang*/ gong ma'i dge ba skye ba dang*/ rjes su mthun pa dang*/ zag pa med pa'i rjes su mthun pa ste/ zag med ni de la skye'o// de bzhi gang gi 'jug du skye zhe na/ nyams pa cha mthun sogs de bzhi so so'i 'jug thogs su rim pas/ de bzhi dang po gnyis dang*/ dang po gsum dang*/ tha ma gsum dang*/ tha ma gcig pu skye'o// thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug ji ltar skye zhe na/ sbyor dngos gnyis kyi/ sbyor ba la ring sbyor dang*/ nye sbyor las ring sbyor ni/ gang la thod rgal bya ba'i gzhi sa brgyad rnam pa gnyis te/ snyoms 'jug brgyad zag bcas zag med rnam pa gnyis yin la/ zag bcas brgyad dang zag med bdun no// tshul ni 'brel pa ste/ go rim bzhin du zag bcas brgyad la/ yar lugs 'byung du song zhing*/ mar lugs zlog (554) du 'ongs nas/ zag med bdun la'ang de bzhin du zhugs pas byang bar byas pa'o// nye sbyong ni de nas cig ste/ re re rgal nas zag bcas dang po la zag bcas gsum pa sogs/ yar lugs 'byung du song zhing*/ mar lugs zlog du 'ongs nas zag med bdun pa la'ang de bzhin du zhugs pas byang bar byas pa'o// dngos gzhi ni de nas ni gang gi tshe zag bcas dang po las zag med gsum pa dang*/

de las zag bcas nam mkha' dang*/ de las zag med ci yang la 'jug cing*/ de bzhin du lugs zlog du 'jug pa de'i tshe/ rigs mi mthun pa'i rdzas gsum par 'gro ba'i phyir/ thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug dngos gzhi grub pa yin no// shin du ring bas bzhi pa la mi 'jug cing*/ rten gling gsum gyi mi dang*/ gang zag dbang po rno la nyon mongs med cing ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob pa zhig ste dgra bcom mi g.yo ba kho nas bskyed do// sar ni sangs rgyas dang*/ bskal pa grangs med gnyis (555) nges par 'byung ba'i byang sems kyi sa brgyad rgal yang nus par bshad do// rten gang gis bsam gtan dang gzugs med du zhig mngon du byed ce na/ de rnams rang sa dang*/ 'og sa'i rten can la mngon du byed la/ rten gong ma'i 'og ma'i snyoms 'jug mngon du mi byed de/ dgos pa med pas so// 'on kyang srid rtser skyes pa'i 'phags pa phyir mi 'ong ni rang sa na zag med med cing*/ ci yang med pa dang*/ nye bas de'i zag med mngon du byas nas srid rtse'i zag pa zad par byed do// zhes pa ni dmigs bsal lo// bsam gtan dang gzugs med 'di rnams kyi dmigs pa ci zhe na/ srid bcas ro myang ldan ni/ rang gi srid pa ste/ rang sa'i zag bcas kyi dngos po la dmigs kyi/ chags pa dang bral bas 'og sa dang*/ sred pas ris su bcad pas gong sa dang*/ dge ba'i chos la 'dun par thal bas zag med la mi dmigs so// bsam gtan dge ba dag pa ba

(556) dang*/ zag med kyi yul ni/ chos gang 'dus byas sam 'dus ma byas yod dgu cog yin cing*/ gzugs med dngos gzhi dge ba rnams kyi/ spyod yul ni zag bcas 'og min gyi rang sa dang gong sa'i zag bcas zag med ci rigs pa dang*/ 'og sa'i yang rjes shes phyogs kyi zag med do// de rnams kyi nyer ldog gi bar chad med lam rnams kyi dmigs pa ni 'og sa'i zag bcas so// de gsum la zag pa med pas rang sa dang*/ gong ma'i nyon mongs rnams spong la/ nyer ldog dag pa bas kyang rang rang gi 'og sa'i nyon mongs rnams spong zhing*/ kyang gi sgras mi lcog med zag med sdud pa ste/ de ni sa thams cad kyi nyon mongs spong nus par bshad zin to// des na zag bcas kyi dngos gzhis ni/ nyon mongs gtan mi spong ste/ 'og sa'i nyer ldog gis spangs zin cing*/ srid pas srid pa las nges par 'byung mi nus pas rang sa'i mi spong la/ dman pas khyad par can spong mi nus pas gong sa'i mi (557) spong bas so// gnyis pa ni nyer ldog du yod ces na/ snyoms 'jug brgyad po de rnams la 'jug pa'i nyer ldog kyang brgyad de/ 'jug tshul 'dir zhib du ma bshad la/ gong mar yid bdun res 'jug par bshad de/ mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa'i yid la byed pas gong ma zhi ba dang*/ 'og ma rags par lta ba thos bsam dang 'dres pa dang*/ mos pa las byung ba dmigs rnam de nyid sgom byung kho nas rtse cig par sgom pa dang*/ rab du dben pa sa 'og ma'i nyon mongs pa chen po gsum spong ba dang*/ dga' ba sdud pa rgyud dga' bas khyab par 'bring gsum spong ba dang*/ spyod pa sa 'og ma'i nyon mongs yod med rtag pa byed pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i mtha' spyad pas nyon mongs cung zad yod par rig nas sgom pas chung ngu gsum spong ba dang*/ sbyor ba'i mtha'i 'bras bu yid la byed pa gong ma'i dngos gzhir gyur pa'o// ci nyer ldog rnams ro myang

(558) ldan sogs gsum yin la/ tshor ba'ang dngos gzhi dang 'dra'am zhe na/ 'og sa las yid 'byung ba dang ma bral zhing*/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i lam yin pas ro myang ldan min gyi/ dag pa dang 'bad de grangs dgos pas bde ba'ang min/ sdug bsngal yang min pa btang snyoms kho na dang ldan no// nyer ldog gi dang po mi lcogs med la gsal bas sam/ bsdu ba ltar na mnyam bzhag gi dang po yin pas 'phags pa'ang ste/ zag med kyang yod la kha cig ni ro myang ldan gsum du 'dod de/ rgyu mtshan ni gsal bsam/ slob dpon 'dus bzang na re/ dngos gzhi la 'gran rnyog pas so// zhes zer ro// nyer ldog dang*/ bsam gtan khyad par can don gcig gam zhe na/ don tha dad de/ nyer ldog ni 'dod chags dang bral ba'i lam yin la/ bsam gtan dang po kho na rtog med de/ rtog pa dang mtshungs par mi ldan pa ni/ bsam gtan khyad par can te/ bsam gtan dang po'i (559) dngos gzhi tsam po las khyad par du 'phags la gnyis pa sogs la ni/ de 'dra ba'i khyad par med pas bsam gtan khyad par can mi bzhag go /de ni ro myang sogs rnam pa gsum dang*/ de lam dka' bas 'bad de grangs dgos pa'i phyir bde min sdug min gyi tshor ba kho na dang ldan la ste/ sgom na ni tshangs chen gyi 'bras bu can no// ting nge 'dzin gsum du dbye ba ni/ mdo las/ ting nge 'dzin gsum gsungs pa la khyad par can de ni rtog pa med la spyod pa tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ de man chad dang po'i dngos gzhi dang*/ mi lcogs med ni rtog dpyod gnyis ka dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ de yan chad gnyis pa'i nyer ldog nas srid rtse'i bar ni rtog dpyod gnyis ka med pa'i ting nge 'dzin no// mdo las stong pa nyid dang*/ smon pa med pa dang*/ mtshan ma med pa bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum gsungs pa'i mtshan med ni/ yul lnga dang 'dus byas kyi (560) mtshan nyid bzhi pho mo'i mtshan ma ste/

bcu zhi ba'i 'gog bden gyi rnam pa bzhi dang*/ mtshungs par ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin no// stong nyid ni bdag med dang*/ stong nyid kyi rnam pa gnyis dang*/ mtshungs par ldan pas/ 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin no// smon pa med pa ni rnam pa de drug las gzhan bden pa'i rnam pa lhag ma bcu dang*/ mtshungs par ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin te/ mi rtag sdug bsngal dang*/ rgyu sogs bzhis yid 'byung la lam yang gzings ltar dor bya yin pas smon pa med pa'o// sngar gyi drug gis ni yid mi 'byung ste/ stong pa bdag med kyang myang 'das dang 'dra bas so// gong ma pa ni lam gyi gzhi'ang mtshan med de/ 'gog lam la mtshan med byed mi nus pas so// mi rtag sdug bsngal dang*/ rgyu sogs bzhi dang bcas pas khams gsum pa la mi smon pas na/ de drug smon med du bzhed la/ kun du kun btags sogs de nyid gsum la dmigs par yang bshad do// (561) de gsum bden pa'i rnam pa can yin pas ro myang ldan dang*/ gong ma bdun gyi nyer ldog la med kyi/ sa bcu gcig gi dag pa ba dang*/ sa dgu pa'i dri ma med pa gnyis yin la/ de gsum rnams dri ma med pa ni/ thar pa'i sgo mo yin pas rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid sogs gsum mo// stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ces pa dang*/ sogs pa smon pa med pa dang*/ mtshan ma med pa mtshan ma med pa ste/ gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin gsum mo// de gsum las/ dang po gnyis ni/ rim pas 'di ni bdag gi min no// zhes stong pa nyid kyi rnam par lta bas mi slob pa'i stong nyid la dmigs pa dang*/ mi rtag pa nyid kyi rnam par lta bas mi slob pa'i smon med la dmigs pa yin la/ mtshan ma med pa mtshan ma med pa ni zhi ba nyid kyi rnam par lta bas mi slob pa'i mtshan med las langs pa'i rjes (562) su zag bcas dang*/ zag med gzhan skyes na rkyen gzhan ma tshang bas mi slob pa'i mtshan med de nyid ma rtags zad pa ste/

rtags min thob pas 'gog pa de la mi dmigs so// de gsum ni/ dang po gnyis rnam thar nyid la dmigs shing*/ gsum pa rnam thar bkag pa la dmigs nas sun 'byin pas rnam thar sun 'byin zhes kyang bya'o// de gsum gyi ngo bo ni/ stong pa dang*/ mi rtag pa dang*/ zhi ba'i rnam pas 'phags lam las rgyab kyis phyogs pas/ zag bcas nyid dang*/ rten ni blo gsal bas mi'i nang du skye la/ gang zag ni dgra bcom mi g.yo ba'i chos can las ste gzhan gyi rnam thar la rgyab kyi phyogs mi nus la/ des mthong chos la bde bar gnas par 'gyur bas/ chags pa'i gnas su gyur pa'i rnam thar la rgyab kyis phyogs par bya ba'i phyir ting nge 'dzin gzhan la 'jug cing*/ sa ni bden pa'i rnam pa can yin pas/ (563) nyer ldog gong ma bdun ma gtogs pa bcu gcig na yod do// ting nge 'dzin bzhir dbye ba ni/ yang bzhi ste/ ting nge 'dzin sgom pa kun du bstan gom par byas lan mang du byas na/ mthong pa'i chos la bde bar gnas par 'gyur ba'ang yod/ de bzhin du sbyar ste/ shes pa mthong bar 'gyur ba'ang yod/ shes rab du rnam par 'byed par 'gyur ba'ang yod/ zag pa zad par 'gyur ba'ang yod/ ces gsungs pa las dge ba'i bsam gtan dag pa'am/ zag med dang po dang*/ de dang po yin pas mtshon pa'i phyi ma gsum dang*/ bzhi sgom pa ni/ mthong chos la bde bar gnas par 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa yin te/ de bzhi las nyams pa dang*/ gong du skyes pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa rnams la tshe phyi ma bde bar gnas pa med pas mthong chos zhes gsungs so// lhan cig mig gi mngon shes rjes su rgyu ba'i yid shes dang bcas (564) pa ni/ shes pa mthong bar 'gyur ba ste/ yid kyi las dge sdig sogs shes shing*/ mig gis bar do'i gzugs mthong bas shes par 'gyur ba dang*/ mthong bar 'gyur ba zhes tshig rnam par sbyar ro// ting nge 'dzin zhes pa mi 'bras bu mngon shes la rgyu ting nge 'dzin gyi ming gi btags pa'o// sbyor ba las byung ba'i yon tan khams gsum pa dang*/

zag med thams cad ni blo dbye ste/ shes rab du rnam par 'byed par 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa yin te/ 'dir ting nge 'dzin dang mtshungs par ldan pa la der btags so// rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ bsam gtan rab mtha' bzhi pa gang yin pa de zag pa zad par 'gyur ba gang yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'o// ting nge 'dzin de bzhi ni/ sngon ston pas mngon du mdzad par bstan pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshe las kyi mtha' la gzigs nas 'dzam bu'i shing gi drung du bsam gtan dang po skyed la/ byang chub kyi shing drung du thun dang (565) po la lha'i bu'i bdud bcom nas/ lha'i spyan skyed de/ sems can gyi 'chi 'pho dang*/ skye ba nyams nga ba la gzigs nas de dag skyabs pa'i phyir gung thun la rnam thar sogs sbyor ba las byung ba'i yon tan mngon du mdzad de/ thun gsum pa la bsam gtan bzhi pa la rten nas rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis kun sbyor thams cad spangs pa'i bar du mdzad do// zhes bye brag smra ba zer ro// dmigs pa'i tshad med pa ni/ byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ dga' ba btang snyoms te bzhi yin no// ci'i phyir bzhir nges zhe na/ gnod sems dang sogs pas rnam 'tshe dang*/ mi dga' ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang*/ gnod sems te/ bzhi mang ba'i gnyen po'i phyir ro// ngo bo ni zhe sdang med pa'i dge ba'i rang bzhin byams pa ste/ snying rje de yang de dang 'dra'o// gzhan bde bas yid bde ba'i rang bzhin dga' ba yin la/ (566) btang snyoms ni ma chags pa'i rang bzhin can no// ci ltar gnod sems kyi gnyen po yin zhe na/ de chags pas grangs pa'o// slob dpon ni/ 'di zhe sdang med pa dang*/ gnyis ka'i rang bzhin yin pas ji ltar srid pa bzhin/ chags sdang gnyis ka'i gnyen po yin la/ chags pa'ang*/ pha ma bu tsha/ nye du la chags pa'i gnyen po dang*/ 'khrig pa'i 'dod chags kyi gnyen po ni/

mi sdug par bzhed do// bye brag smra ba ni/ 'di de'i gnyen po dang*/ mi sdug pa kha dog gi chags sogs kyi gnyen por 'dod do// byams pa sogs bzhi'i rnam pa ni/ kye ma sems can rnams bde bar gyur cig mnyam pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig mnyam pa dang*/ dga' ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig mnyam pa dang*/ sems can rnams la chags sdang rnam par snyoms pa'o// spyod yul can/ 'dod pa na spyod pa'i sems can rnams te/ de la dmigs pa'i gnod sems kyi gnyen (567) po yin pas so// sa ni dga' ba yid bde yin pas/ bsam gtan dang po gnyis kho na na yod la/ gzhan gsum ni bsam gtan sa drug na yod do// kha cig dngos gzhi lnga nyid na yod par 'dod la/ gzhan ni 'dod pa dang nyer ldog phyi ma gsum yang bsnan nas bcu na yod ces zer ro// ci tshad med kyis nyon mongs spong ngam zhe na/ de bzhi yis dngos su mi spong ste/ phal cher dngos gzhi zag bcas yin pas dang*/ de kho na nyid yid byed kyis spong ba las/ mos pa yid la byed pa yin pas dang*/ chos kyi spyi'i mtshan nyid/ yid la byed pas spong ba la sems can la dmigs pas so// sngar gnyen por bshad pa ni/ de bzhi'i sbyor lam gyis rnam par gnon pa dang*/ bar chad med lam gyis spangs pa thag srings byed pas so// rten ni dang por mi rnams kyi nang du skye la/ ldan tshul ni nges par gsum ldun cing*/ bsam gtan gong (568) ma gnyis su skye ba la dga' ba med pas nges bzhi min no// rnam thar ni dmigs pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pas rnam par thar pa ste/ de yang gzugs can gzugs la lta ba dang*/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba dang*/ sdug pa'i rnam thar dang*/ gzugs med bzhi'i rnam thar bzhi dang*/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar te brgyad do// dang po gnyis ni/ rnam par sngos pa sogs kyi rnam pa can yin pas mi sdug pa'i rang bzhin te/ sa ni rim pas 'dod pa dang*/
